--[[
	Workspaces  -  virtual screens for plugin UI drawn over the viewport.
	A workspace holds windows: another plugin's overlay (a ScreenGui in CoreGui, or in a plugin's
	Folder there) or one top-level panel of this plugin. Every showing window belongs to the active
	workspace. Leaving one records what is showing and slides it off to the side; entering one
	slides its members back. Default keys (rebound in the Shortcuts panel; Shortcuts/WorkspaceKeys):
	  "/" next (wraps; makes one when there is only one), Shift + "/" send the hovered window to
	  the next, "=" new after the current, "-" merge into the left one, "H" hide or show the bar
	One empty workspace may exist at a time. The bar at the top (UIBuilder/WorkspaceBar) lists them
	once there is more than one.
	Mutates OTHER plugins' LIVE ScreenGuis: Enabled, and their top-level GuiObjects' Position for
	the length of a slide (put back after). Mutates this plugin's LIVE panels' Position only: a panel
	on another workspace is parked off-screen and marked `_workspaceParked`; Visible is never
	touched, as it means "open" to the rest of the plugin. A parked panel something else moves is
	back on screen. stop() and Unloading put back everything hidden. Studio's own overlays, this
	plugin's helper GUIs and docked windows are never touched.
	  start(plugin), stop(), setEnabled(on), bringHere(gui) -> boolean, goTo(index), next(), new(),
	  mergeLeft(), sendHovered(), refreshTheme(), run(name) (a WorkspaceKeys action)
	Cross-file: init.server.lua calls start() once setup passes its auth gate, and bringHere() from
	the toolbar click; SettingsToggles drives setEnabled(). Widgets.resolveOverlap skips a
	`_workspaceParked` panel, or its clamp would pull it back. UIBuilder/PanelPush neither writes
	nor counts one (isParked tells it by Position). Widgets.attachPanelBackground's image
	(OWN_BACKGROUND) follows its panel and is never a window.
]]

local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local WorkspaceBar = require(script.Parent.UIBuilder.WorkspaceBar)
local Motion = require(script.Parent.UIBuilder.Motion)
local WorkspaceKeys = require(script.Parent.Shortcuts.WorkspaceKeys)

local Workspaces = {}

-- Overlays Studio itself owns (tool handles, view selector, annotations).
local STUDIO_OVERLAYS = {
	RobloxGui = true, ViewSelectorScreenGui = true, DraggerUI = true, TransformTempAdornments = true,
	LightGuides = true, PlaceAnnotations = true, Gen3d = true, PathEditFolder = true,
}
-- Only the main UI's panels move between workspaces; banners and hosts stay put.
local OWN_PREFIX = "PartIcles"
local OWN_MAIN = "PartIclesUI"
local OWN_BACKGROUND = "PanelBackgroundImage"
local INDICATOR_NAME = WorkspaceBar.NAME
local PARKED_ATTRIBUTE = "_workspaceParked"
-- How many screens away a parked panel rests (one would let a wide panel peek in).
local PARKED_SCREENS = 3

local SLIDE_SECONDS = 0.22
local function slideInfo()
	return Motion.info(SLIDE_SECONDS, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
end
local DRAW_SCAN_LIMIT = 300

local workspaces = { { members = {} } }
local activeIndex = 1
-- Windows this module has put away. An overlay maps to true; a panel maps to its record
-- { home, parked, settled, tween } (home = its Position on screen, parked = where it rests).
local hidden = {}
local busy = false
local enabled = true
local started = false
local inputConnection = nil
local indicator = nil
local barHidden = false

local function drawsItself(object)
	if object.BackgroundTransparency < 1 then return true end
	if object:IsA("ImageLabel") or object:IsA("ImageButton") then
		return object.Image ~= "" and object.ImageTransparency < 1
	end
	if object:IsA("TextLabel") or object:IsA("TextButton") or object:IsA("TextBox") then
		return object.Text ~= "" and object.TextTransparency < 1
	end
	return object:IsA("ViewportFrame")
end

local function drawsAnything(parent, budget)
	for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		if budget.left <= 0 then return false end
		budget.left -= 1
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
			if drawsItself(child) or drawsAnything(child, budget) then return true end
		end
	end
	return false
end

local function isShowing(gui)
	if not gui.Enabled then return false end
	return drawsAnything(gui, { left = DRAW_SCAN_LIMIT })
end

-- Parked only while it rests where this module left it; moved by anything else, it is back.
local function isParked(panel)
	local record = hidden[panel]
	if not record then return false end
	if not record.settled or panel.Position == record.parked then return true end
	hidden[panel] = nil
	panel:SetAttribute(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE, nil)
	return false
end

local function isShowingPanel(panel)
	if not panel:IsA("GuiObject") or panel.Name == OWN_BACKGROUND then return false end
	if not panel.Visible or isParked(panel) then return false end
	return drawsItself(panel) or drawsAnything(panel, { left = DRAW_SCAN_LIMIT })
end

local function isManageable(gui)
	local name = gui.Name
	if name == INDICATOR_NAME then return false end
	if string.sub(name, 1, #OWN_PREFIX) == OWN_PREFIX then return name == OWN_MAIN end
	return true
end

-- Overlays, and this plugin's panels one by one; protected instances fail the pcall.
local function showingWindows()
	local found = {}
	local function consider(gui)
		if not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") or not isManageable(gui) then return end
		if gui.Name ~= OWN_MAIN then
			if isShowing(gui) then table.insert(found, gui) end
			return
		end
		if not gui.Enabled then return end
		for _, panel in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
			if isShowingPanel(panel) then table.insert(found, panel) end
		end
	end
	for _, child in ipairs(CoreGui:GetChildren()) do
		pcall(function()
			if STUDIO_OVERLAYS[child.Name] then return end
			if child:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				consider(child)
			elseif child:IsA("Folder") then
				for _, inner in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
					consider(inner)
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	return found
end

-- Offset that carries a ScreenGui's content one full screen sideways, in its own units.
local function slideDistance(gui)
	local scale = 1
	local uiScale = gui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
	if uiScale and uiScale.Scale > 0 then scale = uiScale.Scale end
	return gui.AbsoluteSize.X / scale
end

local function topLevelObjects(gui)
	local objects = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") then table.insert(objects, child) end
	end
	return objects
end

-- Mutates the LIVE panel's Position.
local function parkPanel(panel, direction)
	local gui = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
	if not gui then return end
	local home = panel.Position
	local step = slideDistance(gui) * direction
	local record = { home = home, parked = home + UDim2.fromOffset(step * PARKED_SCREENS, 0), settled = false, tween = nil }
	hidden[panel] = record
	panel:SetAttribute(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE, true)
	record.tween = TweenService:Create(panel, slideInfo(), { Position = home + UDim2.fromOffset(step, 0) })
	record.tween:Play()
	task.delay(Motion.seconds(SLIDE_SECONDS) + 0.03, function()
		if hidden[panel] ~= record then return end
		panel.Position = record.parked
		-- Kept as stored (whole pixels), so isParked compares it with itself, not a UI-scaled value.
		record.parked = panel.Position
		record.settled = true
	end)
end

local function unparkPanel(panel, direction)
	local record = hidden[panel]
	if not isParked(panel) then return end
	hidden[panel] = nil
	panel:SetAttribute(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE, nil)
	if record.tween then record.tween:Cancel() end
	local gui = panel:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("ScreenGui")
	if not gui then return end
	panel.Position = record.home + UDim2.fromOffset(slideDistance(gui) * direction, 0)
	TweenService:Create(panel, slideInfo(), { Position = record.home }):Play()
end

-- direction: -1 left, 1 right. An overlay's objects slide, then it is disabled and their
-- Positions put back; a panel is parked.
local function slideOut(gui, direction)
	if not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		parkPanel(gui, direction)
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		local objects = topLevelObjects(gui)
		local distance = slideDistance(gui) * direction
		local home = {}
		for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
			home[object] = object.Position
			TweenService:Create(object, slideInfo(), { Position = object.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(distance, 0) }):Play()
		end
		hidden[gui] = true
		task.delay(Motion.seconds(SLIDE_SECONDS) + 0.03, function()
			pcall(function()
				if hidden[gui] then gui.Enabled = false end
				for object, position in pairs(home) do
					if object.Parent then object.Position = position end
				end
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

-- An overlay is enabled with its objects off to that side, then they slide home.
local function slideIn(gui, direction)
	if not gui:IsA("ScreenGui") then
		unparkPanel(gui, direction)
		return
	end
	pcall(function()
		local objects = topLevelObjects(gui)
		local distance = slideDistance(gui) * direction
		hidden[gui] = nil
		for _, object in ipairs(objects) do
			local home = object.Position
			object.Position = home + UDim2.fromOffset(distance, 0)
			TweenService:Create(object, slideInfo(), { Position = home }):Play()
		end
		gui.Enabled = true
	end)
end

local function removeMember(gui, exceptWorkspace)
	for _, workspaceEntry in ipairs(workspaces) do
		if workspaceEntry ~= exceptWorkspace then
			local index = table.find(workspaceEntry.members, gui)
			if index then table.remove(workspaceEntry.members, index) end
		end
	end
end

local function refreshIndicator()
	if not indicator then return end
	WorkspaceBar.refresh(indicator, #workspaces, activeIndex, not barHidden, Workspaces.goTo)
end

-- In the themed repaints of every UI build (UIBuilder/init), so a theme change repaints the bar.
function Workspaces.refreshTheme()
	refreshIndicator()
end

local function captureActive()
	local showing = showingWindows()
	local current = workspaces[activeIndex]
	current.members = showing
	for _, gui in ipairs(showing) do
		hidden[gui] = nil
		removeMember(gui, current)
	end
	return showing
end

-- direction 1 moves to the right-hand screen (content exits left), -1 to the left.
local function travel(targetIndex, direction, showing)
	busy = true
	for _, gui in ipairs(showing) do
		slideOut(gui, -direction)
	end
	activeIndex = targetIndex
	for _, gui in ipairs(workspaces[targetIndex].members) do
		if gui.Parent and hidden[gui] then slideIn(gui, direction) end
	end
	refreshIndicator()
	task.delay(Motion.seconds(SLIDE_SECONDS) + 0.06, function() busy = false end)
end

-- True when none of a parked workspace's overlays is still waiting to come back.
local function isParkedEmpty(entry)
	for _, gui in ipairs(entry.members) do
		if gui.Parent and hidden[gui] then return false end
	end
	return true
end

local function otherEmptyIndex()
	for index, entry in ipairs(workspaces) do
		if index ~= activeIndex and isParkedEmpty(entry) then return index end
	end
	return nil
end

-- One empty workspace may stay behind; if another exists, the active one is dropped as it is
-- left, shifting later indexes down by one.
local function leaveFor(targetIndex, direction)
	local showing = captureActive()
	if #showing == 0 and otherEmptyIndex() then
		table.remove(workspaces, activeIndex)
		if targetIndex > activeIndex then targetIndex -= 1 end
	end
	travel(targetIndex, direction, showing)
end

function Workspaces.goTo(targetIndex)
	if busy or not enabled then return end
	if targetIndex == activeIndex or not workspaces[targetIndex] then return end
	leaveFor(targetIndex, targetIndex > activeIndex and 1 or -1)
end

-- Wraps to the first, sliding the same way; with one workspace, makes a new one.
function Workspaces.next()
	if busy or not enabled then return end
	if #workspaces < 2 then
		Workspaces.new()
		return
	end
	leaveFor(activeIndex % #workspaces + 1, 1)
end

-- Adds an empty workspace after the active one and moves to it; nothing to do when nothing is
-- showing. Another empty workspace is removed first.
function Workspaces.new()
	if busy or not enabled then return end
	local showing = captureActive()
	if #showing == 0 then return end
	local staleIndex = otherEmptyIndex()
	if staleIndex then
		table.remove(workspaces, staleIndex)
		if staleIndex < activeIndex then activeIndex -= 1 end
	end
	table.insert(workspaces, activeIndex + 1, { members = {} })
	travel(activeIndex + 1, 1, showing)
end

-- Merges the active workspace into the left one: what shows stays, the left one's overlays
-- slide in, and the emptied one is removed.
function Workspaces.mergeLeft()
	if busy or not enabled or activeIndex <= 1 then return end
	local showing = captureActive()
	local target = workspaces[activeIndex - 1]
	busy = true
	for _, gui in ipairs(target.members) do
		if gui.Parent and hidden[gui] then slideIn(gui, -1) end
	end
	for _, gui in ipairs(showing) do
		table.insert(target.members, gui)
	end
	table.remove(workspaces, activeIndex)
	activeIndex -= 1
	refreshIndicator()
	task.delay(Motion.seconds(SLIDE_SECONDS) + 0.06, function() busy = false end)
end

-- Brings an overlay hidden on another workspace here; false when this module did not hide it.
-- For this plugin's UI with no panel here, every parked panel comes, true if an open one did.
function Workspaces.bringHere(gui)
	if not gui then return false end
	if gui.Name ~= OWN_MAIN then
		if not hidden[gui] then return false end
		removeMember(gui, nil)
		slideIn(gui, 1)
		return true
	end

	local parked = {}
	local anyOpen = false
	for _, panel in ipairs(gui:GetChildren()) do
		if panel:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if isShowingPanel(panel) then return false end
			if isParked(panel) then
				table.insert(parked, panel)
				if panel.Visible then anyOpen = true end
			end
		end
	end
	for _, panel in ipairs(parked) do
		removeMember(panel, nil)
		slideIn(panel, 1)
	end
	return anyOpen
end

local function contains(object, point)
	local origin = object.AbsolutePosition
	local size = object.AbsoluteSize
	return point.X >= origin.X and point.Y >= origin.Y and point.X <= origin.X + size.X and point.Y <= origin.Y + size.Y
end

local function drawsAt(parent, point, budget)
	for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
		if budget.left <= 0 then return false end
		budget.left -= 1
		if child:IsA("GuiObject") and child.Visible then
			if drawsItself(child) and contains(child, point) then return true end
			if drawsAt(child, point, budget) then return true end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- This plugin's topmost panel at `point`, else the drawing overlay with the highest DisplayOrder.
local function windowAt(point)
	local best = nil
	for _, window in ipairs(showingWindows()) do
		if window:IsA("ScreenGui") then
			local better = best == nil or (best:IsA("ScreenGui") and window.DisplayOrder > best.DisplayOrder)
			if better and drawsAt(window, point, { left = DRAW_SCAN_LIMIT }) then best = window end
		elseif contains(window, point) then
			local better = best == nil or best:IsA("ScreenGui") or window.ZIndex >= best.ZIndex
			if better then best = window end
		end
	end
	return best
end

function Workspaces.sendHovered()
	if busy or not enabled then return end
	local window = windowAt(UserInputService:GetMouseLocation())
	if not window then return end
	if #workspaces < 2 then table.insert(workspaces, { members = {} }) end
	local target = workspaces[activeIndex % #workspaces + 1]
	busy = true
	removeMember(window, nil)
	table.insert(target.members, window)
	slideOut(window, 1)
	refreshIndicator()
	task.delay(Motion.seconds(SLIDE_SECONDS) + 0.06, function() busy = false end)
end

local function restoreAll()
	for window, record in pairs(hidden) do
		pcall(function()
			if window:IsA("ScreenGui") then
				window.Enabled = true
				return
			end
			if record.tween then record.tween:Cancel() end
			window:SetAttribute(PARKED_ATTRIBUTE, nil)
			if not record.settled or window.Position == record.parked then window.Position = record.home end
		end)
	end
	hidden = {}
	workspaces = { { members = {} } }
	activeIndex = 1
	busy = false
	refreshIndicator()
end

function Workspaces.setEnabled(on)
	enabled = on == true
	if not enabled then restoreAll() end
end

local function toggleBar()
	if not enabled then return end
	barHidden = not barHidden
	refreshIndicator()
end

-- By the names of Shortcuts/WorkspaceKeys, which the Workspace actions in Modules/Actions share.
local KEY_ACTIONS = {
	next = Workspaces.next,
	send = Workspaces.sendHovered,
	new = Workspaces.new,
	merge = Workspaces.mergeLeft,
	bar = toggleBar,
}

function Workspaces.run(name)
	local action = KEY_ACTIONS[name]
	if action then
		action()
	end
end

local function onInput(input, processed)
	if processed or not enabled then return end
	local name = WorkspaceKeys.match(input)
	if name then
		Workspaces.run(name)
	end
end

function Workspaces.start(pluginRef)
	if started then return end
	started = true
	indicator = WorkspaceBar.build()
	inputConnection = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(onInput)
	pluginRef.Unloading:Connect(Workspaces.stop)
end

function Workspaces.stop()
	if not started then return end
	started = false
	restoreAll()
	if inputConnection then
		inputConnection:Disconnect()
		inputConnection = nil
	end
	if indicator then
		indicator:Destroy()
		indicator = nil
	end
end

return Workspaces

--[[
	Populate: fills each type's Properties section from the selected items.
	(ctx) -> Populate, with populate<X>(items) per selection bucket (PropertyCatalog.SECTIONS).
	Part, Beam, PointLight and the screen types are here; the other types are in the sub-modules.
]]

local initPopulateExtra = require(script.PopulateExtra)
local initPopulateLightning = require(script.PopulateLightning)
local initPopulateCameraShake = require(script.PopulateCameraShake)
local initPopulateSound = require(script.PopulateSound)
local initPopulateRocks = require(script.PopulateRocks)
local initPopulateRope = require(script.PopulateRope)
local initPopulateDistortion = require(script.PopulateDistortion)
local initPopulateContainer = require(script.PopulateContainer)
local initPopulateMatte = require(script.PopulateMatte)
local initPopulateForce = require(script.PopulateForce)
local initPopulateReactor = require(script.PopulateReactor)
local ImageSheetSize = require(script.Parent.ImageSheetSize)
local EventsPopulate = require(script.EventsPopulate)
local setEmitType = require(script.PopulateEmitType)

return function(ctx)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local util = ctx.util

	local readProp = function(item, propName) return util.readProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName) end
	local getPEGraph = util.getPEGraph
	local Th = ctx.UIBuilder.Theme
	local _sTR = util.setToggleState; local function setToggleState(t, s) _sTR(t, s, Th) end
	local _sTM = util.setToggleMixed; local function setToggleMixed(t) _sTM(t, Th) end
	-- Toggle helpers that carry the Theme, the shape EventsPopulate needs: raw ctx.util lacks it.
	local evHelpers = { setToggleState = setToggleState, setToggleMixed = setToggleMixed }

	local refreshEvenDots = require(script.EvenDots)(Th, readProp)
	local refreshLinkAxes = require(script.LinkAxes)
	local populateLinkRows = require(script.LinkRows)
	local getInstancePath = util.getInstancePath
	local getCommonFromItems = util.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = util.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = util.setInputRange
	local setInputVec = util.setInputVec
	local populateGraphInput = util.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = util.populateColorInput

	local Populate = {}
	-- A "PreloadTexture" toggle row from the item attribute the selection shares.
	local function syncPreloadToggle(ref, items)
		if not ref or not ref.PreloadTexture or not ref.PreloadTexture.toggle then return end
		local pl, plV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("PreloadTexture") == true end)
		if plV then setToggleMixed(ref.PreloadTexture.toggle) else setToggleState(ref.PreloadTexture.toggle, pl or false) end
	end
	Populate._syncPreloadToggle = syncPreloadToggle

	local function setDropdown(ref, items, fn)
		if not ref or not ref.dropdown then return nil, false end
		local val, v = getCommonFromItems(items, fn); ref.dropdown.Text = v and "~" or (val and (typeof(val) == "EnumItem" and val.Name or tostring(val)) or "-"); return val, v
	end
	local function setAttrDropdown(ref, items, attr, default)
		if not ref or not ref.dropdown then return nil, false end
		local val, v = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute(attr) or default end); ref.dropdown.Text = v and "~" or (val or "-"); return val, v
	end

	local function getEmitParent(item)
		local ep = item:FindFirstChild("EmitParent")
		return ep and ep:IsA("ObjectValue") and ep.Value or nil
	end
	Populate.getEmitParent = getEmitParent
	local function getLink(item)
		local lk = item:FindFirstChild("Link"); return lk and lk:IsA("ObjectValue") and lk.Value or nil
	end
	Populate.getLink = getLink
	-- What Populate/LinkRows needs; shared with the sub-modules through subHelpers.
	local linkRowHelpers = { getCommonFromItems = getCommonFromItems, getInstancePath = getInstancePath, getLink = getLink, setAttrDropdown = setAttrDropdown, refreshLinkAxes = refreshLinkAxes }
	local function getAccelTarget(item)
		local at = item:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget"); return at and at:IsA("ObjectValue") and at.Value or nil
	end
	Populate.getAccelTarget = getAccelTarget
	local function getShapePart(item)
		local sp = item:FindFirstChild("ShapePart"); return sp and sp:IsA("ObjectValue") and sp.Value or nil
	end
	Populate.getShapePart = getShapePart

	-- PopulateDecals and PopulateMeshFrames wrap this, so their sections refresh with every Part fill.
	function Populate.populateParts(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Part or #items == 0 then return end
		local P = UI.Part
		for _, k in ipairs({"Speed","Transparency","Brightness","AccelStrength","Timescale","Turbulence"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if gm then if P[k] and P[k].input then P[k].input.Text = "~" end
			else populateGraphInput(P[k], gv) end
		end
		local rsRef = P.RotSpeed; if rsRef and rsRef.input then
			local primary = rsRef.getPrimary and rsRef.getPrimary()
			if primary then local rv, rm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, primary) end)
				if rm then rsRef.input.Text = "~" else populateGraphInput(rsRef, rv) end
			else rsRef.input.Text = "" end
		end
		local poRef = P.PosOffset; if poRef and poRef.input then
			local primary = poRef.getPrimary and poRef.getPrimary()
			if primary then local rv, rm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, primary) end)
				if rm then poRef.input.Text = "~" else populateGraphInput(poRef, rv) end
			else poRef.input.Text = "" end
		end
		local cv, cm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Color") end)
		if cm then
			if P.Color and P.Color.input then P.Color.input.Text = "~" end
			if P.Color and P.Color.swatch then P.Color.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1) end
		else
			populateColorInput(P.Color, cv)
		end
		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end)
		setInputRange(P.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end)
		setInputValue(P.Rate, rate, rateV)
		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if P.Enabled and P.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(P.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(P.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local eMode = setAttrDropdown(P.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(P, items)
		local isAnim = eMode == "Animate"
		if P.Enabled and P.Enabled.toggle then P.Enabled.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		if P.Rate and P.Rate.input then P.Rate.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		local aLoop, aLoopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if P.AnimateLoop and P.AnimateLoop.toggle then if aLoopV then setToggleMixed(P.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(P.AnimateLoop.toggle, aLoop or false) end; P.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = (eMode == "Animate") end
		setDropdown(P.RotMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotMode") end)
		setDropdown(P.RotOrder, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotOrder") end)
		setDropdown(P.PosMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PosMode") end)
		setDropdown(P.DisplacementMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DisplacementMode") end)
		setDropdown(P.Direction, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "EmissionDirection") end)
		setDropdown(P.Material, items, function(it) local rt = it:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate"); return rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") and rt.Material or nil end)
		local sa, saV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SpreadAngle") end)
		setInputVec(P.SpreadAngle, sa, saV, 2)
		local acc, accV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Acceleration") end)
		setInputVec(P.Acceleration, acc, accV, 3)
		local drag, dragV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Drag") end)
		setInputValue(P.Drag, drag, dragV)
		local tf, tfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TurbulenceFrequency") end)
		setInputValue(P.TurbulenceFrequency, tf, tfV)
		local cs, csV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "CastShadow") end)
		if P.CastShadow and P.CastShadow.toggle then if csV then setToggleMixed(P.CastShadow.toggle) else setToggleState(P.CastShadow.toggle, cs or false) end end
		setDropdown(P.DirMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DirMode") end)
		setDropdown(P.Orientation, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Orientation") end)
		local zo, zoV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ZOffset") end); setInputValue(P.ZOffset, zo, zoV)
		local im, imV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "InvertMotion") end)
		if P.InvertMotion and P.InvertMotion.toggle then if imV then setToggleMixed(P.InvertMotion.toggle) else setToggleState(P.InvertMotion.toggle, im or false) end end
		local poolP, poolPV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Pool") end)
		if P.Pool and P.Pool.toggle then if poolPV then setToggleMixed(P.Pool.toggle) else setToggleState(P.Pool.toggle, poolP ~= false) end end
		local fr, frV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookReverse") end)
		if P.FlipReverse and P.FlipReverse.toggle then if frV then setToggleMixed(P.FlipReverse.toggle) else setToggleState(P.FlipReverse.toggle, fr or false) end end
		-- The raw attribute: "" is None (picked by the user, and the runtime then skips the flipbook),
		-- nil is unset.
		local function readFlipText(it)
			local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(it)
			if not cfg then return nil end
			local raw = cfg:GetAttribute("FlipbookMode")
			return raw
		end
		local rawFm, rawFmV = getCommonFromItems(items, readFlipText)
		local fm, fmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookMode") end)
		local isOneShot = (not fmV) and fm == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
		-- Filled, not just shown, so a Part with other flipbook values never shows stale ones.
		if P.FlipFramerate and P.FlipFramerate.input then
			P.FlipFramerate.row.Visible = not isOneShot
			-- readProp takes the TypeData name (FlipbookFramerate), not the UI key (FlipFramerate).
			local ff, ffV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookFramerate") end)
			setInputRange(P.FlipFramerate, ff, ffV)
		end
		if P.FlipStartRandom and P.FlipStartRandom.toggle then
			local fsr, fsrV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookStartRandom") end)
			if fsrV then setToggleMixed(P.FlipStartRandom.toggle)
			else P.FlipStartRandom.toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", fsr == true) end
		end
		if P.FlipMode and P.FlipMode.dropdown then
			P.FlipMode.dropdown.Text = (fmV or rawFmV) and "~"
				or (rawFm == "" and "None")
				or (fm and fm.Name)
				or "OneShot"
		end
		local rx, rxV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotX") end)
		setInputRange(P.RotX, rx, rxV)
		local ry, ryV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotY") end)
		setInputRange(P.RotY, ry, ryV)
		local rz, rzV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotZ") end)
		setInputRange(P.RotZ, rz, rzV)
		local rec, recV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotationEvenCycle") end)
		setInputRange(P.RotationEvenCycle, rec, recV)
		local pec, pecV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PositionEvenCycle") end)
		setInputRange(P.PositionEvenCycle, pec, pecV)
		util.applyCycleVisibility(P, items, readProp)
		if P.Texture and P.Texture.input then
			if #items > 1 then P.Texture.input.Text = "~"
			else P.Texture.input.Text = readProp(items[1], "Texture") or "" end
		end
		local le, leV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "LightEmission") end)
		setInputValue(P.LightEmission, le, leV)
		local li, liV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "LightInfluence") end)
		setInputValue(P.LightInfluence, li, liV)
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end)
		setInputValue(P.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		local pl, plV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PartLife") end)
		setInputValue(P.Linger, pl, plV)
		if P.EmitParent and P.EmitParent.label then
			local ep, epM = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return getEmitParent(it) end)
			P.EmitParent.label.Text = epM and "~" or getInstancePath(ep)
		end
		populateLinkRows(P, items, linkRowHelpers)
		if P.AccelTarget and P.AccelTarget.label then
			local at, atM = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return getAccelTarget(it) end)
			P.AccelTarget.label.Text = atM and "~" or getInstancePath(at)
		end
		if P.ShapePart and P.ShapePart.label then
			local sp, spM = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return getShapePart(it) end)
			P.ShapePart.label.Text = spM and "~" or getInstancePath(sp)
		end
		if P.AccelerationTowardsInstance and P.AccelerationTowardsInstance.toggle then
			local atVal, atMulti = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "AccelerationTowardsInstance") end)
			if atMulti then setToggleMixed(P.AccelerationTowardsInstance.toggle)
			else setToggleState(P.AccelerationTowardsInstance.toggle, atVal or false) end
			if P.AccelerationTowardsInstance.fields then
				P.AccelerationTowardsInstance.fields.Visible = (not atMulti) and (atVal == true)
			end
		end
		-- UseShape is a boolean attribute that gates the shape branch in Emit.
		if P.UseShape and P.UseShape.toggle then
			local usVal, usMulti = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "UseShape") end)
			if usMulti then setToggleMixed(P.UseShape.toggle)
			else setToggleState(P.UseShape.toggle, usVal == true) end
			if P.UseShape.fields then
				P.UseShape.fields.Visible = (not usMulti) and (usVal == true)
			end
		end
		-- Shape and ShapeInOut are in the config, not on the item: setAttrDropdown would miss them.
		setDropdown(P.Shape, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Shape") end)
		setDropdown(P.ShapeInOut, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ShapeInOut") end)
		if P.ShapePartial and P.ShapePartial.input then
			local sp, spV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ShapePartial") end)
			setInputValue(P.ShapePartial, sp, spV)
		end
		if P.LookAtInitially and P.LookAtInitially.toggle then
			local laVal, laMulti = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "LookAtInitially") end)
			if laMulti then setToggleMixed(P.LookAtInitially.toggle)
			else setToggleState(P.LookAtInitially.toggle, laVal == true) end
		end
		syncPreloadToggle(P, items)
		-- Pos and Rot share one input switched by the axis pills, so a selection change or undo must
		-- refresh its text.
		if P.Rot and P.Rot.refresh then P.Rot.refresh() end
		if P.Pos and P.Pos.refresh then P.Pos.refresh() end
		if P.Size and P.Size.refresh then P.Size.refresh() end
		if P.RotSpeed and P.RotSpeed.refresh then P.RotSpeed.refresh() end
		if P.PosOffset and P.PosOffset.refresh then P.PosOffset.refresh() end
		refreshEvenDots(P, "Rot", items)
		refreshEvenDots(P, "Pos", items)
		-- The Reactor group: PopulateReactor, which shares the rows with the Reactors section.
		Populate.populateReacting(items)
		EventsPopulate.populate(P, items, evHelpers)
	end

	function Populate.populateBeams(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Beam or #items == 0 then return end
		local B = UI.Beam
		for _, k in ipairs({"Transparency","Width0","Width1","TextureSpeed","CurveSize0","CurveSize1","Brightness","LightEmission","LightInfluence","Segments","TextureLength","Timescale"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if gm then if B[k] and B[k].input then B[k].input.Text = "~" end
			else populateGraphInput(B[k], gv) end
		end
		local bcv, bcm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Color") end)
		if bcm then
			if B.Color and B.Color.input then B.Color.input.Text = "~" end
			if B.Color and B.Color.swatch then B.Color.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1) end
		else
			populateColorInput(B.Color, bcv)
		end
		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end)
		setInputRange(B.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end)
		setInputValue(B.Rate, rate, rateV)
		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if B.Enabled and B.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(B.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(B.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local beMode = setAttrDropdown(B.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(B, items)
		local bIsAnim = beMode == "Animate"
		if B.Enabled and B.Enabled.toggle then B.Enabled.row.Visible = not bIsAnim end
		if B.Rate and B.Rate.input then B.Rate.row.Visible = not bIsAnim end
		local baLoop, baLoopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if B.AnimateLoop and B.AnimateLoop.toggle then if baLoopV then setToggleMixed(B.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(B.AnimateLoop.toggle, baLoop or false) end; B.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = (beMode == "Animate") end
		if B.Texture and B.Texture.input then
			-- Beam.Texture is a native property, read from the RenderTemplate that emitted clones copy; the
			-- source Beam when there is none.
			if #items > 1 then B.Texture.input.Text = "~"
			else
				local b = items[1]
				local rt = b and b:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
				local val = (rt and rt:IsA("Beam") and rt.Texture) or (b and b.Texture) or ""
				B.Texture.input.Text = val
			end
		end
		local fc, fcV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FaceCamera") end)
		if B.FaceCamera and B.FaceCamera.toggle then if fcV then setToggleMixed(B.FaceCamera.toggle) else setToggleState(B.FaceCamera.toggle, fc or false) end end
		local poolB, poolBV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Pool") end)
		if B.Pool and B.Pool.toggle then if poolBV then setToggleMixed(B.Pool.toggle) else setToggleState(B.Pool.toggle, poolB ~= false) end end
		local zo, zoV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ZOffset") end)
		setInputValue(B.ZOffset, zo, zoV)
		local tm, tmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TextureMode") end)
		if B.TextureMode and B.TextureMode.dropdown then B.TextureMode.dropdown.Text = tmV and "~" or (tm and tm.Name or "Stretch") end
		local bfr, bfrV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookReverse") end)
		if B.FlipReverse and B.FlipReverse.toggle then if bfrV then setToggleMixed(B.FlipReverse.toggle) else setToggleState(B.FlipReverse.toggle, bfr or false) end end
		-- "" in BeamFlipbookMode is None.
		local function readBeamFlipText(it)
			local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(it)
			if not cfg then return nil end
			return cfg:GetAttribute("BeamFlipbookMode")
		end
		local rawBfm, rawBfmV = getCommonFromItems(items, readBeamFlipText)
		local bfm, bfmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookMode") end)
		local bIsOneShot = (not bfmV) and bfm == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
		if B.FlipFramerate and B.FlipFramerate.input then
			B.FlipFramerate.row.Visible = not bIsOneShot
			-- readProp resolves the TypeData name (attribute BeamFlipbookFramerate).
			local bff, bffV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookFramerate") end)
			setInputRange(B.FlipFramerate, bff, bffV)
		end
		if B.FlipStartRandom and B.FlipStartRandom.toggle then
			local bfsr, bfsrV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookStartRandom") end)
			if bfsrV then setToggleMixed(B.FlipStartRandom.toggle)
			else B.FlipStartRandom.toggle:SetAttribute("IsOn", bfsr == true) end
		end
		if B.FlipMode and B.FlipMode.dropdown then
			B.FlipMode.dropdown.Text = (bfmV or rawBfmV) and "~"
				or (rawBfm == "" and "None")
				or (bfm and bfm.Name)
				or "OneShot"
		end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end)
		setInputValue(B.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		if B.EmitParent and B.EmitParent.label then B.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1])) end
		-- Read from the RenderTemplate, which emitted clones copy; the source Beam when there is none.
		if B.Attachment0 and B.Attachment0.label then
			local b = items[1]
			local rt = b and b:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			B.Attachment0.label.Text = getInstancePath((rt and rt:IsA("Beam") and rt.Attachment0) or (b and b.Attachment0) or nil)
		end
		if B.Attachment1 and B.Attachment1.label then
			local b = items[1]
			local rt = b and b:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			B.Attachment1.label.Text = getInstancePath((rt and rt:IsA("Beam") and rt.Attachment1) or (b and b.Attachment1) or nil)
		end
		Populate.populateBlender(items)
		syncPreloadToggle(B, items)
		EventsPopulate.populate(B, items, evHelpers)
	end

	-- Populate.populateBlender is set by PopulateBlender after this module returns.

	function Populate.populatePointLights(items)
		if not UI or not UI.PointLight or #items == 0 then return end
		local PL = UI.PointLight
		setEmitType(PL, items)
		-- Angle and Face mean something only on cone lights.
		local anyCone = false
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do
			if it:IsA("SpotLight") or it:IsA("SurfaceLight") then anyCone = true break end
		end
		if PL.Angle and PL.Angle.row then PL.Angle.row.Visible = anyCone end
		if PL.Face and PL.Face.row then PL.Face.row.Visible = anyCone end
		local face, faceV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) local e = readProp(it, "Face"); return e and e.Name or "Front" end)
		if PL.Face and PL.Face.dropdown then PL.Face.dropdown.Text = faceV and "~" or (face or "Front") end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Range","Brightness","Angle","Timescale"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if gm then if PL[k] and PL[k].input then PL[k].input.Text = "~" end
			else populateGraphInput(PL[k], gv) end
		end
		local plcv, plcm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Color") end)
		if plcm then
			if PL.Color and PL.Color.input then PL.Color.input.Text = "~" end
			if PL.Color and PL.Color.swatch then PL.Color.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1) end
		else
			populateColorInput(PL.Color, plcv)
		end
		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end)
		setInputRange(PL.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end)
		setInputValue(PL.Rate, rate, rateV)
		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if PL.Enabled and PL.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(PL.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(PL.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local sh, shV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Shadows") end)
		if PL.Shadows and PL.Shadows.toggle then if shV then setToggleMixed(PL.Shadows.toggle) else setToggleState(PL.Shadows.toggle, sh or false) end end
		local poolPL, poolPLV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Pool") end)
		if PL.Pool and PL.Pool.toggle then if poolPLV then setToggleMixed(PL.Pool.toggle) else setToggleState(PL.Pool.toggle, poolPL ~= false) end end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end)
		setInputValue(PL.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		local pl, plV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PartLife") end)
		setInputValue(PL.Linger, pl, plV)
		if PL.EmitParent and PL.EmitParent.label then PL.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1])) end
		EventsPopulate.populate(PL, items, evHelpers)
	end

	-- Shared by the screen types (Blur, Bloom, CC, Atmosphere); graphKeys and colorKeys name their
	-- graph and colour properties.
	local function populateScreenCommon(ref, items, graphKeys, colorKeys)
		if not ref or #items == 0 then return end
		for _, k in ipairs(graphKeys) do
			local v, m = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if m then if ref[k] and ref[k].input then ref[k].input.Text = "~" end else populateGraphInput(ref[k], v) end
		end
		for _, k in ipairs(colorKeys or {}) do
			local v, m = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if m then
				if ref[k] and ref[k].input then ref[k].input.Text = "~" end
				if ref[k] and ref[k].swatch then ref[k].swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1) end
			else populateColorInput(ref[k], v) end
		end
		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end); setInputRange(ref.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end); setInputValue(ref.Rate, rate, rateV)
		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if ref.Enabled and ref.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(ref.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(ref.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end); setInputValue(ref.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		local pl, plV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PartLife") end); setInputValue(ref.Linger, pl, plV)
		local eMode = setAttrDropdown(ref.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(ref, items)
		local sIsAnim = (eMode == "Animate")
		-- Animate mode uses the Loop toggle instead.
		if ref.Enabled and ref.Enabled.toggle then ref.Enabled.row.Visible = not sIsAnim end
		local aLoop, aLoopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if ref.AnimateLoop and ref.AnimateLoop.toggle then if aLoopV then setToggleMixed(ref.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(ref.AnimateLoop.toggle, aLoop or false) end; ref.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = sIsAnim end
		if ref.EmitParent and ref.EmitParent.label then ref.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1])) end
	end

	function Populate.populateBlurs(items)
		populateScreenCommon(UI and UI.Blur, items, {"Size","Timescale"}, nil)
		EventsPopulate.populate(UI and UI.Blur, items, evHelpers)
	end
	function Populate.populateBlooms(items)
		populateScreenCommon(UI and UI.Bloom, items, {"Intensity","Size","Threshold","Timescale"}, nil)
		EventsPopulate.populate(UI and UI.Bloom, items, evHelpers)
	end
	function Populate.populateColorCorrections(items)
		populateScreenCommon(UI and UI.ColorCorrection, items, {"Brightness","Contrast","Saturation","Timescale"}, {"TintColor"})
		EventsPopulate.populate(UI and UI.ColorCorrection, items, evHelpers)
	end
	function Populate.populateAtmospheres(items)
		populateScreenCommon(UI and UI.Atmosphere, items, {"Density","Offset","Glare","Haze","Timescale"}, {"Color","Decay"})
		EventsPopulate.populate(UI and UI.Atmosphere, items, evHelpers)
	end

	-- ImageLabel has far more statics than the other screen types, so it is filled here in full.
	function Populate.populateImageLabels(items)
		local ref = UI and UI.ImageLabel
		if not ref or #items == 0 then return end
		-- SizeScale is an axis graph row, filled below.
		populateScreenCommon(ref, items,
			{"ImageTransparency","BackgroundTransparency","Speed","RotSpeed","Timescale"},
			{"ImageColor3","BackgroundColor3"})
		local ssRef = ref.SizeScale
		if ssRef and ssRef.input then
			local primary = ssRef.getPrimary and ssRef.getPrimary()
			if primary then
				local rv, rm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, primary) end)
				if rm then ssRef.input.Text = "~" else populateGraphInput(ssRef, rv) end
			else ssRef.input.Text = "" end
		end
		-- ScaleType and ResampleMode are in the config: setDropdown + readProp, not setAttrDropdown.
		local img, imgV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Image") end); setInputValue(ref.Image, img or "", imgV)
		-- Stamps `_SheetSize` before any emit reads it.
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do local px = readProp(it, "Image"); if px and px ~= "" then ImageSheetSize.fetchAndStamp(it, px) end end
		setDropdown(ref.ScaleType, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ScaleType") end)
		setDropdown(ref.ResampleMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ResampleMode") end)
		local pos, posV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Position") end)
		if ref.Position and ref.Position.input then ref.Position.input.Text = posV and "~" or (pos and string.format("%.4g, %d, %.4g, %d", pos.X.Scale, pos.X.Offset, pos.Y.Scale, pos.Y.Offset) or "0, 0, 0, 0") end
		local siz, sizV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Size") end)
		if ref.ImgSize and ref.ImgSize.input then ref.ImgSize.input.Text = sizV and "~" or (siz and string.format("%.4g, %d, %.4g, %d", siz.X.Scale, siz.X.Offset, siz.Y.Scale, siz.Y.Offset) or "0, 0, 0, 0") end
		local ap, apV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "AnchorPoint") end); setInputVec(ref.AnchorPoint, ap, apV, 2)
		local zi, ziV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ZIndex") end); setInputValue(ref.ZIndex, zi, ziV)
		local ea, eaV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "EmissionAngle") end); setInputValue(ref.EmissionAngle, ea, eaV)
		local sa, saV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SpreadAngle") end); setInputValue(ref.SpreadAngle, sa, saV)
		local ac, acV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Acceleration") end); setInputVec(ref.Acceleration, ac, acV, 2)
		local dr, drV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Drag") end); setInputValue(ref.Drag, dr, drV)
		local im, imV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "InvertMotion") end)
		if ref.InvertMotion and ref.InvertMotion.toggle then if imV then setToggleMixed(ref.InvertMotion.toggle) else setToggleState(ref.InvertMotion.toggle, im or false) end end
		local rr, rrV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotRange") end); setInputRange(ref.RotRange, rr, rrV)
		setDropdown(ref.RotMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotMode") end)
		setDropdown(ref.RotOrder, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotOrder") end)
		-- Source is Decals or Spritesheet; Mode is the engine's ParticleFlipbookMode.
		local srcMode = setDropdown(ref.FlipbookSource, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookSource") end)
		local imgFm, imgFmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookMode") end)
		setDropdown(ref.FlipbookMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookMode") end)
		local imgIsOneShot = (not imgFmV) and imgFm == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
		local sr, srV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookStartRandom") end)
		if ref.FlipbookStartRandom and ref.FlipbookStartRandom.toggle then if srV then setToggleMixed(ref.FlipbookStartRandom.toggle) else setToggleState(ref.FlipbookStartRandom.toggle, sr or false) end end
		local gc, gcV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "GridCols") end)
		local gr, grV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "GridRows") end)
		if ref.Grid and ref.Grid.input then
			if gcV or grV then ref.Grid.input.Text = "~"
			else ref.Grid.input.Text = string.format("%d, %d", gc or 8, gr or 8) end -- 8 rows by default, as in TypeDataScreen
		end
		local ff, ffV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookFramerate") end); setInputRange(ref.FlipbookFramerate, ff, ffV)
		local fr, frV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FlipbookReverse") end)
		if ref.FlipbookReverse and ref.FlipbookReverse.toggle then if frV then setToggleMixed(ref.FlipbookReverse.toggle) else setToggleState(ref.FlipbookReverse.toggle, fr or false) end end
		-- Grid is for a Spritesheet source only; Framerate hides for OneShot, which spreads the frames
		-- over Lifetime. A mixed selection shows the row.
		local isSpritesheet = (srcMode == "Spritesheet") or (srcMode == "-")
		if ref.Grid and ref.Grid.input then ref.Grid.row.Visible = isSpritesheet end
		if ref.FlipbookFramerate and ref.FlipbookFramerate.input then ref.FlipbookFramerate.row.Visible = not imgIsOneShot end
		syncPreloadToggle(ref, items)
		EventsPopulate.populate(ref, items, evHelpers)
	end

	-- The helpers every sub-module takes.
	local subHelpers = {
		UI = UI, readProp = readProp, getPEGraph = getPEGraph,
		getCommonFromItems = getCommonFromItems, setInputValue = setInputValue,
		setInputRange = setInputRange, setInputVec = setInputVec,
		populateGraphInput = populateGraphInput, populateColorInput = populateColorInput,
		setToggleState = setToggleState, setToggleMixed = setToggleMixed,
		setDropdown = setDropdown, setAttrDropdown = setAttrDropdown, setEmitType = setEmitType,
		getInstancePath = getInstancePath, getEmitParent = getEmitParent, getLink = getLink,
		EventsPopulate = EventsPopulate, evHelpers = evHelpers,
		refreshEvenDots = refreshEvenDots, applyCycleVisibility = util.applyCycleVisibility,
		refreshLinkAxes = refreshLinkAxes, TypeRegistry = TypeRegistry,
		populateLinkRows = populateLinkRows, linkRowHelpers = linkRowHelpers,
	}
	initPopulateExtra(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateLightning(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateCameraShake(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateSound(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateRocks(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateRope(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateDistortion(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateContainer(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateMatte(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateForce(Populate, subHelpers)
	initPopulateReactor(Populate, subHelpers)

	return Populate
end

-- Populate/EvenDots: the per-axis EvenDistribution dots. (Theme, readProp) -> refresh(typeRef, baseKey, items)
return function(Th, readProp)
	-- On or off when the selection agrees, dimmed when it does not, off when nothing is selected.
	return function(typeRef, baseKey, items)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef[baseKey]
		if not ref or not ref.evenButtons then return end
		for _, dot in pairs(ref.evenButtons) do
			local attrName = dot:GetAttribute("_evenAttr")
			if not attrName then continue end
			if #items == 0 then
				dot:SetAttribute("_even", false)
				dot.BackgroundColor3 = Th.DarkGold
				dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
				continue
			end
			local first = readProp(items[1], attrName) == true
			local mixed = false
			for i = 2, #items do
				if (readProp(items[i], attrName) == true) ~= first then mixed = true; break end
			end
			if mixed then
				dot:SetAttribute("_even", false)
				dot.BackgroundColor3 = Th.MutedGold
				dot.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5
			else
				dot:SetAttribute("_even", first)
				dot.BackgroundColor3 = first and Th.BrightGold or Th.DarkGold
				dot.BackgroundTransparency = first and 0 or 0.4
			end
		end
	end
end

--[[
	EventsPopulate: fills the Events section from the selected items' event configs.
	Values the selection disagrees on show as mixed (a striped toggle, "~").
	  EventsPopulate.populate(typeRefs, items, helpers)
]]

local EventsSchema = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.EventsSchema)
local HitFilter = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.HitFilter)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.Constants)
local T = Constants.T

local EventsPopulate = {}

local function getCommon(items, fn)
	local first
	local mixed = false
	for i, it in ipairs(items) do
		local v = fn(it)
		if i == 1 then first = v
		elseif v ~= first then mixed = true; break end
	end
	return first, mixed
end

local function pathOf(inst)
	if not inst then return "" end
	local ok, name = pcall(function() return inst:GetFullName() end)
	return ok and name or tostring(inst)
end

local function readEventState(item, eventName)
	local cfg = EventsSchema.readEvent(item, eventName)
	if not cfg then
		return {
			Enabled = false, EmitMode = "AtPosition", ScriptEnabled = false,
			ChainDepthLimit = 4, EmitTarget = nil, ImportedUntrusted = false,
			Collision = "Off", Bounciness = 0.7, Friction = 0.2, Spin = 0.5,
		}
	end
	local et = cfg:FindFirstChild("EmitTarget")
	return {
		Enabled = cfg:GetAttribute("Enabled") == true,
		EmitMode = cfg:GetAttribute("EmitMode") or "AtPosition",
		ScriptEnabled = cfg:GetAttribute("ScriptEnabled") == true,
		ChainDepthLimit = cfg:GetAttribute("ChainDepthLimit") or 4,
		EmitTarget = et and et:IsA("ObjectValue") and et.Value or nil,
		ImportedUntrusted = cfg:GetAttribute("ImportedUntrusted") == true,
		Collision = cfg:GetAttribute("Collision") or "Off",
		Bounciness = cfg:GetAttribute("Bounciness") or 0.7,
		Friction = cfg:GetAttribute("Friction") or 0.2,
		Spin = cfg:GetAttribute("Spin") or 0.5,
		HitCheckInterval = cfg:GetAttribute("HitCheckInterval") or 0,
	}
end

local function setToggleSafe(helpers, toggle, value, mixed)
	if not toggle or not helpers then return end
	if mixed then helpers.setToggleMixed(toggle)
	else helpers.setToggleState(toggle, value == true) end
end

local function populateEventBlock(eventRefs, items, eventName, helpers)
	if not eventRefs then return end
	local en, enMix = getCommon(items, function(it) return readEventState(it, eventName).Enabled end)
	if eventRefs.toggle then
		setToggleSafe(helpers, eventRefs.toggle, en, enMix)
	end
	-- An untrusted event shows its rows even when off, so Trust and Edit Script can be reached.
	local ut, utMix = getCommon(items, function(it) return readEventState(it, eventName).ImportedUntrusted end)
	local anyUntrusted = (ut == true) or utMix

	-- Shown when every item has the event on, or any item's is untrusted.
	if eventRefs.fields then
		eventRefs.fields.Visible = anyUntrusted or ((not enMix) and (en == true))
	end

	if eventRefs.UntrustedBadge then
		eventRefs.UntrustedBadge.Visible = anyUntrusted
	end
	if eventRefs.TrustScript then
		eventRefs.TrustScript.Visible = anyUntrusted
	end

	-- Filled even while hidden, so turning the event on shows this selection's values (schema
	-- defaults for items without a config).

	local mode, modeMix = getCommon(items, function(it) return readEventState(it, eventName).EmitMode end)
	if eventRefs.EmitMode and eventRefs.EmitMode.dropdown then
		eventRefs.EmitMode.dropdown.Text = modeMix and "~" or (mode or "AtPosition")
	end

	local se, seMix = getCommon(items, function(it) return readEventState(it, eventName).ScriptEnabled end)
	if eventRefs.ScriptEnabled and eventRefs.ScriptEnabled.toggle then
		setToggleSafe(helpers, eventRefs.ScriptEnabled.toggle, se, seMix)
	end

	local depth, depthMix = getCommon(items, function(it) return readEventState(it, eventName).ChainDepthLimit end)
	if eventRefs.ChainDepth and eventRefs.ChainDepth.input then
		eventRefs.ChainDepth.input.Text = depthMix and "~" or tostring(depth or 4)
	end

	-- Collision exists on OnHit only. The physics rows show only for "Bounce": Kill and Stop use none
	-- of them.
	local activeCollisionMode = nil
	if eventRefs.Collision and eventRefs.Collision.dropdown then
		local col, colMix = getCommon(items, function(it) return readEventState(it, eventName).Collision end)
		eventRefs.Collision.dropdown.Text = colMix and "~" or (col or "Off")
		activeCollisionMode = (not colMix) and col or nil
	end
	local physicsVisible = activeCollisionMode == "Bounce"
	local function setPhysicsRow(refsField, valueKey)
		local bundle = eventRefs[refsField]
		if not bundle or not bundle.input then return end
		if bundle.row then bundle.row.Visible = physicsVisible end
		local v, mix = getCommon(items, function(it) return readEventState(it, eventName)[valueKey] end)
		bundle.input.Text = mix and "~" or tostring(v)
	end
	setPhysicsRow("Bounciness", "Bounciness")
	setPhysicsRow("Friction",   "Friction")
	setPhysicsRow("SpinAttr",   "Spin")

	-- Shown with every OnHit row: the ray throttle does not depend on Collision.
	if eventRefs.HitCheckInterval and eventRefs.HitCheckInterval.input then
		eventRefs.HitCheckInterval.row.Visible = true
		local v, mix = getCommon(items, function(it) return readEventState(it, eventName).HitCheckInterval end)
		eventRefs.HitCheckInterval.input.Text = mix and "~" or tostring(v or 0)
	end

	local et, etMix = getCommon(items, function(it) return readEventState(it, eventName).EmitTarget end)
	-- Mixed "~" muted, a target by FullName bright, "(none)" muted.
	if eventRefs.EmitTarget and eventRefs.EmitTarget.label then
		local lbl = eventRefs.EmitTarget.label
		if etMix then
			lbl.Text = "~"
			lbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		elseif et then
			lbl.Text = pathOf(et)
			lbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
		else
			lbl.Text = "(none)"
			lbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		end
	end

	if eventRefs.ModeHint then
		eventRefs.ModeHint.Text = (not modeMix and EventsSchema.EMIT_MODE_HINTS[mode]) or ""
	end
	-- The picked target cannot spawn at an event origin (it emits in place instead).
	if eventRefs.ModeBadge then
		local reason = nil
		if not etMix and et and not modeMix and mode ~= "AtTarget" then
			reason = EventsSchema.emitCapabilityReason(et)
		end
		eventRefs.ModeBadge.Visible = reason ~= nil
		eventRefs.ModeBadge.Text = reason and ("Emits in place: " .. reason .. ".") or ""
	end
	-- Once the event is on: "On Death -> Sparks · AtPosition · script".
	if eventRefs.headerLabel then
		local base = eventRefs.baseLabel or eventName
		local summary = base
		if en == true and not enMix then
			local parts = {}
			if not etMix and et then table.insert(parts, et.Name) end
			if not modeMix and mode then table.insert(parts, mode) end
			if se == true and not seMix then table.insert(parts, "script") end
			if #parts > 0 then summary = base .. " \u{2192} " .. table.concat(parts, " \u{00B7} ") end
		end
		eventRefs.headerLabel.Text = summary
	end
end

-- "Group: X, N excludes", "(none)", or "~" when the selection disagrees. Also fills the Reactor
-- section's Hit Filter row (PopulateReactor).
local function populateHitFilter(hitFilter, items)
	if not hitFilter or not hitFilter.label then return end
	local lbl = hitFilter.label
	local group, groupMix = getCommon(items, function(it) local g = HitFilter.read(it) return g end)
	local count, countMix = getCommon(items, function(it) local _, excludes = HitFilter.read(it) return #excludes end)
	if groupMix or countMix then
		lbl.Text = "~"
		lbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
		return
	end
	local parts = {}
	if group and group ~= "" then table.insert(parts, "Group: " .. group) end
	if (count or 0) > 0 then table.insert(parts, tostring(count) .. " excludes") end
	if #parts == 0 then
		lbl.Text = "(none)"
		lbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
	else
		lbl.Text = table.concat(parts, ", ")
		lbl.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
	end
end

--- `helpers` must be Populate/init's { setToggleState, setToggleMixed }, which carry the Theme:
--- raw ctx.util lacks it and the toggles draw wrong.
function EventsPopulate.populate(typeRefs, items, helpers)
	if not typeRefs or not typeRefs.Events or #items == 0 then return end
	populateHitFilter(typeRefs.Events._HitFilter, items)
	for _, eventName in ipairs(EventsSchema.EVENT_NAMES) do
		populateEventBlock(typeRefs.Events[eventName], items, eventName, helpers)
	end
end

EventsPopulate.populateHitFilter = populateHitFilter

return EventsPopulate

-- Populate/LinkAxes: the per-axis link pills (LinkPosX ... LinkRotZ on the item; absent means
-- inherit). Mixed across items shows muted.
return function(typeRef, items)
	local ref = typeRef and typeRef.LinkAxes
	if not ref or not ref.buttons then return end
	for attrName in pairs(ref.buttons) do
		if #items == 0 then
			ref.setState(attrName, true)
			continue
		end
		local first = items[1]:GetAttribute(attrName) ~= false
		local mixed = false
		for i = 2, #items do
			if (items[i]:GetAttribute(attrName) ~= false) ~= first then
				mixed = true
				break
			end
		end
		if mixed then
			ref.setState(attrName, nil)
		else
			ref.setState(attrName, first)
		end
	end
end

-- Populate/LinkRows: a type's Link rows (picker, Link, Link Mode, Link Axes). The picker shows
-- what the Link source resolves to (the instance, <camera> or <none>), never a stored pick the
-- runtime ignores. An item without LinkSource reads its Link ObjectValue, as GetData does.
-- helpers = { getCommonFromItems, getInstancePath, getLink, setAttrDropdown, refreshLinkAxes }
local function linkSourceOf(item)
	local source = item:GetAttribute("LinkSource")
	if source then
		return source
	end
	local link = item:FindFirstChild("Link")
	return (link and link:IsA("ObjectValue") and link.Value) and "Object" or "None"
end

return function(typeRef, items, helpers)
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local source, sourceMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, linkSourceOf)

	if typeRef.Link and typeRef.Link.label then
		local text = "<none>"
		if sourceMixed then
			text = "~"
		elseif source == "Object" then
			local pick, pickMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, helpers.getLink)
			text = pickMixed and "~" or helpers.getInstancePath(pick)
		elseif source == "Camera" then
			text = "<camera>"
		end
		typeRef.Link.label.Text = text
	end

	helpers.setAttrDropdown(typeRef.LinkMode, items, "LinkMode", "Follow")
	helpers.refreshLinkAxes(typeRef, items)

	if typeRef.LinkSource and typeRef.LinkSource.dropdown then
		typeRef.LinkSource.dropdown.Text = sourceMixed and "~" or (source or "-")
	end
end

	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue

	function Populate.populateCameraShakes(items)
		if not UI or not UI.CameraShake or #items == 0 then return end
		local S = UI.CameraShake

		for _, k in ipairs({"ShakeAmplitude","ShakeRotAmplitude","ShakeFrequency","Timescale"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)

			else populateGraphInput(S[k], gv) end
		end

		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end)
		setInputRange(S.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end)
		setInputValue(S.Rate, rate, rateV)
		local fo, foV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ShakeFalloff") end)
		setInputValue(S.ShakeFalloff, fo, foV)
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end)
		setInputValue(S.Keyframes, kf, kfV)

		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if S.Enabled and S.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(S.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(S.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end

		local mode = setAttrDropdown(S.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(S, items)
		local isAnim = mode == "Animate"
		if S.Enabled and S.Enabled.row then S.Enabled.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		if S.Rate and S.Rate.row then S.Rate.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		local loop, loopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if S.AnimateLoop and S.AnimateLoop.toggle then
			if loopV then setToggleMixed(S.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(S.AnimateLoop.toggle, loop or false) end
			S.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = isAnim
		end

		EventsPopulate.populate(S, items, evHelpers)

end

-- Populate/PopulateContainer: (Populate, helpers) -> sets Populate.populateContainers(items).
local GRAPH_KEYS = {
	"DriveRate", "DriveScale", "DriveTimescale", "DriveBrightness",
	"DriveLightInfluence", "DriveLightEmission", "DriveTransparency",
}
-- Rows with an "Apply to" asterisk (TypeDataContainer.SKIP_ROWS).
local APPLY_ROWS = { "DriveRate", "DriveScale", "DriveTimescale", "DriveBrightness", "DriveSpread", "DriveLightInfluence", "DriveLightEmission", "DriveColor", "DriveTransparency" }
local CONFIG_NAME = "PartIcleProperties"

return function(Populate, helpers)
	local UI = helpers.UI
	local readProp = helpers.readProp
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local populateGraphInput = helpers.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = helpers.populateColorInput
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local getInstancePath = helpers.getInstancePath
	local getEmitParent = helpers.getEmitParent
	local setEmitType = helpers.setEmitType

	function Populate.populateContainers(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Container or #items == 0 then return end
		local refs = UI.Container
		setEmitType(refs, items)

		for _, key in ipairs(GRAPH_KEYS) do
			local graph, mixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			if mixed then
				if refs[key] and refs[key].input then refs[key].input.Text = "~" end
			else
				populateGraphInput(refs[key], graph)
			end
		end

		-- The graph of the selected axis pill.
		local spread = refs.DriveSpread
		if spread and spread.input then
			local primary = spread.getPrimary and spread.getPrimary()
			if primary then
				local graph, mixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, primary) end)
				if mixed then
					spread.input.Text = "~"
				else
					populateGraphInput(spread, graph)
				end
			else
				spread.input.Text = ""
			end
		end

		local lifetime, lifetimeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Lifetime") end)
		setInputRange(refs.Lifetime, lifetime, lifetimeMixed)
		local rate, rateMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Rate") end)
		setInputValue(refs.Rate, rate, rateMixed)

		local enabled, enabledMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Enabled") end)
		if refs.Enabled and refs.Enabled.toggle then
			if enabledMixed then
				setToggleMixed(refs.Enabled.toggle)
			else
				setToggleState(refs.Enabled.toggle, enabled or false)
			end
		end

		local mode, modeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Mode") end)
		if refs.Mode and refs.Mode.dropdown then
			refs.Mode.dropdown.Text = modeMixed and "~" or (mode or "Absolute")
		end

		local color, colorMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "DriveColor") end)
		if colorMixed then
			if refs.DriveColor and refs.DriveColor.input then refs.DriveColor.input.Text = "~" end
			if refs.DriveColor and refs.DriveColor.swatch then refs.DriveColor.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
		else
			populateColorInput(refs.DriveColor, color)
		end
		local colorMode, colorModeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "ColorMode") end)
		if refs.ColorMode and refs.ColorMode.dropdown then
			refs.ColorMode.dropdown.Text = colorModeMixed and "~" or (colorMode or "Recolor")
		end

		-- An asterisk reads "*" while its property reaches every kind and "-" once one is left out.
		for _, rowKey in ipairs(APPLY_ROWS) do
			local ref = refs[rowKey]
			if ref and ref.configBtn then
				local leftOut = false
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					local config = item:FindFirstChild(CONFIG_NAME)
					local skipped = config and config:GetAttribute(rowKey .. "Skip")
					if type(skipped) == "string" and skipped ~= "" then
						leftOut = true
						break
					end
				end
				ref.configBtn.Text = leftOut and "-" or "*"
			end
		end

		if refs.EmitParent and refs.EmitParent.label then
			refs.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1]))
		end
	end
end

-- Populate/PopulateDistortion: (Populate, helpers) -> sets Populate.populateDistortions(items).
-- Shows the rows of the FieldKind, as PropertyInputsDistortion does on a change; a mixed
-- selection shows every row.
local ROW_GATES = {
	Wavelength = { Ripple = true, Wave = true },
	Speed = { Ripple = true, Wave = true, Noise = true },
	Direction = { Wave = true, Noise = true },
	NoiseScale = { Noise = true },
	LensRadius = { Bulge = true, Pinch = true },
}

return function(Populate, helpers)
	local UI = helpers.UI
	local readProp = helpers.readProp
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local populateGraphInput = helpers.populateGraphInput
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local setAttrDropdown = helpers.setAttrDropdown
	local setEmitType = helpers.setEmitType
	local EventsPopulate = helpers.EventsPopulate
	local evHelpers = helpers.evHelpers

	function Populate.populateDistortions(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Distortion or #items == 0 then return end
		local D = UI.Distortion

		for _, k in ipairs({"Amplitude", "Transparency", "Timescale"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if gm then if D[k] and D[k].input then D[k].input.Text = "~" end
			else populateGraphInput(D[k], gv) end
		end

		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end)
		setInputRange(D.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		for _, k in ipairs({"Rate", "Wavelength", "Speed", "Direction", "NoiseScale", "LensRadius", "Falloff", "Strength", "Amplify", "Resolution"}) do
			local v, vV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			setInputValue(D[k], v, vV)
		end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end)
		setInputValue(D.Keyframes, kf, kfV)

		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if D.Enabled and D.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(D.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(D.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local ao, aoV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "AllowOverdrive") end)
		if D.AllowOverdrive and D.AllowOverdrive.toggle then
			if aoV then setToggleMixed(D.AllowOverdrive.toggle) else setToggleState(D.AllowOverdrive.toggle, ao == true) end
		end

		local mode = setAttrDropdown(D.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(D, items)
		local isAnim = mode == "Animate"
		if D.Enabled and D.Enabled.row then D.Enabled.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		if D.Rate and D.Rate.row then D.Rate.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		local loop, loopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if D.AnimateLoop and D.AnimateLoop.toggle then
			if loopV then setToggleMixed(D.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(D.AnimateLoop.toggle, loop or false) end
			D.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = isAnim
		end

		local fk, fkV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "FieldKind") end)
		if D.FieldKind and D.FieldKind.dropdown then D.FieldKind.dropdown.Text = fkV and "~" or (fk or "Ripple") end
		for key, kinds in pairs(ROW_GATES) do
			if D[key] and D[key].row then
				D[key].row.Visible = fkV or kinds[fk or "Ripple"] == true
			end
		end
		local em, emV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "EpicenterMode") end)
		if D.EpicenterMode and D.EpicenterMode.dropdown then D.EpicenterMode.dropdown.Text = emV and "~" or (em or "WorldPoint") end

		EventsPopulate.populate(D, items, evHelpers)
	end
end

--[[
	PopulateEmitType: the Type row (Auto / Burst) of a type's Emission section, from the item
	attribute EmitMode (absent is Auto). PropertyInputsEmitType writes it.
	  setEmitType(typeRefs, items); the row hides while every item is in Animate mode, which plays
	  the one RenderTemplate and never bursts.
]]

return function(typeRefs, items)
	local rowRef = typeRefs and typeRefs.EmitMode
	if not rowRef or not rowRef.dropdown then
		return
	end

	local shown = nil
	local allAnimate = #items > 0
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		local emitType = "Auto"
		if item:GetAttribute("EmitMode") == "Burst" then
			emitType = "Burst"
		end
		if shown == nil then
			shown = emitType
		elseif shown ~= emitType then
			shown = "~"
		end
		if item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") ~= "Animate" then
			allAnimate = false
		end
	end

	rowRef.dropdown.Text = shown or "Auto"
	if rowRef.row then
		rowRef.row.Visible = not allAnimate
	end
end
