-- Populate/PopulateExtra: (Populate, helpers) -> sets populateHighlights, populateTrailEmitters,
-- populateTrails, populateBeamNatives, populateAttachments, populateModels and populatePEs.
return function(Populate, helpers)
	local UI = helpers.UI
	local readProp = helpers.readProp
	local getPEGraph = helpers.getPEGraph
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local setInputVec = helpers.setInputVec
	local populateGraphInput = helpers.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = helpers.populateColorInput
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local setDropdown = helpers.setDropdown
	local setAttrDropdown = helpers.setAttrDropdown
	local setEmitType = helpers.setEmitType
	local getInstancePath = helpers.getInstancePath
	local getEmitParent = helpers.getEmitParent
	local getLink = helpers.getLink
	local refreshLinkAxes = helpers.refreshLinkAxes
	local EventsPopulate = helpers.EventsPopulate
	local applyCycleVisibility = helpers.applyCycleVisibility
	local evHelpers = helpers.evHelpers
	local refreshEvenDots = helpers.refreshEvenDots
	local TypeRegistry = helpers.TypeRegistry

	-- Rows that depend on EmissionMode hide when the selection has one mode.
	function Populate.populateHighlights(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Highlight or #items == 0 then return end
		local HL = UI.Highlight
		for _, k in ipairs({"FillTransparency","OutlineTransparency","Timescale"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if gm then if HL[k] and HL[k].input then HL[k].input.Text = "~" end
			else populateGraphInput(HL[k], gv) end
		end
		for _, k in ipairs({"FillColor","OutlineColor"}) do
			local cv, cm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if cm then
				if HL[k] and HL[k].input then HL[k].input.Text = "~" end
				if HL[k] and HL[k].swatch then HL[k].swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1) end
			else populateColorInput(HL[k], cv) end
		end
		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end); setInputRange(HL.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end); setInputValue(HL.Rate, rate, rateV)
		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if HL.Enabled and HL.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(HL.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(HL.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local hlMode = setAttrDropdown(HL.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(HL, items)
		local hlIsAnim = hlMode == "Animate"
		if HL.Enabled and HL.Enabled.row then HL.Enabled.row.Visible = not hlIsAnim end
		if HL.Rate and HL.Rate.row then HL.Rate.row.Visible = not hlIsAnim end
		local hlLoop, hlLoopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if HL.AnimateLoop and HL.AnimateLoop.toggle then if hlLoopV then setToggleMixed(HL.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(HL.AnimateLoop.toggle, hlLoop or false) end; HL.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = hlIsAnim end
		local pool, poolV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Pool") end)
		if HL.Pool and HL.Pool.toggle then if poolV then setToggleMixed(HL.Pool.toggle) else setToggleState(HL.Pool.toggle, pool ~= false) end end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end); setInputValue(HL.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		local pl, plV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PartLife") end); setInputValue(HL.Linger, pl, plV)
		local dm, dmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) local e = readProp(it, "DepthMode"); return e and e.Name or "AlwaysOnTop" end)
		if HL.DepthMode and HL.DepthMode.dropdown then HL.DepthMode.dropdown.Text = dmV and "~" or (dm or "AlwaysOnTop") end
		if HL.EmitParent and HL.EmitParent.label then HL.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1])) end
		local function adornee(it)
			local a = it:FindFirstChild("Adornee"); return a and a:IsA("ObjectValue") and a.Value or nil
		end
		if HL.Adornee and HL.Adornee.label then HL.Adornee.label.Text = getInstancePath(adornee(items[1])) end
		EventsPopulate.populate(HL, items, evHelpers)
	end

	function Populate.populateTrailEmitters(items)
		if not UI or not UI.TrailEmitter or #items == 0 then return end
		local TE = UI.TrailEmitter
		for _, k in ipairs({"Brightness","LightEmission","LightInfluence","TextureLength","MinLength","MaxLength","Timescale"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if gm then if TE[k] and TE[k].input then TE[k].input.Text = "~" end
			else populateGraphInput(TE[k], gv) end
		end
		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end); setInputRange(TE.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local tl, tlV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TrailLife") end); setInputRange(TE.TrailLife, tl, tlV)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end); setInputValue(TE.Rate, rate, rateV)
		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if TE.Enabled and TE.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(TE.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(TE.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local teMode = setAttrDropdown(TE.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(TE, items)
		local teIsAnim = teMode == "Animate"
		if TE.Enabled and TE.Enabled.row then TE.Enabled.row.Visible = not teIsAnim end
		if TE.Rate and TE.Rate.row then TE.Rate.row.Visible = not teIsAnim end
		local teLoop, teLoopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if TE.AnimateLoop and TE.AnimateLoop.toggle then if teLoopV then setToggleMixed(TE.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(TE.AnimateLoop.toggle, teLoop or false) end; TE.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = teIsAnim end
		local pool, poolV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Pool") end)
		if TE.Pool and TE.Pool.toggle then if poolV then setToggleMixed(TE.Pool.toggle) else setToggleState(TE.Pool.toggle, pool ~= false) end end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end); setInputValue(TE.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		local pl, plV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PartLife") end); setInputValue(TE.Linger, pl, plV)
		-- Static properties are read from each item's RenderTemplate.
		local function _rtOf(it) return it and it:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate") end
		local tex, texV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) local rt = _rtOf(it); return rt and rt.Texture or "" end); setInputValue(TE.Texture, tex, texV)
		local fc, fcV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) local rt = _rtOf(it); return rt and rt.FaceCamera or false end)
		if TE.FaceCamera and TE.FaceCamera.toggle then if fcV then setToggleMixed(TE.FaceCamera.toggle) else setToggleState(TE.FaceCamera.toggle, fc or false) end end
		local tm, tmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) local rt = _rtOf(it); return rt and rt.TextureMode and rt.TextureMode.Name or "Stretch" end)
		if TE.TextureMode and TE.TextureMode.dropdown then TE.TextureMode.dropdown.Text = tmV and "~" or (tm or "Stretch") end
		if TE.EmitParent and TE.EmitParent.label then TE.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1])) end
		-- An empty TEmitFlipbookMode attribute is the dropdown's "None".
		local fm, fmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it)
			local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(it)
			if cfg and cfg:GetAttribute("TEmitFlipbookMode") == "" then return "None" end
			local mode = readProp(it, "TrailFlipbookMode")
			return mode and mode.Name or "OneShot"
		end)
		if TE.TrailFlipbookMode and TE.TrailFlipbookMode.dropdown then TE.TrailFlipbookMode.dropdown.Text = fmV and "~" or (fm or "OneShot") end
		-- None hides every flipbook row; OneShot hides Framerate (frames spread over Lifetime), as for Parts.
		local fbNone = (not fmV) and (fm == nil or fm == "" or fm == "None")
		local fbOneShot = (not fmV) and fm == "OneShot"
		local ff, ffV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TrailFlipbookFramerate") end); setInputRange(TE.TrailFlipbookFramerate, ff, ffV)
		if TE.TrailFlipbookFramerate and TE.TrailFlipbookFramerate.row then TE.TrailFlipbookFramerate.row.Visible = not (fbNone or fbOneShot) end
		local fsr, fsrV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TrailFlipbookStartRandom") end)

		local rs, rsV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.RotSpeed end)
		setInputRange(P.RotSpeed, rs, rsV)
		local acc, accV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.Acceleration end)
		setInputVec(P.Acceleration, acc, accV, 3)
		local drag, dragV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.Drag end)
		setInputValue(P.Drag, drag, dragV)
		local ltp, ltpV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.LockedToPart end)
		if P.LockedToPart and P.LockedToPart.toggle then if ltpV then setToggleMixed(P.LockedToPart.toggle) else setToggleState(P.LockedToPart.toggle, ltp or false) end end
		local br, brV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.Brightness end)
		setInputValue(P.Brightness, br, brV)
		local le, leV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.LightEmission end)
		setInputValue(P.LightEmission, le, leV)
		local li, liV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.LightInfluence end)
		setInputValue(P.LightInfluence, li, liV)
		local zo, zoV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.ZOffset end)
		setInputValue(P.ZOffset, zo, zoV)
		local ori, oriV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.Orientation end)
		if P.Orientation and P.Orientation.dropdown then P.Orientation.dropdown.Text = oriV and "~" or (ori and ori.Name or "-") end
		-- Lock Roll means something only to an emitter facing its velocity (Part/RollLock).
		local anyPerpendicular = false
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do
			if it.Orientation == Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular then
				anyPerpendicular = true
				break
			end
		end
		if P.LockRoll and P.LockRoll.row then P.LockRoll.row.Visible = anyPerpendicular end
		local lock, lockV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("LockRoll") == true end)
		if P.LockRoll and P.LockRoll.toggle then
			if lockV then setToggleMixed(P.LockRoll.toggle) else setToggleState(P.LockRoll.toggle, lock or false) end
		end
		-- Follow Spin acts through Lock Roll: shown while a selected emitter has it on.
		local anyLocked = false
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do
			if it.Orientation == Enum.ParticleOrientation.VelocityPerpendicular and it:GetAttribute("LockRoll") == true then
				anyLocked = true
				break
			end
		end
		if P.FollowSpin and P.FollowSpin.row then P.FollowSpin.row.Visible = anyLocked end
		local spin, spinV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("FollowSpin") == true end)
		if P.FollowSpin and P.FollowSpin.toggle then
			if spinV then setToggleMixed(P.FollowSpin.toggle) else setToggleState(P.FollowSpin.toggle, spin or false) end
		end
		local shape, shapeV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.Shape end)
		if P.Shape and P.Shape.dropdown then P.Shape.dropdown.Text = shapeV and "~" or (shape and shape.Name or "-") end
		local ss, ssV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.ShapeStyle end)
		if P.ShapeStyle and P.ShapeStyle.dropdown then P.ShapeStyle.dropdown.Text = ssV and "~" or (ss and ss.Name or "-") end
		local sio, sioV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.ShapeInOut end)
		if P.ShapeInOut and P.ShapeInOut.dropdown then P.ShapeInOut.dropdown.Text = sioV and "~" or (sio and sio.Name or "-") end
		local sp, spV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.ShapePartial end)
		setInputValue(P.ShapePartial, sp, spV)
		-- Shape, Style, InOut and Hollow describe the volume of the part an emitter sits in; under an
		-- Attachment it emits from a point, so the rows show only when a selected emitter is in a part.
		local anyInPart = false
		for _, it in ipairs(items) do
			if not (it.Parent and it.Parent:IsA("Attachment")) then
				anyInPart = true
				break
			end
		end
		for _, shapeKey in ipairs({"Shape", "ShapeStyle", "ShapeInOut", "ShapePartial"}) do
			if P[shapeKey] and P[shapeKey].row then P[shapeKey].row.Visible = anyInPart end
		end
		local fm, fmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.FlipbookMode end)
		if P.FlipbookMode and P.FlipbookMode.dropdown then P.FlipbookMode.dropdown.Text = fmV and "~" or (fm and fm.Name or "-") end
		-- From FlipbookLayout: Grid2x2 / 4x4 / 8x8 give their size, Custom its FlipbookSizeX / Y, None "0, 0".
		if P.FlipbookGrid and P.FlipbookGrid.input then
			local lay, layMulti = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.FlipbookLayout end)
			if layMulti then P.FlipbookGrid.input.Text = "~"
			elseif not lay or lay == Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.None then P.FlipbookGrid.input.Text = "0, 0"
			elseif lay == Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid2x2 then P.FlipbookGrid.input.Text = "2, 2"
			elseif lay == Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid4x4 then P.FlipbookGrid.input.Text = "4, 4"
			elseif lay == Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Grid8x8 then P.FlipbookGrid.input.Text = "8, 8"
			elseif lay == Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Custom then
				local sx, sxM = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.FlipbookSizeX end)
				local sy, syM = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.FlipbookSizeY end)
				if sxM or syM then P.FlipbookGrid.input.Text = "~"
				else P.FlipbookGrid.input.Text = math.floor(sx or 1) .. ", " .. math.floor(sy or 1) end
			end
		end
		local ff, ffV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.FlipbookFramerate end)
		setInputRange(P.FlipbookFramerate, ff, ffV)
		local fsr, fsrV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.FlipbookStartRandom end)
		if P.FlipbookStartRandom and P.FlipbookStartRandom.toggle then if fsrV then setToggleMixed(P.FlipbookStartRandom.toggle) else setToggleState(P.FlipbookStartRandom.toggle, fsr or false) end end
		local fbf, fbfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.FlipbookBlendFrames end)
		if P.FlipbookBlendFrames and P.FlipbookBlendFrames.toggle then if fbfV then setToggleMixed(P.FlipbookBlendFrames.toggle) else setToggleState(P.FlipbookBlendFrames.toggle, fbf or false) end end
		local wad, wadV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.WindAffectsDrag end)
		if P.WindAffectsDrag and P.WindAffectsDrag.toggle then if wadV then setToggleMixed(P.WindAffectsDrag.toggle) else setToggleState(P.WindAffectsDrag.toggle, wad or false) end end
		local vi, viV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.VelocityInheritance end)
		setInputValue(P.VelocityInheritance, vi, viV)
		local ts, tsV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it.TimeScale end)
		setInputValue(P.TimeScale, ts, tsV)
		if Populate._syncPreloadToggle then Populate._syncPreloadToggle(P, items) end
	end
end

-- Populate/PopulateForce: (Populate, helpers) -> sets Populate.populateForces(items).
local NUMBER_KEYS = { "Rate", "Range", "Inner", "Width", "Height", "Angle", "Falloff", "TravelTime", "Lift", "Spin", "Pull", "Variation", "Turbulence", "SizeResponse", "Drag", "TurbulenceFrequency", "AfterDelay", "Pieces", "PushAlong", "PushApart", "CutNoise", "CutNoiseScale" }
local RANGE_KEYS = { "Lifetime", "PositionEvenCycle", "RotationEvenCycle" }
local GRAPH_KEYS = { "Strength", "Timescale", "Speed", "AccelStrength", "MotionTurbulence" }
-- Row key -> the property it shows, for the dropdowns of the mesh's Spawn and Motion rows.
local MODE_ROWS = { PosMode = "PosMode", RotOrder = "RotOrder", DirMode = "DirMode", DisplacementMode = "DisplacementMode", RotMode = "RotMode", MoveDirection = "MoveDirection" }
-- The axis rows: one input for the axes picked on the row, refreshed by the row itself.
local AXIS_ROWS = { "Pos", "Rot", "PosOffset", "RotSpeed" }
-- Row -> the shapes that use it. A row not listed is used by every shape.
local SHAPE_ROWS = {
	Direction = { Cone = true, Linear = true, Vortex = true },
	Width = { Linear = true },
	Height = { Linear = true, Vortex = true },
	Angle = { Cone = true },
	Spin = { Vortex = true },
	Pull = { Vortex = true },
	Cut = { Linear = true },
	PushAlong = { Linear = true },
	PushApart = { Linear = true },
	CutNoise = { Linear = true },
	CutNoiseScale = { Linear = true },
}

return function(Populate, helpers)
	local UI = helpers.UI
	local readProp = helpers.readProp
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local populateGraphInput = helpers.populateGraphInput
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local setDropdown = helpers.setDropdown
	local setEmitType = helpers.setEmitType
	local setInputVec = helpers.setInputVec
	local getInstancePath = helpers.getInstancePath
	local refreshEvenDots = helpers.refreshEvenDots
	local applyCycleVisibility = helpers.applyCycleVisibility

	-- The mesh's Spawn, Motion and Link rows (BuildPropertiesForce), filled as populateParts fills
	-- them, under the Force's keys.
	local function populateMotion(refs, items)
		for rowKey, property in pairs(MODE_ROWS) do
			setDropdown(refs[rowKey], items, function(item) return readProp(item, property) end)
		end
		local spread, spreadMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "SpreadAngle") end)
		setInputVec(refs.SpreadAngle, spread, spreadMixed, 2)
		local acceleration, accelerationMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Acceleration") end)
		setInputVec(refs.Acceleration, acceleration, accelerationMixed, 3)

		local reversed, reversedMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "InvertMotion") end)
		if refs.InvertMotion and refs.InvertMotion.toggle then
			if reversedMixed then
				setToggleMixed(refs.InvertMotion.toggle)
			else
				setToggleState(refs.InvertMotion.toggle, reversed or false)
			end
		end

		local toward = refs.AccelerationTowardsInstance
		if toward and toward.toggle then
			local on, onMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "AccelerationTowardsInstance") end)
			if onMixed then
				setToggleMixed(toward.toggle)
			else
				setToggleState(toward.toggle, on or false)
			end
			if toward.fields then
				toward.fields.Visible = (not onMixed) and on == true
			end
		end
		if refs.AccelTarget and refs.AccelTarget.label then
			local target, targetMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, Populate.getAccelTarget)
			refs.AccelTarget.label.Text = targetMixed and "~" or getInstancePath(target)
		end

		for _, rowKey in ipairs(AXIS_ROWS) do
			if refs[rowKey] and refs[rowKey].refresh then
				refs[rowKey].refresh()
			end
		end
		refreshEvenDots(refs, "Rot", items)
		refreshEvenDots(refs, "Pos", items)
		applyCycleVisibility(refs, items, readProp)
		helpers.populateLinkRows(refs, items, helpers.linkRowHelpers)
	end

	function Populate.populateForces(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Force or #items == 0 then return end
		local refs = UI.Force
		setEmitType(refs, items)

		local enabled, enabledMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Enabled") end)
		if refs.Enabled and refs.Enabled.toggle then
			if enabledMixed then
				setToggleMixed(refs.Enabled.toggle)
			else
				setToggleState(refs.Enabled.toggle, enabled or false)
			end
		end
		for _, key in ipairs(RANGE_KEYS) do
			local range, rangeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			setInputRange(refs[key], range, rangeMixed)
		end
		for _, key in ipairs(NUMBER_KEYS) do
			local value, mixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			setInputValue(refs[key], value, mixed)
		end
		for _, key in ipairs(GRAPH_KEYS) do
			local graph, graphMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			if graphMixed then
				if refs[key] and refs[key].input then refs[key].input.Text = "~" end
			else
				populateGraphInput(refs[key], graph)
			end
		end
		populateMotion(refs, items)

		local group, groupMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Group") end)
		if refs.Group and refs.Group.input then
			refs.Group.input.Text = groupMixed and "~" or (group or "")
		end
		setDropdown(refs.Direction, items, function(item) return readProp(item, "EmissionDirection") end)

		local shape, shapeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Shape") end)
		if refs.Shape and refs.Shape.dropdown then
			refs.Shape.dropdown.Text = shapeMixed and "~" or (shape or "Sphere")
		end
		local actsAs, actsAsMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "ActsAs") end)
		if refs.ActsAs and refs.ActsAs.dropdown then
			refs.ActsAs.dropdown.Text = actsAsMixed and "~" or (actsAs or "Impulse")
		end
		local after, afterMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "After") end)
		if refs.After and refs.After.dropdown then
			refs.After.dropdown.Text = afterMixed and "~" or (after or "Reactor's")
		end
		local cut, cutMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Cut") end)
		if refs.Cut and refs.Cut.dropdown then
			refs.Cut.dropdown.Text = cutMixed and "~" or (cut or "Off")
		end

		-- A row shows when the shape uses it; with several shapes selected every row shows.
		for key, shapes in pairs(SHAPE_ROWS) do
			if refs[key] and refs[key].row then
				refs[key].row.Visible = shapeMixed or shapes[shape or "Sphere"] == true
			end
		end
		-- Only a Continuous force has gusts. Lifetime always shows: it is the length of a Continuous force
		-- and of an Impulse that travels, which any Motion or Link row can make it.
		if refs.Turbulence and refs.Turbulence.row then
			refs.Turbulence.row.Visible = actsAsMixed or actsAs == "Continuous"
		end
		-- Lift angles an Impulse's kick and is a Vortex's share along its axis; no other flow uses it.
		if refs.Lift and refs.Lift.row then
			refs.Lift.row.Visible = actsAsMixed or shapeMixed or actsAs ~= "Continuous" or shape == "Vortex"
		end
	end
end

-- Populate/PopulateLightning: (Populate, helpers) -> sets Populate.populateLightnings(items).
return function(Populate, helpers)
	local UI = helpers.UI
	local readProp = helpers.readProp
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local setInputVec = helpers.setInputVec
	local populateGraphInput = helpers.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = helpers.populateColorInput
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local setDropdown = helpers.setDropdown
	local setAttrDropdown = helpers.setAttrDropdown
	local setEmitType = helpers.setEmitType
	local getInstancePath = helpers.getInstancePath
	local getEmitParent = helpers.getEmitParent
	local EventsPopulate = helpers.EventsPopulate
	local evHelpers = helpers.evHelpers
	local refreshEvenDots = helpers.refreshEvenDots
	local applyCycleVisibility = helpers.applyCycleVisibility

	-- TargetMode picks the Point / Directional rows; a mixed selection shows every row.
	function Populate.populateLightnings(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Lightning or #items == 0 then return end
		local L = UI.Lightning

		for _, k in ipairs({"Brightness","Transparency","Thickness","ThicknessProfile","Timescale","Speed","Turbulence","DiskSize","DiskTransparency","DiskBrightness"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if gm then if L[k] and L[k].input then L[k].input.Text = "~" end
			else populateGraphInput(L[k], gv) end
		end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Color", "Gradient"}) do
			local cv, cm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if cm then
				if L[k] and L[k].input then L[k].input.Text = "~" end
				if L[k] and L[k].swatch then L[k].swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1) end
			else populateColorInput(L[k], cv) end
		end

		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end); setInputRange(L.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local ln, lnV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Length") end); setInputRange(L.Length, ln, lnV)
		local sa, saV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SpreadAngle") end); setInputVec(L.SpreadAngle, sa, saV, 2)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end); setInputValue(L.Rate, rate, rateV)
		local gs, gsV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "GrowthSpeed") end)
		if typeof(gs) == "number" then gs = NumberRange.new(gs) end
		setInputRange(L.GrowthSpeed, gs, gsV)
		-- A plain number stored here reads as a range.
		for _, k in ipairs({"SegmentCount","Amplitude","AmplitudeDecay","JitterRate","ScrollSpeed","Waves","ForkChance","ForkDepth","ForkLengthScale","Sag","SagShape"}) do
			local v, vV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if typeof(v) == "number" then v = NumberRange.new(v) end
			setInputRange(L[k], v, vV)
		end

		-- A mixed selection shows every row.
		local sm, smV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ShapeMode") end)
		if L.ShapeMode and L.ShapeMode.dropdown then L.ShapeMode.dropdown.Text = smV and "~" or (sm or "Jitter") end
		local jitterOnly = not smV and (sm == nil or sm == "Jitter")
		for _, k in ipairs({"ScrollSpeed","Waves"}) do
			if L[k] and L[k].row then L[k].row.Visible = not jitterOnly end
		end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end); setInputValue(L.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		local pl, plV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PartLife") end); setInputValue(L.Linger, pl, plV)

		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if L.Enabled and L.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(L.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(L.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local pool, poolV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Pool") end)
		if L.Pool and L.Pool.toggle then if poolV then setToggleMixed(L.Pool.toggle) else setToggleState(L.Pool.toggle, pool ~= false) end end

		local mode = setAttrDropdown(L.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(L, items)
		local isAnim = mode == "Animate"
		if L.Enabled and L.Enabled.row then L.Enabled.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		if L.Rate and L.Rate.row then L.Rate.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		local loop, loopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if L.AnimateLoop and L.AnimateLoop.toggle then
			if loopV then setToggleMixed(L.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(L.AnimateLoop.toggle, loop or false) end
			L.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = isAnim
		end

		setDropdown(L.Direction, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "EmissionDirection") end)
		setDropdown(L.Material, items, function(it)
			local rt = it:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			return rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") and rt.Material or nil
		end)

		local tm, tmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TargetMode") end)
		if L.TargetMode and L.TargetMode.dropdown then L.TargetMode.dropdown.Text = tmV and "~" or (tm or "Directional") end
		local isPoint = not tmV and tm == "Point"
		local isSeek = not tmV and tm == "Seek"
		local isDir = not tmV and (tm == nil or tm == "Directional")
		if L.Target and L.Target.row then L.Target.row.Visible = tmV or isPoint end
		for _, k in ipairs({"SeekRadius","SeekRetarget","SeekBias","RetargetSpeed"}) do
			if L[k] and L[k].row then L[k].row.Visible = tmV or isSeek end
		end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Length","SpreadAngle","Direction"}) do
			if L[k] and L[k].row then L[k].row.Visible = tmV or isDir end
		end
		if L.GrowthSpeed and L.GrowthSpeed.row then L.GrowthSpeed.row.Visible = tmV or not isPoint end
		local sr, srV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SeekRadius") end)
		if typeof(sr) == "number" then sr = NumberRange.new(sr) end
		setInputRange(L.SeekRadius, sr, srV)
		local rt2, rt2V = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SeekRetarget") end)
		if L.SeekRetarget and L.SeekRetarget.toggle then
			if rt2V then setToggleMixed(L.SeekRetarget.toggle) else setToggleState(L.SeekRetarget.toggle, rt2 == true) end
		end
		setInputValue(L.SeekBias, getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SeekBias") end))
		setInputValue(L.RetargetSpeed, getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RetargetSpeed") end))

		setDropdown(L.RotOrder, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotOrder") end)
		setDropdown(L.PosMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PosMode") end)
		setDropdown(L.DirMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DirMode") end)
		local rcy, rcyV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotationEvenCycle") end)
		setInputRange(L.RotationEvenCycle, rcy, rcyV)
		local pcy, pcyV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PositionEvenCycle") end)
		setInputRange(L.PositionEvenCycle, pcy, pcyV)
		if L.Rot and L.Rot.refresh then L.Rot.refresh() end
		if L.Pos and L.Pos.refresh then L.Pos.refresh() end
		refreshEvenDots(L, "Rot", items)
		refreshEvenDots(L, "Pos", items)
		applyCycleVisibility(L, items, readProp)

		if L.PosOffset and L.PosOffset.refresh then L.PosOffset.refresh() end
		setDropdown(L.DisplacementMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DisplacementMode") end)
		local av, avV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Acceleration") end)
		setInputVec(L.Acceleration, av, avV, 3)
		local dg, dgV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Drag") end)
		setInputValue(L.Drag, dg, dgV)
		local ltf, ltfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TurbulenceFrequency") end)
		setInputValue(L.TurbulenceFrequency, ltf, ltfV)

		-- Fields shown only when UseShape is on for every item.
		local us, usV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "UseShape") end)
		if L.UseShape and L.UseShape.toggle then
			if usV then setToggleMixed(L.UseShape.toggle) else setToggleState(L.UseShape.toggle, us == true) end
			if L.UseShape.fields then L.UseShape.fields.Visible = not usV and us == true end
		end
		setDropdown(L.Shape, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Shape") end)
		setDropdown(L.ShapeInOut, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ShapeInOut") end)
		local sd, sdV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ShapeDirection") end)
		if L.ShapeDirection and L.ShapeDirection.dropdown then L.ShapeDirection.dropdown.Text = sdV and "~" or (sd or "Emitter") end
		local spv, spvV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "ShapePartial") end)
		setInputValue(L.ShapePartial, spv, spvV)
		local function shapePartOf(it)
			local sp = it:FindFirstChild("ShapePart")
			return sp and sp:IsA("ObjectValue") and sp.Value or nil
		end
		if L.ShapePart and L.ShapePart.label then L.ShapePart.label.Text = getInstancePath(shapePartOf(items[1])) end

		-- Fields shown only when DiskEnabled is on for every item.
		local de, deV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DiskEnabled") end)
		if L.DiskEnabled and L.DiskEnabled.toggle then
			if deV then setToggleMixed(L.DiskEnabled.toggle) else setToggleState(L.DiskEnabled.toggle, de == true) end
			if L.DiskEnabled.fields then L.DiskEnabled.fields.Visible = not deV and de == true end
		end
		-- Manual-only rows; a mixed selection shows every row.
		local dm, dmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DiskMode") end)
		if L.DiskMode and L.DiskMode.dropdown then L.DiskMode.dropdown.Text = dmV and "~" or (dm or "Follow") end
		local manualDisk = dmV or dm == "Manual"
		for _, k in ipairs({"DiskTransparency","DiskBrightness"}) do
			if L[k] and L[k].row then L[k].row.Visible = manualDisk end
		end
		setInputValue(L.DiskTexture, getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DiskTexture") end))
		setInputValue(L.DiskOffset, getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DiskOffset") end))

		local function targetOf(it)
			local t = it:FindFirstChild("Target")
			return t and t:IsA("ObjectValue") and t.Value or nil
		end
		if L.Target and L.Target.label then L.Target.label.Text = getInstancePath(targetOf(items[1])) end
		if L.EmitParent and L.EmitParent.label then L.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1])) end
		helpers.populateLinkRows(L, items, helpers.linkRowHelpers)
		if Populate._syncPreloadToggle then Populate._syncPreloadToggle(L, items) end
		EventsPopulate.populate(L, items, evHelpers)
	end
end

-- Populate/PopulateMatte: (Populate, helpers) -> sets Populate.populateMattes(items).
local GRAPH_KEYS = { "Brightness", "Transparency", "MaskEdgeBrightness", "FlipbookTime", "MaskFlipbookTime" }
local COLOR_KEYS = { "Color", "MaskEdgeColor" }

return function(Populate, helpers)
	local UI = helpers.UI
	local readProp = helpers.readProp
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local populateGraphInput = helpers.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = helpers.populateColorInput
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local setEmitType = helpers.setEmitType

	function Populate.populateMattes(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Matte or #items == 0 then return end
		local refs = UI.Matte
		setEmitType(refs, items)

		for _, key in ipairs(GRAPH_KEYS) do
			local graph, mixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			if mixed then
				if refs[key] and refs[key].input then refs[key].input.Text = "~" end
			else
				populateGraphInput(refs[key], graph)
			end
		end

		local lifetime, lifetimeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Lifetime") end)
		setInputRange(refs.Lifetime, lifetime, lifetimeMixed)
		local rate, rateMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Rate") end)
		setInputValue(refs.Rate, rate, rateMixed)

		local enabled, enabledMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Enabled") end)
		if refs.Enabled and refs.Enabled.toggle then
			if enabledMixed then
				setToggleMixed(refs.Enabled.toggle)
			else
				setToggleState(refs.Enabled.toggle, enabled or false)
			end
		end

		local texture, textureMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Texture") end)
		setInputValue(refs.Texture, texture or "", textureMixed)
		local scale, scaleMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "TextureScale") end)
		setInputValue(refs.TextureScale, scale, scaleMixed)
		local backFaces, backFacesMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "BackFaces") end)
		if refs.BackFaces and refs.BackFaces.dropdown then
			refs.BackFaces.dropdown.Text = backFacesMixed and "~" or (backFaces or "Auto")
		end
		local viewMode, viewModeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "ViewMode") end)
		if refs.ViewMode and refs.ViewMode.dropdown then
			refs.ViewMode.dropdown.Text = viewModeMixed and "~" or (viewMode or "Tilted")
		end

		-- The picture's flipbook and the mask's have the same four rows.
		for _, prefix in ipairs({ "Flipbook", "MaskFlipbook" }) do
			local modeKey = prefix .. "Mode"
			local mode, modeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, modeKey) end)
			if refs[modeKey] and refs[modeKey].dropdown then
				refs[modeKey].dropdown.Text = modeMixed and "~" or (mode or "OneShot")
			end
			local rateKey = prefix .. "Framerate"
			local framerate, framerateMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, rateKey) end)
			setInputRange(refs[rateKey], framerate, framerateMixed)
		end
		local maskTexture, maskTextureMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "MaskTexture") end)
		setInputValue(refs.MaskTexture, maskTexture or "", maskTextureMixed)
		local maskScale, maskScaleMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "MaskScale") end)
		setInputValue(refs.MaskScale, maskScale, maskScaleMixed)
		for _, key in ipairs({ "PictureActive", "MaskActive" }) do
			if refs[key] and refs[key].refresh then
				refs[key].refresh()
			end
		end
		for _, key in ipairs({ "FlipbookStartRandom", "FlipbookReverse", "MaskFlipbookStartRandom", "MaskFlipbookReverse", "Pool" }) do
			local on, onMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			if refs[key] and refs[key].toggle then
				if onMixed then
					setToggleMixed(refs[key].toggle)
				else
					setToggleState(refs[key].toggle, on or false)
				end
			end
		end

		for _, key in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
			local color, colorMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			if colorMixed then
				if refs[key] and refs[key].input then refs[key].input.Text = "~" end
				if refs[key] and refs[key].swatch then refs[key].swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
			else
				populateColorInput(refs[key], color)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Populate/PopulateReactor: the Reactors section, and the same rows in the Meshes section's
-- Reactor group (BuildPropertiesReactorRows.forPartIcle).
-- (Populate, helpers) -> sets Populate.populateReactors(items) and Populate.populateReacting(items).

-- The runtime (ctx.Part): cuts a selected Reactor's shards ahead.
local Particle = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part)
local ReactorPieces = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.Reactor.Pieces)
local ReactorShards = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.Reactor.Shards)
-- The Hit Filter row's summary, as the Events section fills its own.
local EventsPopulate = require(script.Parent.EventsPopulate)

-- The pattern that is cracked ground; GetDataRig.readReacting changes it for an emitted copy,
-- which is never a ground.
local GROUND_PATTERN = "Cracks"
local COPY_PATTERN = "Around hit"

return function(Populate, helpers)
	local UI = helpers.UI
	local readProp = helpers.readProp
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local getInstancePath = helpers.getInstancePath

	local function picked(item, name)
		local holder = item:FindFirstChild(name)
		if holder and holder:IsA("ObjectValue") then
			return holder.Value
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- The rows a Reactor and a reacting mesh both have: their values and which show.
	-- shownPattern(pattern) is the text the Pattern row shows for a stored pattern.
	local function fillShared(refs, items, shownPattern)
		for _, key in ipairs({ "Hold", "HoldSpread", "Pieces", "MaxPieces", "MaxAirTime", "AfterDelay", "AfterTime" }) do
			local value, mixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			setInputValue(refs[key], value, mixed)
		end
		for _, key in ipairs({ "Gravity", "Bounciness", "Friction", "TumbleSpeed" }) do
			local range, mixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			setInputRange(refs[key], range, mixed)
		end

		local group, groupMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Group") end)
		if refs.Group and refs.Group.input then
			refs.Group.input.Text = groupMixed and "~" or (group or "")
		end

		local after, afterMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "After") end)
		if refs.After and refs.After.dropdown then
			refs.After.dropdown.Text = afterMixed and "~" or (after or "Stay")
		end
		local breakMode, breakMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Break") end)
		if refs.Break and refs.Break.dropdown then
			refs.Break.dropdown.Text = breakMixed and "~" or (breakMode or "None")
		end
		local pattern, patternMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return shownPattern(readProp(item, "ShardPattern")) end)
		if refs.ShardPattern and refs.ShardPattern.dropdown then
			refs.ShardPattern.dropdown.Text = patternMixed and "~" or (pattern or "Even")
		end
		-- Pieces counts blocks as well as shards; only shards have a Pattern.
		local shards = breakMixed or breakMode == "Shards"
		if refs.Pieces and refs.Pieces.row then
			refs.Pieces.row.Visible = shards or breakMode == "Blocks"
		end
		if refs.ShardPattern and refs.ShardPattern.row then
			refs.ShardPattern.row.Visible = shards
		end

		-- Stay has no delay and takes no time.
		local timed = afterMixed or (after ~= nil and after ~= "Stay")
		for _, key in ipairs({ "AfterDelay", "AfterTime" }) do
			if refs[key] and refs[key].row then
				refs[key].row.Visible = timed
			end
		end
	end

	local function asStored(pattern)
		return pattern
	end
	local function asACopyTakesIt(pattern)
		if pattern == GROUND_PATTERN then
			return COPY_PATTERN
		end
		return pattern
	end

	-- The Meshes section's Reactor group: the switch, the rows under it while it is on (shown when
	-- the meshes differ), and the group itself, hidden while every mesh is in Animate, which never
	-- reacts. Called by populateParts on every fill.
	function Populate.populateReacting(items)
		local refs = UI and UI.Part
		local switch = refs and refs.Reacts
		if not switch or not switch.toggle or #items == 0 then return end

		local reacts, reactsMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Reacts") == true end)
		if reactsMixed then
			setToggleMixed(switch.toggle)
		else
			setToggleState(switch.toggle, reacts == true)
		end
		if switch.fields then
			switch.fields.Visible = reactsMixed or reacts == true
		end
		fillShared(refs, items, asACopyTakesIt)

		-- A reacting mesh is judged now (Reactor/Shards.judge), as a selected Reactor is, so the engine's
		-- answer is in before the first Force.
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local template = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			if template and template:IsA("BasePart") and readProp(item, "Reacts") == true then
				for _, part in ipairs(ReactorPieces.parts(template)) do
					ReactorShards.judge(part)
				end
			end
		end

		-- The group's frame, kept by BuildProperties (W.buildTypeSection's third value).
		local group = UI.MeshGroups and UI.MeshGroups.Reactor
		if group then
			local allAnimate = true
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				if item:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") ~= "Animate" then
					allAnimate = false
					break
				end
			end
			group.Visible = not allAnimate
		end
	end

	function Populate.populateReactors(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Reactor or #items == 0 then return end
		local refs = UI.Reactor

		fillShared(refs, items, asStored)
		for _, key in ipairs({ "ScatterCount", "ScatterSpacing", "ScatterSeed" }) do
			local value, mixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
			setInputValue(refs[key], value, mixed)
		end
		local size, sizeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "ScatterSize") end)
		setInputRange(refs.ScatterSize, size, sizeMixed)
		EventsPopulate.populateHitFilter(refs.HitFilter, items)

		-- Shards are cut now and again when a cut setting changes (this runs on both), so the first Force
		-- finds them ready. Nothing happens for a Reactor that does not break into shards.
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			Particle:PrepareReactor(item)
		end

		local collapse, collapseMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "Collapse") end)
		if refs.Collapse and refs.Collapse.toggle then
			if collapseMixed then
				setToggleMixed(refs.Collapse.toggle)
			else
				setToggleState(refs.Collapse.toggle, collapse ~= false)
			end
		end

		local shape, shapeMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "ScatterShape") end)
		if refs.ScatterShape and refs.ScatterShape.dropdown then
			refs.ScatterShape.dropdown.Text = shapeMixed and "~" or (shape or "Box")
		end
		local hollow, hollowMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "ScatterHollow") end)
		setInputValue(refs.ScatterHollow, hollow, hollowMixed)
		if refs.ScatterHollow and refs.ScatterHollow.row then
			refs.ScatterHollow.row.Visible = shapeMixed or shape == "Circle"
		end

		local turn, turnMixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "ScatterTurn") end)
		if refs.ScatterTurn and refs.ScatterTurn.dropdown then
			refs.ScatterTurn.dropdown.Text = turnMixed and "~" or (turn or "Upright")
		end
		-- The first selected Reactor's pick, or what Scatter.fill takes when nothing is picked.
		local unpicked = { ScatterSource = "its own parts", ScatterRegion = "around it" }
		for key, fallback in pairs(unpicked) do
			if refs[key] and refs[key].label then
				local choice = picked(items[1], key)
				if choice then
					refs[key].label.Text = getInstancePath(choice)
				else
					refs[key].label.Text = fallback
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

-- Populate/PopulateRocks: (Populate, helpers) -> sets Populate.populateRocks(items).
return function(Populate, helpers)
	local UI = helpers.UI
	local readProp = helpers.readProp
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local setInputVec = helpers.setInputVec
	local populateGraphInput = helpers.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = helpers.populateColorInput
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local setDropdown = helpers.setDropdown
	local setAttrDropdown = helpers.setAttrDropdown
	local setEmitType = helpers.setEmitType
	local getInstancePath = helpers.getInstancePath
	local getEmitParent = helpers.getEmitParent
	local EventsPopulate = helpers.EventsPopulate
	local evHelpers = helpers.evHelpers
	local refreshEvenDots = helpers.refreshEvenDots

	function Populate.populateRocks(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Rocks or #items == 0 then return end
		local R = UI.Rocks

		for _, k in ipairs({"Speed","Brightness","Transparency","Scale","Timescale"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if gm then if R[k] and R[k].input then R[k].input.Text = "~" end
			else populateGraphInput(R[k], gv) end
		end
		local cv, cm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Color") end)
		if cm then
			if R.Color and R.Color.input then R.Color.input.Text = "~" end
			if R.Color and R.Color.swatch then R.Color.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1) end
		else populateColorInput(R.Color, cv) end

		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end); setInputRange(R.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end); setInputValue(R.Rate, rate, rateV)
		local sa, saV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SpreadAngle") end); setInputVec(R.SpreadAngle, sa, saV, 2)
		for _, k in ipairs({"ChunkCount","ChunkScale","Gravity","Bounciness","Friction","TumbleSpeed"}) do
			local v, vV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if typeof(v) == "number" then v = NumberRange.new(v) end
			setInputRange(R[k], v, vV)
		end
		if R.Pos and R.Pos.refresh then R.Pos.refresh() end
		if refreshEvenDots then refreshEvenDots(R, "Pos", items) end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end); setInputValue(R.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		local pl, plV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PartLife") end); setInputValue(R.Linger, pl, plV)

		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if R.Enabled and R.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(R.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(R.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local pool, poolV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Pool") end)
		if R.Pool and R.Pool.toggle then if poolV then setToggleMixed(R.Pool.toggle) else setToggleState(R.Pool.toggle, pool ~= false) end end
		local so, soV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SinkOut") end)
		if R.SinkOut and R.SinkOut.toggle then if soV then setToggleMixed(R.SinkOut.toggle) else setToggleState(R.SinkOut.toggle, so ~= false) end end
		local ifl, iflV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "InheritFloor") end)
		if R.InheritFloor and R.InheritFloor.toggle then if iflV then setToggleMixed(R.InheritFloor.toggle) else setToggleState(R.InheritFloor.toggle, ifl == true) end end
		local hpc, hpcV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "HitPerChunk") end)
		if R.HitPerChunk and R.HitPerChunk.toggle then if hpcV then setToggleMixed(R.HitPerChunk.toggle) else setToggleState(R.HitPerChunk.toggle, hpc == true) end end

		local mode = setAttrDropdown(R.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(R, items)
		local isAnim = mode == "Animate"
		if R.Enabled and R.Enabled.row then R.Enabled.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		if R.Rate and R.Rate.row then R.Rate.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		local loop, loopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if R.AnimateLoop and R.AnimateLoop.toggle then
			if loopV then setToggleMixed(R.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(R.AnimateLoop.toggle, loop or false) end
			R.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = isAnim
		end

		setDropdown(R.Direction, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "EmissionDirection") end)
		setDropdown(R.PosMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PosMode") end)
		local bm, bmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "BurstMode") end)
		if R.BurstMode and R.BurstMode.dropdown then R.BurstMode.dropdown.Text = bmV and "~" or (bm or "Directional") end
		setDropdown(R.Material, items, function(it)
			local rt = it:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			return rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") and rt.Material or nil
		end)

		if R.EmitParent and R.EmitParent.label then R.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1])) end
		if Populate._syncPreloadToggle then Populate._syncPreloadToggle(R, items) end
		EventsPopulate.populate(R, items, evHelpers)
	end
end

	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local setInputVec = helpers.setInputVec
	local populateGraphInput = helpers.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = helpers.populateColorInput
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local setDropdown = helpers.setDropdown
	local setAttrDropdown = helpers.setAttrDropdown
	local setEmitType = helpers.setEmitType
	local getInstancePath = helpers.getInstancePath
	local getEmitParent = helpers.getEmitParent
	local EventsPopulate = helpers.EventsPopulate
	local evHelpers = helpers.evHelpers
	local refreshEvenDots = helpers.refreshEvenDots

		end
		local cv, cm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Color") end)
		if cm then
			if R.Color and R.Color.input then R.Color.input.Text = "~" end
			if R.Color and R.Color.swatch then R.Color.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1) end
		else populateColorInput(R.Color, cv) end

		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end); setInputRange(R.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		local rate, rateV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Rate") end); setInputValue(R.Rate, rate, rateV)
		for _, k in ipairs({"SegmentCount","RopeLength","WindAmplitude","LaunchSpeed","PositionEvenCycle","RotationEvenCycle"}) do
			local v, vV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if typeof(v) == "number" then v = NumberRange.new(v) end
			setInputRange(R[k], v, vV)
		end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Slack","Stiffness","Damping","WindFrequency","TurbulenceFrequency","Drag","GrowIn","DeathWindow","BendStiffness"}) do
			local v, vV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			setInputValue(R[k], v, vV)
		end
		local gv, gvV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Gravity") end); setInputVec(R.Gravity, gv, gvV, 3)
		local av, avV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Acceleration") end); setInputVec(R.Acceleration, av, avV, 3)
		local sa, saV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SpreadAngle") end); setInputVec(R.SpreadAngle, sa, saV, 2)
		if R.Pos and R.Pos.refresh then R.Pos.refresh() end
		if R.Rot and R.Rot.refresh then R.Rot.refresh() end
		if refreshEvenDots then
			refreshEvenDots(R, "Pos", items)
			refreshEvenDots(R, "Rot", items)
		end
		setDropdown(R.PosMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PosMode") end)
		setDropdown(R.RotOrder, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "RotOrder") end)
		if R.PosOffset and R.PosOffset.refresh then R.PosOffset.refresh() end
		setDropdown(R.DisplacementMode, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DisplacementMode") end)
		setDropdown(R.Direction, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "EmissionDirection") end)
		setDropdown(R.MotionDirection, items, function(it) return readProp(it, "MotionDirection") end)
		local mt, mtV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "MotionTarget") end)
		if R.MotionTarget and R.MotionTarget.dropdown then R.MotionTarget.dropdown.Text = mtV and "~" or (mt or "Start") end
		local st, stV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "SpawnTarget") end)
		if R.SpawnTarget and R.SpawnTarget.dropdown then R.SpawnTarget.dropdown.Text = stV and "~" or (st or "Start") end
		local dm, dmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "DeathMode") end)
		if R.DeathMode and R.DeathMode.dropdown then R.DeathMode.dropdown.Text = dmV and "~" or (dm or "None") end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end); setInputValue(R.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		local pl, plV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PartLife") end); setInputValue(R.Linger, pl, plV)

		local en, enV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Enabled") end)
		if R.Enabled and R.Enabled.toggle then if enV then setToggleMixed(R.Enabled.toggle) else setToggleState(R.Enabled.toggle, en or false) end end
		local pool, poolV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Pool") end)
		if R.Pool and R.Pool.toggle then if poolV then setToggleMixed(R.Pool.toggle) else setToggleState(R.Pool.toggle, pool == true) end end

		local mode = setAttrDropdown(R.EmissionMode, items, "EmissionMode", "Emit")
		setEmitType(R, items)
		local isAnim = mode == "Animate"
		if R.Enabled and R.Enabled.row then R.Enabled.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		if R.Rate and R.Rate.row then R.Rate.row.Visible = not isAnim end
		local loop, loopV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return it:GetAttribute("AnimateLoop") or false end)
		if R.AnimateLoop and R.AnimateLoop.toggle then
			if loopV then setToggleMixed(R.AnimateLoop.toggle) else setToggleState(R.AnimateLoop.toggle, loop or false) end
			R.AnimateLoop.row.Visible = isAnim
		end

		local pm, pmV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "PinMode") end)
		if R.PinMode and R.PinMode.dropdown then R.PinMode.dropdown.Text = pmV and "~" or (pm or "BothEnds") end
		local pinText = pmV and "" or (pm or "BothEnds")
		if R.Target and R.Target.row then R.Target.row.Visible = pmV or pinText == "BothEnds" or pinText == "Launch" end
		if R.LaunchSpeed and R.LaunchSpeed.row then R.LaunchSpeed.row.Visible = pmV or pinText == "Launch" end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Direction","SpreadAngle"}) do
			if R[k] and R[k].row then R[k].row.Visible = pmV or pinText ~= "BothEnds" end
		end
		if R.Target and R.Target.label then
			local tv = items[1]:FindFirstChild("Target")
			R.Target.label.Text = getInstancePath(tv and tv:IsA("ObjectValue") and tv.Value or nil)
		end
		setDropdown(R.Material, items, function(it)
			local rt = it:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			return rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") and rt.Material or nil
		end)

		if R.EmitParent and R.EmitParent.label then R.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1])) end
		if Populate._syncPreloadToggle then Populate._syncPreloadToggle(R, items) end
		EventsPopulate.populate(R, items, evHelpers)
	end
end

-- Populate/PopulateSound: (Populate, helpers) -> sets Populate.populateSounds(items).
return function(Populate, helpers)
	local UI = helpers.UI
	local readProp = helpers.readProp
	local getCommonFromItems = helpers.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputValue = helpers.setInputValue
	local setInputRange = helpers.setInputRange
	local populateGraphInput = helpers.populateGraphInput
	local setToggleState = helpers.setToggleState
	local setToggleMixed = helpers.setToggleMixed
	local getInstancePath = helpers.getInstancePath
	local getEmitParent = helpers.getEmitParent
	local EventsPopulate = helpers.EventsPopulate
	local evHelpers = helpers.evHelpers
	local setEmitType = helpers.setEmitType

	local function populateToggle(ref, items, key)
		if not ref or not ref.toggle then return end
		local value, mixed = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, key) end)
		if mixed then setToggleMixed(ref.toggle) else setToggleState(ref.toggle, value == true) end
	end

	function Populate.populateSounds(items)
		if not UI or not UI.Sound or #items == 0 then return end
		local SND = UI.Sound
		setEmitType(SND, items)

		for _, k in ipairs({"Volume", "PlaybackSpeed", "Timescale"}) do
			local gv, gm = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, k) end)
			if gm then if SND[k] and SND[k].input then SND[k].input.Text = "~" end
			else populateGraphInput(SND[k], gv) end
		end

		local lt, ltV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "Lifetime") end)
		setInputRange(SND.Lifetime, lt, ltV)
		for _, key in ipairs({"Rate", "StartOffset", "RollOffMin", "RollOffMax"}) do
			local v, vV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, key) end)
			setInputValue(SND[key], v, vV)
		end
		local kf, kfV = getCommonFromItems(items, function(it) return readProp(it, "TotalKeyFrames") end)
		setInputValue(SND.Keyframes, kf, kfV)
		populateToggle(SND.Enabled, items, "Enabled")
		populateToggle(SND.Looped, items, "Looped")
		populateToggle(SND.Local2D, items, "Local2D")
		if SND.EmitParent and SND.EmitParent.label then SND.EmitParent.label.Text = getInstancePath(getEmitParent(items[1])) end

		EventsPopulate.populate(SND, items, evHelpers)
	end
end
