--[[
	PopulateBlender: the Blender's state list (the GraphBlender folder of a Beam or Trail).
	(ctx, Populate) -> sets Populate.populateBlender(beams, opts) and Populate.populateTrailBlender(trails).
]]

local ClipSlots = require(script.Parent.Modules.ClipSlots)

return function(ctx, Populate)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local util = ctx.util
	local populateGraphInput = util.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = util.populateColorInput
	local parseRGB = util.parseRGB
	local color3ToRGB = util.color3ToRGB

	Populate.populateBlender = function(beams, opts)
		opts = opts or {}
		local includeWidth = opts.includeWidth == true
		local stateList = opts.stateListRef or (UI and UI.BlenderStateList)
		if not UI or not stateList then return end
		-- The swatches the hue preview refreshes: a Beam fill starts the list, a Trail fill adds to it.
		if not opts.appendColorRefs or UI._blenderColorRefs == nil then
			UI._blenderColorRefs = {}
		end
		for _, child in ipairs(stateList:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		if not beams then return end
		if type(beams) ~= "table" or beams.Name then beams = {beams} end
		if #beams == 0 then return end
		local beam = beams[1]
		-- The Clipboard and Shifter list as many states as the selection has (ClipSlots).
		if ctx.refreshClipShifterSlots then ctx.refreshClipShifterSlots() end
		local gb = beam:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
		if not gb then return end
		-- Every selected item's state config of that name.
		local function forAllConfigs(cfgName, fn)
			for _, b in ipairs(beams) do
				local g = b:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender"); if not g then continue end
				local c = g:FindFirstChild(cfgName); if c then fn(c) end
			end
		end
		-- In the order the Clipboard lists them too (ClipSlots): its State 3 is this box's State 3.
		local states = {}
		for _, child in ipairs(ClipSlots.statesOf(beam)) do
			table.insert(states, {config = child, time = child:GetAttribute("Time") or 0, index = tonumber(child.Name) or 0})
		end

		local T = UIBuilder.Theme
		-- addStroke registers strokes for theme refresh.
		local Widgets = require(script.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.Widgets)
		local addCorner = Widgets.addCorner
		local addStroke = Widgets.addStroke
		local addList = function(p, pad) local l = Instance.new("UIListLayout"); l.Padding = UDim.new(0, pad or 3); l.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder; l.Parent = p end
		local addPad = function(p, l, r, t, b) local pd = Instance.new("UIPadding"); pd.PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0,l); pd.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0,r); pd.PaddingTop = UDim.new(0,t); pd.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0,b); pd.Parent = p end
		local LABEL_W = 78
		local CONTENT_OFF = 82
		local ROW_H = 22

		local function buildGraphRow(parent, labelText, order)
			local rowFrame = Instance.new("Frame"); rowFrame.Name = labelText:gsub("%s+","").."Row"
			rowFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1; rowFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,ROW_H); rowFrame.LayoutOrder = order; rowFrame.Parent = parent
			local lb = Instance.new("Frame"); lb.Name = "LabelBlob"; lb.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; lb.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			lb.BorderSizePixel = 0; lb.Size = UDim2.new(0,LABEL_W,1,0); lb.Parent = rowFrame; addCorner(lb); addStroke(lb)
			local ll = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ll.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ll.Text = labelText; ll.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			ll.Font = T.Font; ll.TextSize = 10; ll.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; ll.Size = UDim2.new(1,-6,1,0); ll.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); ll.Parent = lb
			local blob = Instance.new("Frame"); blob.Name = "GraphBlob"; blob.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; blob.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			blob.BorderSizePixel = 0; blob.Size = UDim2.new(1,-CONTENT_OFF,1,0); blob.Position = UDim2.new(0,CONTENT_OFF,0,0); blob.Parent = rowFrame; addCorner(blob); addStroke(blob)
			local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.Name = "Input"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tb.Text = "0"
			tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 11
			tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false
			-- The "more" button leads, as in Widgets.makeGraphRow.
			tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-22,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,18,0,0); tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = blob
			local dotsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); dotsBtn.Name = "DotsBtn"; dotsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			dotsBtn.Text = "\u{22EF}"; dotsBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; dotsBtn.TextTransparency = 0.3; dotsBtn.Font = T.Font; dotsBtn.TextSize = 14
			dotsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,18,1,0); dotsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,0,0,0); dotsBtn.ZIndex = 3; dotsBtn.Parent = blob
			return {input = tb, dotsBtn = dotsBtn, frame = blob}
		end

		local function buildColorRow(parent, labelText, order)
			local rowFrame = Instance.new("Frame"); rowFrame.Name = labelText:gsub("%s+","").."Row"
			rowFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1; rowFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,ROW_H); rowFrame.LayoutOrder = order; rowFrame.Parent = parent
			local lb = Instance.new("Frame"); lb.Name = "LabelBlob"; lb.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; lb.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			lb.BorderSizePixel = 0; lb.Size = UDim2.new(0,LABEL_W,1,0); lb.Parent = rowFrame; addCorner(lb); addStroke(lb)
			local ll = Instance.new("TextLabel"); ll.BackgroundTransparency = 1; ll.Text = labelText; ll.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			ll.Font = T.Font; ll.TextSize = 10; ll.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; ll.Size = UDim2.new(1,-6,1,0); ll.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); ll.Parent = lb
			local blob = Instance.new("Frame"); blob.Name = "ColorBlob"; blob.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; blob.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			blob.BorderSizePixel = 0; blob.Size = UDim2.new(1,-CONTENT_OFF,1,0); blob.Position = UDim2.new(0,CONTENT_OFF,0,0); blob.Parent = rowFrame; addCorner(blob); addStroke(blob)
			local swatch = Instance.new("Frame"); swatch.Name = "Swatch"; swatch.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1,1,1); swatch.BorderSizePixel = 0
			swatch.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,0,14); swatch.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0.5,-7); swatch.ZIndex = 2; swatch.Parent = blob; addCorner(swatch, UDim.new(0,3))
			-- A user colour: the theme's recolouring pass leaves it alone.
			swatch:SetAttribute("_noColorRemap", true)
			local swatchBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); swatchBtn.Name = "SwatchBtn"; swatchBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			swatchBtn.Text = ""; swatchBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,0,14); swatchBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0.5,-7); swatchBtn.ZIndex = 3; swatchBtn.Parent = blob
			local tb = Instance.new("TextBox"); tb.Name = "Input"; tb.BackgroundTransparency = 1; tb.Text = "255, 255, 255"
			tb.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold; tb.PlaceholderColor3 = T.DarkGold; tb.Font = T.Font; tb.TextSize = 11
			tb.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; tb.ClearTextOnFocus = false
			tb.Size = UDim2.new(1,-40,1,0); tb.Position = UDim2.new(0,22,0,0); tb.BorderSizePixel = 0; tb.Parent = blob
			local dotsBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); dotsBtn.Name = "DotsBtn"; dotsBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			dotsBtn.Text = "\u{22EF}"; dotsBtn.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; dotsBtn.TextTransparency = 0.3; dotsBtn.Font = T.Font; dotsBtn.TextSize = 14
			dotsBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,18,1,0); dotsBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-18,0,0); dotsBtn.ZIndex = 3; dotsBtn.Parent = blob
			return {swatch = swatch, swatchBtn = swatchBtn, input = tb, dotsBtn = dotsBtn, frame = blob}
		end

		-- Edits reach states by name: when the selected items' states differ, only the first item is
		-- edited and a banner says to select one item to edit the others.
		local hasMismatch = false
		if #beams > 1 then
			for bi = 2, #beams do
				local og = beams[bi]:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
				if not og then hasMismatch = true; break end
				local cnt = 0
				for _, c in ipairs(og:GetChildren()) do
					if c:IsA("Configuration") then
						cnt = cnt + 1
						if not gb:FindFirstChild(c.Name) then hasMismatch = true; break end
					end
				end
				if hasMismatch then break end
				if cnt ~= #states then hasMismatch = true; break end
			end
		end
		if hasMismatch then
			beams = {beams[1]}
			local banner = Instance.new("Frame")
			banner.Name = "MismatchBanner"
			banner.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg
			banner.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			banner.BorderSizePixel = 0
			banner.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)
			banner.LayoutOrder = -1
			banner.Parent = stateList
			addCorner(banner); addStroke(banner)
			local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			lbl.Text = "Mixed blender states  -  editing first beam only"
			lbl.TextColor3 = T.MutedGold
			lbl.Font = T.Font
			lbl.TextSize = 9
			lbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
			lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 1, 0)
			lbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0)
			lbl.Parent = banner
		end

		for i, state in ipairs(states) do
			local cfg = state.config
			local section = Instance.new("Frame"); section.Name = "State"..i.."Section"
			section.BackgroundTransparency = 1; section.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0)
			section.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; section.LayoutOrder = i; section.Parent = stateList
			addList(section, 0)
			local head = Instance.new("Frame"); head.Name = "Header"; head.BackgroundColor3 = T.BlobBg; head.BackgroundTransparency = T.BlobAlpha
			head.BorderSizePixel = 0; head.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,22); head.LayoutOrder = 0; head.Parent = section
			addCorner(head); addStroke(head)
			local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel"); arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; arrow.Text = "\u{25BC}"
			arrow.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; arrow.Font = T.Font; arrow.TextSize = 8
			arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0,14,1,0); arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0,4,0,0); arrow.Parent = head
			local titleLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); titleLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			titleLbl.Text = "State " .. i; titleLbl.TextColor3 = T.Gold; titleLbl.Font = T.Font; titleLbl.TextSize = 10
			titleLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; titleLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0,50,1,0); titleLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0,18,0,0); titleLbl.Parent = head
			local timeLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel"); timeLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1; timeLbl.Text = "Time:"
			timeLbl.TextColor3 = T.DarkGold; timeLbl.Font = T.Font; timeLbl.TextSize = 8
			timeLbl.Size = UDim2.new(0,26,1,0); timeLbl.Position = UDim2.new(1,-76,0,0); timeLbl.Parent = head
			local timeBox = Instance.new("TextBox"); timeBox.Name = "TimeBox"; timeBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			timeBox.Text = string.format("%.2f", state.time); timeBox.TextColor3 = T.BrightGold
			timeBox.Font = T.Font; timeBox.TextSize = 9; timeBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
			timeBox.Size = UDim2.new(0,32,1,0); timeBox.Position = UDim2.new(1,-50,0,0)
			timeBox.BorderSizePixel = 0; timeBox.Parent = head
			-- A failed parse restores the saved text.
			local timeSaved = timeBox.Text
			timeBox.Focused:Connect(function() timeSaved = timeBox.Text end)
			timeBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(timeBox.Text)
				if not n then
					timeBox.Text = timeSaved; util.flashInvalid(timeBox); return
				end
				-- Out of range flashes instead of clamping silently.
				if n < 0 or n > 1 then
					timeBox.Text = timeSaved; util.flashInvalid(timeBox); return
				end
				-- Two states at one Time blend ambiguously, so the edit is refused (within 0.001: shown as %.2f).
				for _, beam in ipairs(beams) do
					local g = beam:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender")
					if g then
						for _, c in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
							if c:IsA("Configuration") and c.Name ~= cfg.Name then
								local ot = c:GetAttribute("Time")
								if ot and math.abs(ot - n) < 0.001 then
									timeBox.Text = timeSaved; util.flashInvalid(timeBox); return
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Time")
				forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c)
					c:SetAttribute("Time", n)
					c:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", nil) -- set by hand: Add State no longer places it at the midpoint
				end)
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Time")
			end)
			-- State 1 (the first by Time) is never deleted, so the list never empties.
			local canDelete = (i > 1) and (#states > 1)
			local delBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); delBtn.Name = "Del"; delBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			delBtn.Text = "\u{00D7}"; delBtn.TextColor3 = canDelete and T.Red or T.DarkGold
			delBtn.Font = T.Font; delBtn.TextSize = 14; delBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0,16,1,0)
			delBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1,-18,0,0); delBtn.ZIndex = 3; delBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0; delBtn.Parent = head
			if canDelete then
				delBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Remove Blender State")
					-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
					forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c.Parent = nil end)
					for _, beam in ipairs(beams) do util.renumberBlenderStates(beam) end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Remove Blender State")
					-- opts again, so a Trail refills its own list.
					Populate.populateBlender(beams, opts)
				end)
			end
			local body = Instance.new("Frame"); body.Name = "Body"; body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			body.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,0); body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			body.LayoutOrder = 1; body.Parent = section
			addList(body, 3); addPad(body, 4, 4, 4, 4)
			local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton"); toggleBtn.Name = "Toggle"; toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			toggleBtn.Text = ""; toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1,-36,1,0); toggleBtn.Parent = head
			toggleBtn.Activated:Connect(function() body.Visible = not body.Visible; arrow.Text = body.Visible and "\u{25BC}" or "\u{25B6}" end)

			-- Wired even without a Transparency attribute: it defaults to an empty sequence.
			local transRefs = buildGraphRow(body, "Transparency", 1)
			local curTrans = cfg:GetAttribute("Transparency")
			if curTrans then populateGraphInput(transRefs, curTrans) end
			do
				transRefs.dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
					if not ctx.graphEditor then return end
					local seq = cfg:GetAttribute("Transparency")
					if typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then seq = NumberSequence.new(0) end
					ctx.graphEditor:Open(seq, "Blender Trans #"..i, function(newSeq)
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Trans Edit")
						forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Transparency", newSeq) end)
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Trans Edit")
						populateGraphInput(transRefs, newSeq)
					end, function(prevSeq) forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Transparency", prevSeq) end) end)
				end)
				local transSaved = transRefs.input.Text
				transRefs.input.Focused:Connect(function()
					transSaved = transRefs.input.Text
					if transRefs.input.Text == "<NumberSequence>" then transRefs.input.Text = "" end
				end)
				transRefs.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
					local txt = transRefs.input.Text
					if txt == "" or txt == "<NumberSequence>" then transRefs.input.Text = transSaved; return end
					local n = tonumber(txt); if n == nil then transRefs.input.Text = transSaved; return end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Trans Inline")
					forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Transparency", NumberSequence.new(n)) end)
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Trans Inline")
					transRefs.input.Text = string.format("%.4g", n)
				end)
			end

			-- Trail blender only.
			if includeWidth then
				local widthRefs = buildGraphRow(body, "Width", 0)
				local curWidth = cfg:GetAttribute("Width")
				if curWidth then populateGraphInput(widthRefs, curWidth) end
				widthRefs.dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
					if not ctx.graphEditor then return end
					local seq = cfg:GetAttribute("Width")
					if typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then seq = NumberSequence.new(1) end
					ctx.graphEditor:Open(seq, "Blender Width #"..i, function(newSeq)
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Width Edit")
						forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Width", newSeq) end)
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Width Edit")
						populateGraphInput(widthRefs, newSeq)
					end, function(prevSeq) forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Width", prevSeq) end) end)
				end)
				local widthSaved = widthRefs.input.Text
				widthRefs.input.Focused:Connect(function()
					widthSaved = widthRefs.input.Text
					if widthRefs.input.Text == "<NumberSequence>" then widthRefs.input.Text = "" end
				end)
				widthRefs.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
					local txt = widthRefs.input.Text
					if txt == "" or txt == "<NumberSequence>" then widthRefs.input.Text = widthSaved; return end
					local n = tonumber(txt); if n == nil then widthRefs.input.Text = widthSaved; return end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Width Inline")
					forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Width", NumberSequence.new(n)) end)
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Width Inline")
					widthRefs.input.Text = string.format("%.4g", n)
				end)
			end

			-- States 2 and up: the ease of the blend into this state; absent is linear.
			if i > 1 then
				local transitionRefs = buildGraphRow(body, "Transition", 3)
				local function showTransition(seq)
					if typeof(seq) == "NumberSequence" then populateGraphInput(transitionRefs, seq) else transitionRefs.input.Text = "linear" end
				end
				showTransition(cfg:GetAttribute("Transition"))
				transitionRefs.dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
					if not ctx.graphEditor then return end
					local seq = cfg:GetAttribute("Transition")
					if typeof(seq) ~= "NumberSequence" then
						seq = NumberSequence.new({ NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1) })
					end
					ctx.graphEditor:Open(seq, "Blender Transition #"..i, function(newSeq)
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Transition Edit")
						forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Transition", newSeq) end)
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Transition Edit")
						showTransition(newSeq)
					end, function(prevSeq) forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Transition", prevSeq) end) end)
				end)
				-- Only "linear" (which clears the ease) is accepted as text.
				transitionRefs.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
					local txt = string.lower(transitionRefs.input.Text)
					if txt == "linear" or txt == "none" then
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Transition Clear")
						forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Transition", nil) end)
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Transition Clear")
					end
					showTransition(cfg:GetAttribute("Transition"))
				end)
			end

			-- Wired even without a Color attribute: it defaults to a plain ColorSequence.
			local colorRefs = buildColorRow(body, "Color", 2)
			local curColor = cfg:GetAttribute("Color")
			table.insert(UI._blenderColorRefs, {refs = colorRefs, config = cfg})
			if curColor then populateColorInput(colorRefs, curColor) end
			do
				colorRefs.dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
					if not ctx.colorGradientEditor then return end
					local cs = cfg:GetAttribute("Color")
					if typeof(cs) ~= "ColorSequence" then cs = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)) end
					local pos = nil
					if UI and UI.ScreenGui then
						local absPos = colorRefs.dotsBtn.AbsolutePosition
						local uiScale = UI.ScreenGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
						local scale = uiScale and uiScale.Scale or 1
						local x = (absPos.X - 288) / scale; local y = absPos.Y / scale
						local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1920, 1080)
						x = math.max(4, x); y = math.clamp(y, 4, vp.Y / scale - 170)
						pos = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
					end
					ctx.colorGradientEditor:Open(cs, "Blender Color #"..i, function(newCS)
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Color Edit")
						forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Color", newCS) end)
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Color Edit")
						populateColorInput(colorRefs, newCS)
					end, function(prevCS) forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Color", prevCS) end) end, pos, {
						items = beams, live = #beams, anchor = colorRefs.dotsBtn, title = "State " .. i .. " color",
					})
				end)
				local colorSaved = colorRefs.input.Text
				colorRefs.input.Focused:Connect(function()
					colorSaved = colorRefs.input.Text
					if colorRefs.input.Text == "<ColorSequence>" then colorRefs.input.Text = "" end
				end)
				colorRefs.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
					local txt = colorRefs.input.Text
					if txt == "" or txt == "<ColorSequence>" then colorRefs.input.Text = colorSaved; return end
					local color = parseRGB(txt); if not color then colorRefs.input.Text = colorSaved; return end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Color Inline")
					forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) c:SetAttribute("Color", ColorSequence.new(color)) end)
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Color Inline")
					colorRefs.input.Text = color3ToRGB(color); colorRefs.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = color
				end)
				colorRefs.swatchBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
					if not ctx.colorPicker then return end
					local cs = cfg:GetAttribute("Color")
					if typeof(cs) ~= "ColorSequence" then cs = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)) end
					local preCS = cs; local firstColor = cs.Keypoints[1].Value
					ctx.colorPicker:SetOnColorChanged(function(newColor)
						forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) pcall(function() c:SetAttribute("Color", ColorSequence.new(newColor)) end) end)
						colorRefs.swatch.BackgroundColor3 = newColor; colorRefs.input.Text = color3ToRGB(newColor)
					end)
					ctx.colorPicker:SetOnOK(function() ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Color Pick") end)
					ctx.colorPicker:SetOnCancel(function()
						forAllConfigs(cfg.Name, function(c) pcall(function() c:SetAttribute("Color", preCS) end) end); populateColorInput(colorRefs, preCS)
						-- Closes the "Before" waypoint, so the undo stack stays balanced (as Connectors.cColorSwatch).
						ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Blender Color Cancelled")
					end)
					-- Before Open, so the drag writes sit inside one undo step.
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Blender Color Pick")
					ctx.colorPicker:Open(firstColor, "State " .. i .. " color", nil, {
						items = beams, live = #beams, anchor = colorRefs.swatchBtn,
						classicTitle = "Blender Color #" .. i,
					})
				end)
			end
		end
	end

	-- The Trail's own state list, with a Width row; its colour refs add to the Beam's.
	Populate.populateTrailBlender = function(trails)
		Populate.populateBlender(trails, {
			stateListRef = UI and UI.TrailBlenderStateList,
			includeWidth = true,
			appendColorRefs = true,
		})
	end
end

--[[
	PopulateDecals: the Decals section, one entry per decal layer on the selected Parts'
	RenderTemplate (runtime: Part/DecalLayers; settings are Layer* attributes on each decal).
	(ctx, Populate, C) -> wraps Populate.populateParts so the list rebuilds with every Part fill, and
	sets Populate.populateDecals(items).
	Edits reach the same-named decal on every selected item; a layer's Bezier handles are on its
	decal. LayerActive marks an Inventory insert target (InventoryFlipbookDetail reads it).
	Every layer's rows share their keys (LayerColor ...), so each row carries editorTitle for its
	editors' titles, and a layer's refs table is kept while the same items are listed: an editor
	opened from a row reaches the row in the panel now (Connectors reads typeRef[key] when it runs).
]]

local ClipSlots = require(script.Parent.Modules.ClipSlots)

return function(ctx, Populate, C)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Theme = ctx.UIBuilder.Theme
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local Migrate = ctx.Migrate
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local util = ctx.util
	local Widgets = require(script.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.Widgets)

	local FLIP_MODES = { "Inherit", "OneShot", "Loop", "PingPong", "None" }

	-- In the order the Clipboard lists them too (ClipSlots): its Layer 2 is this list's #2.
	local function decalsOf(item)
		return ClipSlots.slotsOf("Decal", item)
	end

	local function decalNamed(item, name)
		for _, decal in ipairs(decalsOf(item)) do
			if decal.Name == name then return decal end
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function forAllDecals(items, name, fn)
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local decal = decalNamed(item, name)
			if decal then fn(decal) end
		end
	end

	-- The flipbook choices: sub-folders of the first item's MeshFlipbooks.
	local function flipbookNames(item)
		local names = {}
		local folder = item:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks")
		if folder then
			for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Folder") then table.insert(names, child.Name) end
			end
		end
		table.sort(names)
		return names
	end

	local function uniqueDecalName(items)
		local n = 0
		while true do
			n += 1
			local candidate = n == 1 and "Decal" or ("Decal" .. n)
			local taken = false
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				if decalNamed(item, candidate) then taken = true; break end
			end
			if not taken then return candidate end
		end
	end

	-- Unset means 0, the authored Color3 or 1, as the runtime reads it; the Clipboard copies the same.
	local function layerValue(decal, key)
		return ClipSlots.shown("Decal", decal, key)
	end

	local function layerGetter(name)
		return function(item, key)
			local decal = decalNamed(item, name)
			return decal and layerValue(decal, key) or nil
		end
	end
	local function layerSetter(name)
		return function(item, key, value)
			local decal = decalNamed(item, name)
			if decal then decal:SetAttribute(key, value) end
		end
	end

	-- One undo step on every selected item's same-named decal.
	local function writeAll(items, name, key, value, label)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before " .. label)
		forAllDecals(items, name, function(decal) decal:SetAttribute(key, value) end)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: " .. label)
	end

	local function addGraphRow(body, refs, items, name, key, label, order, layerTitle)
		refs[key] = {}
		local row = Widgets.makeRow(body, label, function(p)
			local r = Widgets.makeGraphRow(key, nil); r.frame.Parent = p; refs[key] = r; return r.frame
		end, order)
		refs[key].row = row
		refs[key].editorTitle = label .. " " .. layerTitle
		local first = decalNamed(items[1], name)
		if first then util.populateGraphInput(refs[key], layerValue(first, key)) end
		local getItems = function() return items end
		-- Each layer's handles on its own decal: the layers share their keys.
		local function layerDecal(item) return decalNamed(item, name) end
		C.cGraphDots(refs, key, getItems, layerGetter(name), layerSetter(name), layerDecal)
		C.cGraphInline(refs, key, getItems, layerSetter(name), "DL_" .. name .. "_", layerDecal)
	end

	local function addColorRow(body, refs, items, name, key, label, order, layerTitle)
		refs[key] = {}
		local row = Widgets.makeRow(body, label, function(p)
			local r = Widgets.makeColorRow(key, nil); r.frame.Parent = p; refs[key] = r; return r.frame
		end, order)
		refs[key].row = row
		refs[key].editorTitle = layerTitle
		local first = decalNamed(items[1], name)
		if first then util.populateColorInput(refs[key], layerValue(first, key)) end
		local getItems = function() return items end
		C.cColorDots(refs, key, getItems, layerGetter(name), layerSetter(name))
		C.cColorInline(refs, key, getItems, layerSetter(name), "DL_" .. name .. "_")
		C.cColorSwatch(refs, key, getItems, layerGetter(name), layerSetter(name))
	end

	-- toValue maps the chosen text to the attribute value (nil clears it).
	local function addDropdownRow(body, items, name, key, label, options, current, order, toValue)
		local setOnChanged
		Widgets.makeRow(body, label, function(p)
			local _, frame, soc = Widgets.makeDropdown(key, nil, options, current)
			frame.Parent = p
			setOnChanged = soc
			return frame
		end, order)
		setOnChanged(function(text)
			writeAll(items, name, key, toValue(text), "Decal " .. label)
		end)
	end

	-- Empty clears the attribute, so the layer inherits the part's setting.
	local function addRangeRow(body, items, name, key, label, order)
		local input
		Widgets.makeRow(body, label, function(p)
			local tb, frame = Widgets.makeInput(key, nil, "", "min, max (inherit)")
			frame.Parent = p
			input = tb
			return frame
		end, order)
		local first = decalNamed(items[1], name)
		local current = first and first:GetAttribute(key)
		if typeof(current) == "NumberRange" then input.Text = string.format("%.4g, %.4g", current.Min, current.Max) end
		local saved = input.Text
		input.Focused:Connect(function() saved = input.Text end)
		input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local text = input.Text
			if text == "" then writeAll(items, name, key, nil, "Decal " .. label); return end
			local range = util.safeRange(text)
			if not range then input.Text = saved; util.flashInvalid(input); return end
			writeAll(items, name, key, range, "Decal " .. label)
			input.Text = string.format("%.4g, %.4g", range.Min, range.Max)
		end)
	end

	-- Shows the layer's value, else the part's Flipbook setting.
	local function addToggleRow(body, items, name, key, label, inheritKey, order)
		local tog
		Widgets.makeRow(body, label, function(p)
			local t, wrap = Widgets.makeToggleInBlob(key, nil)
			wrap.Parent = p
			tog = t
			return wrap
		end, order)
		local first = decalNamed(items[1], name)
		local value = first and first:GetAttribute(key)
		if value == nil then value = TypeRegistry.read(items[1], inheritKey) == true end
		tog:SetAttribute("IsOn", value == true)
		tog:GetAttributeChangedSignal("IsOn"):Connect(function()
			writeAll(items, name, key, tog:GetAttribute("IsOn") == true, "Decal " .. label)
		end)
	end

	-- Every layer's row refs, by layer name, for the items the list was last built for.
	local rowRefs = { items = {}, byLayer = {} }

	-- The last build's table while the items are the same; a new one for other items, so an editor
	-- still open for those cannot write here.
	local function refsFor(items, name)
		local same = #rowRefs.items == #items
		for index, item in ipairs(items) do
			if rowRefs.items[index] ~= item then
				same = false
				break
			end
		end
		if not same then
			rowRefs.items = table.clone(items)
			rowRefs.byLayer = {}
		end
		local refs = rowRefs.byLayer[name]
		if not refs then
			refs = {}
			rowRefs.byLayer[name] = refs
		end
		return refs
	end

	local function makeHeader(section, decal, items, rebuild)
		local name = decal.Name
		local head = Widgets.makeBlob("Header", section, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 22)); head.LayoutOrder = 0
		local arrow = Instance.new("TextLabel"); arrow.Name = "Arrow"; arrow.BackgroundTransparency = 1; arrow.Text = "\u{25BC}"
		arrow.TextColor3 = Theme.DarkGold; arrow.Font = Theme.Font; arrow.TextSize = 8
		arrow.Size = UDim2.new(0, 14, 1, 0); arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0); arrow.Parent = head
		local title = Instance.new("TextLabel"); title.Name = "Title"; title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		title.Text = name; title.TextColor3 = Theme.Gold; title.Font = Theme.Font; title.TextSize = 10
		title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left; title.TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd
		title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -110, 1, 0); title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 0); title.Parent = head
		-- An Inventory insert fills every active layer, or adds a layer when none is.
		local active = Instance.new("TextButton"); active.Name = "Active"; active.Text = "Active"
		active.Font = Theme.Font; active.TextSize = 9; active.Size = UDim2.new(0, 44, 0, 16)
		active.Position = UDim2.new(1, -68, 0.5, -8); active.BorderSizePixel = 0; active.AutoButtonColor = false
		active.ZIndex = 3; active.Parent = head; Widgets.addCorner(active, UDim.new(0, 8)); Widgets.addStroke(active)
		local function paintActive()
			local on = decal:GetAttribute("LayerActive") == true
			active.BackgroundColor3 = on and Theme.Gold or Theme.BlobBg
			active.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or Theme.BlobAlpha
			active.TextColor3 = on and Theme.PanelBg or Theme.MutedGold
		end
		paintActive()
		active.Activated:Connect(function()
			local on = not (decal:GetAttribute("LayerActive") == true)
			writeAll(items, name, "LayerActive", on or nil, "Decal Active")
			paintActive()
		end)
		local remove = Instance.new("TextButton"); remove.Name = "Remove"; remove.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		remove.Text = "\u{00D7}"; remove.TextColor3 = Theme.Red; remove.Font = Theme.Font; remove.TextSize = 14
		remove.Size = UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, 0); remove.Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0, 0); remove.ZIndex = 3; remove.Parent = head
		remove.Activated:Connect(function()
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Remove Decal")
			-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
			forAllDecals(items, name, function(d) d.Parent = nil end)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Remove Decal")
			rebuild()
		end)
		local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton"); toggle.Name = "Toggle"; toggle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		toggle.Text = ""; toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -72, 1, 0); toggle.Parent = head
		return arrow, toggle
	end

	-- The first item's layers; writes reach the same-named decals.
	function Populate.populateDecals(items)
		local list = UI.DecalList
		if not list then return end
		for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Frame") then child:Destroy() end
		end
		if #items == 0 then return end
		-- Older items convert once, deferred so the config write fills the panel after this pass.
		local legacy = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			if Migrate.DecalLayers.needs(item) then table.insert(legacy, item) end
		end
		if #legacy > 0 then
			task.defer(function()
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Decal Layers")
				for _, item in ipairs(legacy) do Migrate.DecalLayers.migrate(item) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Decal Layers")
			end)
			return
		end
		local first = items[1]
		local decals = decalsOf(first)
		-- The Clipboard and Shifter list as many layers as the selection has (ClipSlots).
		if ctx.refreshClipShifterSlots then ctx.refreshClipShifterSlots() end
		local flipOptions = { "Auto", "None" }
		for _, folderName in ipairs(flipbookNames(first)) do table.insert(flipOptions, folderName) end
		local function rebuild() Populate.populateDecals(items) end
		if #items > 1 then
			local mismatch = false
			for i = 2, #items do
				for _, decal in ipairs(decals) do
					if not decalNamed(items[i], decal.Name) then mismatch = true; break end
				end
				if mismatch then break end
			end
			if mismatch then
				local banner = Widgets.makeBlob("MismatchBanner", list, UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 20)); banner.LayoutOrder = -1
				Widgets.makeLabel("L", banner, "Mixed decals  -  edits reach items that have the same layer", Theme.MutedGold, Theme.Font, 9)
			end
		end
		for index, decal in ipairs(decals) do
			local name = decal.Name
			local section = Instance.new("Frame"); section.Name = "Layer" .. index; section.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			section.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0); section.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; section.LayoutOrder = index; section.Parent = list
			Widgets.addListLayout(section, 0)
			local arrow, toggle = makeHeader(section, decal, items, rebuild)
			local body = Instance.new("Frame"); body.Name = "Body"; body.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			body.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0); body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y; body.LayoutOrder = 1; body.Parent = section
			Widgets.addListLayout(body, 3); Widgets.addPadding(body, 4, 4, 4, 4)
			toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
				body.Visible = not body.Visible
				arrow.Text = body.Visible and "\u{25BC}" or "\u{25B6}"
			end)
			local refs = refsFor(items, name)
			local layerTitle = "#" .. index .. " " .. name
			addGraphRow(body, refs, items, name, "LayerTransparency", "Transparency", 1, layerTitle)
			addColorRow(body, refs, items, name, "LayerColor", "Color", 2, layerTitle)
			addGraphRow(body, refs, items, name, "LayerBrightness", "Brightness", 3, layerTitle)
			local flipCurrent = decal:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbook")
			if flipCurrent == nil or flipCurrent == "" then flipCurrent = "Auto" end
			addDropdownRow(body, items, name, "LayerFlipbook", "Flipbook", flipOptions, flipCurrent, 4, function(text)
				if text == "Auto" then return nil end
				return text
			end)
			addDropdownRow(body, items, name, "LayerFlipbookMode", "Mode", FLIP_MODES, decal:GetAttribute("LayerFlipbookMode") or "Inherit", 5, function(text)
				if text == "Inherit" then return nil end
				return text
			end)
			addRangeRow(body, items, name, "LayerFlipbookFramerate", "Framerate", 6)
			addToggleRow(body, items, name, "LayerFlipbookStartRandom", "Start Random", "FlipbookStartRandom", 7)
			addToggleRow(body, items, name, "LayerFlipbookReverse", "Reverse", "FlipbookReverse", 8)
		end
	end

	-- A hidden Front decal on every selected RenderTemplate, shown through its own layer graph.
	if UI.DecalAddBtn then
		UI.DecalAddBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local items = ctx.selectedParts or {}
			if #items == 0 then return end
			local name = uniqueDecalName(items)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Add Decal")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
				if rt and not decalNamed(item, name) then
					local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
					decal.Name = name
					decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
					decal.Transparency = 1
					decal:SetAttribute("LayerTransparency", NumberSequence.new(0))
					decal.Parent = rt
				end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Add Decal")
			Populate.populateDecals(items)
		end)
	end

	local basePopulateParts = Populate.populateParts
	Populate.populateParts = function(items)
		basePopulateParts(items)
		Populate.populateDecals(items)
	end

--[[
	PopulateMeshFrames: the Mesh Frames section, the four playback rows, the frame count and the
	Set from selection / Clear buttons (runtime: Part/MeshFrames; frames are MeshParts named 1..N
	in a MeshFrames Folder under the item).
	(ctx, Populate, C) -> wraps Populate.populateParts and sets Populate.populateMeshFrames(items).
	Child changes fire no fill, so the buttons fill the section after they write. Textures reach the
	frames through the Inventory (InventoryWiring/MeshFrameTargets).
]]

local Widgets = require(script.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.Widgets)
local LocalMeshFrames = require(script.Parent.Modules.LocalMeshFrames)
local MeshFramesMod = require(script.Parent.Modules.Part.MeshFrames)

return function(ctx, Populate, C)
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local Theme = ctx.UIBuilder.Theme
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local util = ctx.util
	local getCommonFromItems = util.getCommonFromItems
	local setInputRange = util.setInputRange
	local function readProp(item, propName) return util.readProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName) end
	local function setToggleState(toggle, state) util.setToggleState(toggle, state, Theme) end
	local function setToggleMixed(toggle) util.setToggleMixed(toggle, Theme) end

	local function framesFolder(item)
		return item:FindFirstChild("MeshFrames")
	end

	local function frameCount(item)
		local folder = framesFolder(item)
		if not folder then return 0 end
		local count = 0
		for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			if MeshFramesMod.isFrame(child) then count += 1 end
		end
		return count
	end

	local function insideTransformed(inst)
		local ancestor = inst.Parent
		while ancestor do
			if ancestor:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return true end
			ancestor = ancestor.Parent
		end
		return false
	end

	-- Frames from the selection (MeshParts, Models, Folders of either; ordered by the number in the
	-- name), skipping the emitters and anything inside a transformed item.
	local function selectedFrameSources(emitters)
		local isEmitter = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(emitters) do isEmitter[item] = true end
		local function accept(part)
			if part:GetAttribute("Transformed") or isEmitter[part] then return false end
			return not insideTransformed(part)
		end
		local sources, _, _, unnumbered = LocalMeshFrames.collectFrames(ctx.Selection:Get(), accept)
		if #sources > 0 and unnumbered then
			Widgets.showToast("No frame numbers in the names; frames were kept in Explorer order.", "warn", 5)
		end
		return sources
	end

	-- A hidden, inert copy of a frame under `folder`, named by index and parked at the emitter. Only
	-- the MeshPart is copied, never the Model the Importer wrapped it in.
	local function placeFrame(source, index, item, folder)
		local frame = source:Clone()
		frame.Name = tostring(index)
		frame.Anchored = true
		frame.CanCollide = false
		frame.CanQuery = false
		frame.CanTouch = false
		frame.CastShadow = false
		frame.Transparency = 1
		frame.CFrame = item.CFrame
		frame.Parent = folder
	end

	local function clearFrames(item)
		local folder = framesFolder(item)
		if not folder then return end
		for _, child in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
			-- Taken out, not destroyed: Studio's undo gives back only what was not destroyed.
			if MeshFramesMod.isFrame(child) then child.Parent = nil end
		end
	end

	local function setFrames(items, sources)
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Mesh Frames")
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			local folder = framesFolder(item)
			if not folder then
				folder = Instance.new("Folder")
				folder.Name = "MeshFrames"
				folder.Parent = item
			end
			clearFrames(item)
			for index, source in ipairs(sources) do placeFrame(source, index, item, folder) end
		end
		ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Mesh Frames")
	end

	function Populate.populateMeshFrames(items)
		local P = UI.Part
		if not P then return end
		if #items == 0 then
			if UI.MeshFramesCount then UI.MeshFramesCount.Text = "0" end
			return
		end
		-- The raw attribute tells "" (None, from the dropdown) apart from the enum default.
		local function readModeText(item)
			local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
			return config and config:GetAttribute("MeshFrameMode") or nil
		end
		local rawMode, rawModeVaries = getCommonFromItems(items, readModeText)
		local mode, modeVaries = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "MeshFrameMode") end)
		if P.MeshFrameMode and P.MeshFrameMode.dropdown then
			P.MeshFrameMode.dropdown.Text = (modeVaries or rawModeVaries) and "~"
				or (rawMode == "" and "None")
				or (mode and mode.Name)
				or "OneShot"
		end
		-- OneShot spreads the frames over Lifetime, so the framerate row hides.
		local isOneShot = not modeVaries and mode == Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode.OneShot
		if P.MeshFrameFramerate and P.MeshFrameFramerate.input then
			P.MeshFrameFramerate.row.Visible = not isOneShot
			local framerate, framerateVaries = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, "MeshFrameFramerate") end)
			setInputRange(P.MeshFrameFramerate, framerate, framerateVaries)
		end
		for _, key in ipairs({ "MeshFrameStartRandom", "MeshFrameReverse" }) do
			local ref = P[key]
			if ref and ref.toggle then
				local value, varies = getCommonFromItems(items, function(item) return readProp(item, key) end)
				if varies then setToggleMixed(ref.toggle) else setToggleState(ref.toggle, value == true) end
			end
		end
		if UI.MeshFramesCount then
			local count, countVaries = getCommonFromItems(items, frameCount)
			UI.MeshFramesCount.Text = countVaries and "~" or tostring(count or 0)
		end
	end

	if UI.MeshFramesSetBtn then
		UI.MeshFramesSetBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local items = ctx.selectedParts or {}
			if #items == 0 then return end
			local sources = selectedFrameSources(items)
			if #sources == 0 then
				Widgets.showToast("Select the frame MeshParts (or a Folder of them) together with the emitter, then press Set.", "warn", 5)
				return
			end
			setFrames(items, sources)
			Populate.populateMeshFrames(items)
		end)
	end

	if UI.MeshFramesClearBtn then
		UI.MeshFramesClearBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local items = ctx.selectedParts or {}
			if #items == 0 then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Clear Mesh Frames")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do clearFrames(item) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Clear Mesh Frames")
			Populate.populateMeshFrames(items)
		end)
	end

	local basePopulateParts = Populate.populateParts
	Populate.populateParts = function(items)
		basePopulateParts(items)
		Populate.populateMeshFrames(items)
	end
end

-- PropertyInputs: wires every type's Properties rows. (ctx, connectors); the per-type wiring is
-- in the sub-modules, which take the helpers below through wiringDeps.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local UI_CONSTANTS = require(script.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.Constants)
local PropertyCatalog = require(script.Parent.Modules.PropertyCatalog)
local THEME = UI_CONSTANTS.T
local AxisGraphPreview = require(script.AxisGraphPreview)
return function(ctx, C)
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local util = ctx.util
	local sel = ctx.sel
	local UI = ctx.UI

	local readProp = function(item, propName) return util.readProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName) end
	local writeProp = function(item, propName, value) util.writeProp(TypeRegistry, item, propName, value) end
	local parseCSV = util.parseCSV
	local safeRange = util.safeRange
	local populateGraphInput = util.populateGraphInput
	local isShiftHeld = C.isShiftHeld

	-- An axis graph row: the graph of the selected axis pill (Part and Attachment).
	local function wireAxisGraphSelect(typeRef, baseKey, getItems, writeFor)
		local ref = typeRef[baseKey]
		if not ref then return end

		local function refreshAxisInput()
			if not ref.input then return end
			local selAxes = ref.getSelected()
			local items = getItems()
			if #selAxes == 0 or #items == 0 then ref.input.Text = ""; return end
			local primary = ref.getPrimary and ref.getPrimary()
			if primary then
				local seq = readProp(items[1], primary)
				if seq and typeof(seq) == "NumberSequence" then
					local firstStr = tostring(seq)
					for _, axisKey in ipairs(selAxes) do
						for _, item in ipairs(items) do
							if tostring(readProp(item, axisKey)) ~= firstStr then
								ref.input.Text = "~"
								return
							end
						end
					end
					populateGraphInput(ref, seq)
				else
					ref.input.Text = ""
				end
			else
				ref.input.Text = ""
			end
		end

		if ref.setOnSelectionChanged then
			ref.setOnSelectionChanged(refreshAxisInput)
		end
		-- Selection changes and undo repaint the input through this.
		ref.refresh = refreshAxisInput

		if ref.dotsBtn then
			ref.dotsBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if isShiftHeld() and ctx._showDotsMenu then
					local primary = ref.getPrimary and ref.getPrimary()
					if primary then
						ctx._showDotsMenu(ref.dotsBtn, typeRef, primary, getItems, readProp, writeProp)
					end
					return
				end
				if not ctx.graphEditor then return end
				local selAxes = ref.getSelected()
				if #selAxes == 0 then return end
				local items = getItems()
				if #items == 0 then return end
				local primary = ref.getPrimary and ref.getPrimary() or selAxes[1]
				local firstGraph = readProp(items[1], primary)
				if not firstGraph or typeof(firstGraph) ~= "NumberSequence" then return end
				local snapshot = {table.unpack(items)}
				local selSnap = {table.unpack(selAxes)}
				local axisNames = {}
				for _, k in ipairs(selSnap) do table.insert(axisNames, k:sub(#baseKey + 1)) end
				-- Each axis keeps its own "_BezierHandles"; the editor opens on the first one's.
				local primaryCfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(snapshot[1])
				local bezJSON = primaryCfg and primaryCfg:GetAttribute(primary .. "_BezierHandles") or nil
				ctx.graphEditor:Open(firstGraph, baseKey .. " (" .. table.concat(axisNames, "+") .. ")", function(newSeq, bezData)
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Edit " .. baseKey)
					local encoded = bezData and HttpService:JSONEncode(bezData) or nil
					for _, axisKey in ipairs(selSnap) do
						for _, item in ipairs(snapshot) do
							writeProp(item, axisKey, newSeq)
							local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
							if cfg then cfg:SetAttribute(axisKey .. "_BezierHandles", encoded) end
						end
					end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Edit " .. baseKey)
					refreshAxisInput()
					if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
				end, AxisGraphPreview(snapshot, selSnap, firstGraph, readProp, writeProp), bezJSON)
			end)
		end

		if ref.input then
			local savedText = ref.input.Text
			local pfx = "AGS_Focus_"..writeFor.."_"; local pfx2 = "AGS_"..writeFor.."_"
			Connections[pfx..baseKey] = ref.input.Focused:Connect(function()
				savedText = ref.input.Text
				if ref.input.Text == "<NumberSequence>" or ref.input.Text == "~" then ref.input.Text = "" end
			end)
			Connections[pfx2..baseKey] = ref.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local txt = ref.input.Text
				if txt == "" or txt == "<NumberSequence>" or txt == "~" then ref.input.Text = savedText; C.flashInvalid(ref.input); return end
				local newSeq
				local parts = {}; for v in txt:gmatch("[^,]+") do local nn = tonumber(v:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")); if nn then parts[#parts+1] = nn end end
				if #parts == 2 then
					local lo, hi = math.min(parts[1], parts[2]), math.max(parts[1], parts[2])
					if lo == hi then newSeq = NumberSequence.new(lo)
					else local mid = (lo + hi) / 2; local env = (hi - lo) / 2
						newSeq = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, mid, env), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, mid, env)}) end
				elseif #parts == 1 then newSeq = NumberSequence.new(parts[1])
				else ref.input.Text = savedText; C.flashInvalid(ref.input); return end
				local selAxes = ref.getSelected(); if #selAxes == 0 then ref.input.Text = savedText; C.flashInvalid(ref.input); return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Inline " .. baseKey)
				for _, axisKey in ipairs(selAxes) do
					for _, item in ipairs(getItems()) do
						writeProp(item, axisKey, newSeq)
						-- The old handles no longer match the new keypoints.
						local cfg = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
						if cfg then pcall(function() cfg:SetAttribute(axisKey .. "_BezierHandles", nil) end) end
					end
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Inline " .. baseKey)
				populateGraphInput(ref, newSeq)
				if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
			end)
		end
	end

	-- An axis input (Rotation, Position). ref.refresh is shared by the fills and the axis pills, so
	-- a selection change or undo repaints the text too.
	local function wireAxisInput(typeRef, baseKey, parser, getItems, writeForFn, connPrefix)
		local ref = typeRef[baseKey]
		if not ref or not ref.input then return end
		local function refresh()
			local selAxes = ref.getSelected()
			if #selAxes == 0 then ref.input.Text = ""; return end
			local items = getItems()
			if #items == 0 then ref.input.Text = ""; return end
			local first = readProp(items[1], selAxes[1])
			local firstStr = tostring(first)
			for _, axisKey in ipairs(selAxes) do
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					if tostring(readProp(item, axisKey)) ~= firstStr then
						ref.input.Text = "~"
						return
					end
				end
			end
			if first == nil then ref.input.Text = ""; return end
			if typeof(first) == "NumberRange" then ref.input.Text = string.format("%.4g, %.4g", first.Min, first.Max)
			elseif typeof(first) == "number" then ref.input.Text = string.format("%.4g", first)
			else ref.input.Text = tostring(first) end
		end
		ref.setOnSelectionChanged(refresh)
		ref.refresh = refresh
		-- A failed parse restores the text and flashes.
		local savedText = ref.input.Text
		Connections[connPrefix.."F_"..baseKey] = ref.input.Focused:Connect(function() savedText = ref.input.Text end)
		Connections[connPrefix..baseKey] = ref.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local selAxes = ref.getSelected()
			if #selAxes == 0 then return end
			local txt = ref.input.Text
			if txt == "" or txt == "~" then return end
			local val = parser(txt)
			if val == nil then ref.input.Text = savedText; C.flashInvalid(ref.input); return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Edit " .. baseKey)
			for _, axisKey in ipairs(selAxes) do writeForFn(axisKey, val) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Edit " .. baseKey)
		end)
	end

	-- The EvenDistribution dots of an axis row (ref.evenButtons, from WidgetAxis): a click flips
	-- RotXEven, PosYEven ... on every selected item, one undo step each.
	local function wireAxisEvenToggles(typeRef, baseKey, getItems, connPrefix)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef[baseKey]
		if not ref or not ref.evenButtons then return end
		for axis, dot in pairs(ref.evenButtons) do
			local attrName = dot:GetAttribute("_evenAttr")
			if not attrName then continue end
			Connections[connPrefix.."Even_"..baseKey.."_"..axis] = dot.Activated:Connect(function()
				local items = getItems()
				if #items == 0 then return end
				local newOn = not (dot:GetAttribute("_even") == true)
				dot:SetAttribute("_even", newOn)
				dot.BackgroundColor3 = newOn and THEME.BrightGold or THEME.DarkGold
				dot.BackgroundTransparency = newOn and 0 or 0.4
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle " .. attrName)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, attrName, newOn) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle " .. attrName)
			end)
		end
	end

	local wireConfigButtons = C.wireConfigButtons

	-- LinkMode and LinkSource are item attributes, not config properties.
	local function wireLinkMode(typeRef, getItems)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef.LinkMode
		if ref and ref.setOnChanged then ref.setOnChanged(function() task.defer(function()
			local text = ref.dropdown and ref.dropdown.Text; if not text then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set LinkMode")
			for _, v in ipairs(getItems()) do v:SetAttribute("LinkMode", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set LinkMode")
		end) end) end
		local srcRef = typeRef and typeRef.LinkSource
		if srcRef and srcRef.setOnChanged then srcRef.setOnChanged(function() task.defer(function()
			local text = srcRef.dropdown and srcRef.dropdown.Text; if not text then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set LinkSource")
			for _, v in ipairs(getItems()) do v:SetAttribute("LinkSource", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set LinkSource")
		end) end) end
	end

	-- The per-axis link pills (LinkPosX ... on the item; absent is on).
	local function wireLinkAxes(typeRef, getItems, connPrefix)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef.LinkAxes
		if not ref or not ref.buttons then return end
		for attrName, btn in pairs(ref.buttons) do
			Connections[connPrefix .. "LinkAxis_" .. attrName] = btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				local items = getItems()
				if #items == 0 then return end
				local newOn = not (btn:GetAttribute("_selected") == true)
				ref.setState(attrName, newOn)
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle " .. attrName)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do item:SetAttribute(attrName, newOn) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle " .. attrName)
			end)
		end
	end

	-- The items at the click, so the deferred write never reads a later selection.
	local function wireRotMode(typeRef, getItems, connKey)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef.RotMode
		if not ref then return end
		local function apply()
			local items = {table.unpack(getItems())}
			task.defer(function()
				local t = ref.dropdown and ref.dropdown.Text
				if not t then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set RotMode")
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "RotMode", t) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set RotMode")
			end)
		end
		if ref.setOnChanged then
			ref.setOnChanged(apply)
		elseif ref.dropdown then
			Connections["D_RotMode_"..connKey] = ref.dropdown.Activated:Connect(apply)
		end
	end

	-- The order the per-frame rotations compose in: "Global" is Y*X*Z; the six "LocalABC" apply each
	-- axis in the frame the previous rotation left.
	local function wireRotOrder(typeRef, getItems, connKey)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef.RotOrder
		if not ref then return end

			local items = {table.unpack(getItems())}
			task.defer(function()

				if not t then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set RotOrder")
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "RotOrder", t) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set RotOrder")
			end)

		if ref.setOnChanged then

		elseif ref.dropdown then
			Connections["D_RotOrder_"..connKey] = ref.dropdown.Activated:Connect(apply)

	local function wirePosMode(typeRef, getItems, connKey)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef.PosMode
		if not ref then return end
		local function apply()
			local items = {table.unpack(getItems())}
			task.defer(function()
				local t = ref.dropdown and ref.dropdown.Text
				if not t then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set PosMode")
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "PosMode", t) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set PosMode")
			end)
		end
		if ref.setOnChanged then
			ref.setOnChanged(apply)
		elseif ref.dropdown then
			Connections["D_PosMode_"..connKey] = ref.dropdown.Activated:Connect(apply)
		end
	end

	-- DisplacementMode governs the PosOffset graphs over a lifetime.
	local function wireDisplacementMode(typeRef, getItems, connKey)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef.DisplacementMode
		if not ref then return end
		local function apply()
			local items = {table.unpack(getItems())}
			task.defer(function()
				local t = ref.dropdown and ref.dropdown.Text
				if not t then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set DisplacementMode")
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "DisplacementMode", t) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set DisplacementMode")
			end)

		if ref.setOnChanged then
			ref.setOnChanged(apply)
		elseif ref.dropdown then
			Connections["D_DisplacementMode_"..connKey] = ref.dropdown.Activated:Connect(apply)
		end
	end

	local function wireOrientation(typeRef, getItems, connKey)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef.Orientation
		if not ref then return end
		local function apply()
			local items = {table.unpack(getItems())}
			task.defer(function()
				local t = ref.dropdown and ref.dropdown.Text
				if not t then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Orientation")
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "Orientation", t) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Orientation")
			end)
		end
		if ref.setOnChanged then
			ref.setOnChanged(apply)
		elseif ref.dropdown then
			Connections["D_Orientation_"..connKey] = ref.dropdown.Activated:Connect(apply)
		end
	end

	-- Also writes VelocityVectored, which the per-frame update (NeedsFullIteration) reads.
	local function wireDirMode(typeRef, getItems, connKey)
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef.DirMode
		if not ref then return end
		local function apply()
			local items = {table.unpack(getItems())}
			task.defer(function()
				local t = ref.dropdown and ref.dropdown.Text
				if not t then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set DirMode")
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					writeProp(item, "DirMode", t)
					writeProp(item, "VelocityVectored", t == "Local")
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set DirMode")
			end)
		end
		if ref.setOnChanged then
			ref.setOnChanged(apply)
		elseif ref.dropdown then
			Connections["D_DirMode_"..connKey] = ref.dropdown.Activated:Connect(apply)
		end
	end

	-- EmissionMode and AnimateLoop are item attributes, not config properties.
	local function wireEmissionMode(typeRef, getItems, connKey)
		local modeRef = typeRef and typeRef.EmissionMode
		local loopRef = typeRef and typeRef.AnimateLoop
		local enabledRef = typeRef and typeRef.Enabled
		if modeRef and modeRef.setOnChanged then
			modeRef.setOnChanged(function()
				task.defer(function()
					local text = modeRef.dropdown and modeRef.dropdown.Text
					if not text then return end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set EmissionMode")
					for _, v in ipairs(getItems()) do
						local oldMode = v:GetAttribute("EmissionMode")
						if oldMode ~= text and ctx and ctx.Part then
							pcall(function() ctx.Part:Disable(v) end)
						end
						v:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", text)
					end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set EmissionMode")
					local isAnim = (text == "Animate") -- Animate shows the Loop row and hides Enabled
					if loopRef and loopRef.toggle then loopRef.row.Visible = isAnim end
					if enabledRef and enabledRef.toggle then enabledRef.row.Visible = not isAnim end
					-- Animate ignores EmitCount: the row hides when every selected item is in Animate.
					if UI and UI.EmitRow then
						local hasAny, allAnimate = false, true
						local typeBuckets = {ctx.selectedParts, ctx.selectedBeams, ctx.selectedPointLights,
							ctx.selectedHighlights, ctx.selectedTrailEmitters, ctx.selectedAttachments, ctx.selectedModels, ctx.selectedBlurs, ctx.selectedBlooms,
							ctx.selectedColorCorrections, ctx.selectedAtmospheres, ctx.selectedImageLabels}
						for _, bucket in ipairs(typeBuckets) do
							for _, t in ipairs(bucket or {}) do
								hasAny = true
								if t:GetAttribute("EmissionMode") ~= "Animate" then allAnimate = false; break end
							end
							if not allAnimate then break end
						end
						UI.EmitRow.Visible = not (hasAny and allAnimate)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
		if loopRef and loopRef.toggle then
			Connections["T_AnimLoop_"..connKey] = loopRef.toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
				task.defer(function()
					local isOn = loopRef.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn")
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle AnimateLoop")
					for _, v in ipairs(getItems()) do
						v:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", isOn or false)
						-- Turning it on starts an idle item's Animate cycle, as the toolbar's Enable does.
						if isOn and ctx and ctx.Part and ctx.Part.ActiveAnimates and not ctx.Part.ActiveAnimates[v] then
							pcall(function() ctx.Part:EmitAnimate(v) end)
						end
					end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle AnimateLoop")
				end)
			end)
		end
	end

	local function wireItemAttrToggle(typeRef, attrName, getItems, connKey) -- ref key == attribute name
		local ref = typeRef and typeRef[attrName]; if not ref or not ref.toggle then return end
		Connections["T_" .. attrName .. "_" .. connKey] = ref.toggle.Activated:Connect(function() task.defer(function()
			local isOn = ref.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") or false
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle " .. attrName)
			for _, v in ipairs(getItems()) do v:SetAttribute(attrName, isOn) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle " .. attrName) end) end)
	end

	local wiringDeps = {
		ctx = ctx, C = C, UI = UI, sel = sel,
		Connections = Connections, ChangeHistoryService = ChangeHistoryService,
		readProp = readProp, writeProp = writeProp,
		parseCSV = parseCSV, safeRange = safeRange,
		wireAxisGraphSelect = wireAxisGraphSelect,
		wireAxisInput = wireAxisInput,
		wireAxisEvenToggles = wireAxisEvenToggles,
		wireLinkMode = wireLinkMode,
		wireLinkAxes = wireLinkAxes,
		wireRotMode = wireRotMode,
		wireRotOrder = wireRotOrder,
		wirePosMode = wirePosMode,
		wireDisplacementMode = wireDisplacementMode,
		wireOrientation = wireOrientation,
		wireDirMode = wireDirMode,
		wireEmissionMode = wireEmissionMode,
		wireItemAttrToggle = wireItemAttrToggle,
		typeItemKeys = PropertyCatalog.TYPE_ITEM_KEYS,
		scatter = require(script.Parent.Modules.Scatter),
	}
	require(script.PropertyInputsTypeSections)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsLightning)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsCameraShake)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsSound)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsRocks)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsRope)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsDistortion)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsContainer)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsMatte)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsForce)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsReactor)(wiringDeps)
	require(script.PropertyInputsPE)(ctx, C)
	require(script.PropertyInputsScreen)(ctx, C)
	-- Last: the Type row of every section built above.
	require(script.PropertyInputsEmitType)(wiringDeps)

--[[
	AxisGraphPreview: the live-preview callback of a graph editor opened on several axes.
	  AxisGraphPreview(items, axisKeys, openedSeq, readProp, writeProp) -> function(previewSeq)
	Cross-file: GraphEditor (Close / _reload) hands back the sequence it was opened with to revert:
	that restores every item's own graph on every axis; any other sequence is a live edit for all.
	The same contract as Connectors.cGraphDots.
]]

return function(items, axisKeys, openedSeq, readProp, writeProp)
	local originals = {}
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		local perAxis = {}
		for _, axisKey in ipairs(axisKeys) do
			perAxis[axisKey] = readProp(item, axisKey)
		end
		originals[item] = perAxis
	end

	return function(previewSeq)
		local reverting = previewSeq == openedSeq
		for _, axisKey in ipairs(axisKeys) do
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				local original = originals[item][axisKey]
				if reverting and original ~= nil then
					writeProp(item, axisKey, original)
				else
					writeProp(item, axisKey, previewSeq)
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local GRAPH_KEYS = {
	"DriveRate", "DriveScale", "DriveTimescale", "DriveBrightness",
	"DriveLightInfluence", "DriveLightEmission", "DriveTransparency",
}
-- TypeDataContainer.MODES and COLOR_MODES, as the two dropdowns list them.
local MODES = { Absolute = true, Relative = true, ["Relative Lifetime"] = true, ["Relative Span"] = true }
local COLOR_MODES = { Recolor = true, Colorize = true, Shift = true, Tint = true }
-- TypeDataContainer.APPLY_KINDS, as the "Apply to" popup names them: short, four fit a row.
local KIND_LABELS = { Emitter = "Emitters", Mesh = "Meshes", Beam = "Beams", Trail = "Trails", Reactor = "Reactors", Part = "Parts", Effect = "Effects" }
local CONFIG_NAME = "PartIcleProperties"

-- The kinds listed in a row's Skip attribute, as { [kind] = true }.
local function skippedKinds(item, rowKey)
	local skipped = {}
	local config = item:FindFirstChild(CONFIG_NAME)
	local text = config and config:GetAttribute(rowKey .. "Skip")
	if type(text) == "string" then
		for kind in string.gmatch(text, "[^,%s]+") do
			skipped[kind] = true
		end
	end
	return skipped
end

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local C = deps.C
	local UI = deps.UI
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local readProp = deps.readProp
	local writeProp = deps.writeProp
	local safeRange = deps.safeRange

	local CT = UI.Container
	if not CT then return end
	local function selectedContainers() return ctx.selectedContainers end

	C.cInput(CT, "Rate", tonumber, "CT")
	C.cInput(CT, "Lifetime", safeRange, "CT")
	C.cToggle(CT, "Enabled", "CT")

	local function wireStringDropdown(ref, key, allowed)
		if not ref or not ref.setOnChanged then return end
		ref.setOnChanged(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedContainers)}
			task.defer(function()
				local text = ref.dropdown.Text
				if not allowed[text] then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Container " .. key)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, key, text) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Container " .. key)
			end)
		end)
	end
	wireStringDropdown(CT.Mode, "Mode", MODES)
	wireStringDropdown(CT.ColorMode, "ColorMode", COLOR_MODES)

	for _, key in ipairs(GRAPH_KEYS) do
		C.cGraphDots(CT, key, selectedContainers, readProp, writeProp)
		C.cGraphInline(CT, key, selectedContainers, writeProp, "CT_")
	end
	-- One row, X and Y pills, stored as DriveSpreadX / DriveSpreadY.
	deps.wireAxisGraphSelect(CT, "DriveSpread", selectedContainers, "CT")
	C.cColorDots(CT, "DriveColor", selectedContainers, readProp, writeProp)
	C.cColorInline(CT, "DriveColor", selectedContainers, writeProp, "CT_")
	C.cColorSwatch(CT, "DriveColor", selectedContainers, readProp, writeProp)

	-- A row's asterisk: "Apply to" for the Drive rows (<row>Skip lists the kinds left out, read by
	-- GetDataRig.readContainer), the shared config popups for the rest.
	local function wireApplyTo(rowKey, ref)
		ref.configBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedContainers)}
			local panel = ctx.configPanel
			if #items == 0 or not panel or not panel.openApplyPanel then return end
			local skipped = skippedKinds(items[1], rowKey)
			local kinds = {}
			local applies = {}
			for _, kind in ipairs(ref.configKind.kinds) do
				table.insert(kinds, { key = kind, label = KIND_LABELS[kind] or kind })
				applies[kind] = not skipped[kind]
			end
			panel.openApplyPanel({
				title = "Apply to",
				context = rowKey,
				kinds = kinds,
				applies = applies,
				onSet = function(chosen)
					local left = {}
					for _, kind in ipairs(ref.configKind.kinds) do
						if chosen[kind] == false then table.insert(left, kind) end
					end
					local stored = nil
					if #left > 0 then
						stored = table.concat(left, ",")
					end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Apply To")
					for _, item in ipairs(items) do
						local config = item:FindFirstChild(CONFIG_NAME)
						if config then config:SetAttribute(rowKey .. "Skip", stored) end
					end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Apply To")
					ref.configBtn.Text = stored and "-" or "*"
				end,
			})
		end)
	end
	for key, ref in pairs(CT) do
		if type(ref) == "table" and ref.configBtn then
			if type(ref.configKind) == "table" and ref.configKind.kind == "apply-to" then
				wireApplyTo(key, ref)
			else
				C.cConfigButton(ref, selectedContainers, key)
			end
		end
	end
end

-- PropertyInputsForce: wires the Force section. (deps) from PropertyInputs/init.

-- TypeDataForce.SHAPES and KINDS, as the two dropdowns list them.
local SHAPES = { Sphere = true, Cone = true, Linear = true, Vortex = true }
local KINDS = { Impulse = true, Continuous = true }
-- What a ground does after this Force's crack: the Reactor's own After, or one of its three.
local AFTERS = { ["Reactor's"] = true, Stay = true, Fade = true, Return = true }
-- TypeDataForce.CUTS: what a Linear Force's blade makes of a part.
local CUTS = { Off = true, Halves = true, Pieces = true, Band = true }
local NUMBER_KEYS = { "Rate", "Range", "Inner", "Width", "Height", "Angle", "TravelTime", "Lift", "Spin", "Pull", "Variation", "Turbulence", "SizeResponse", "Drag", "TurbulenceFrequency", "AfterDelay", "Pieces", "PushAlong", "PushApart", "CutNoise", "CutNoiseScale" }
local RANGE_KEYS = { "Lifetime", "PositionEvenCycle", "RotationEvenCycle" }
local GRAPH_KEYS = { "Strength", "Timescale", "Speed", "AccelStrength", "MotionTurbulence" }
-- The ObjectValues the Link and Accel toward pickers write. Transform makes them; an older Force
-- gets them at the press.
local PICKED_VALUES = { "Link", "AccelTarget" }

-- Falloff is a share: outside 0 to 1 is stored as the nearest end, so the row shows what the
-- runtime uses.
local function parseShare(text)
	local value = tonumber(text)
	if not value then
		return nil
	end
	return math.clamp(value, 0, 1)
end

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local C = deps.C
	local UI = deps.UI
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local readProp = deps.readProp
	local writeProp = deps.writeProp
	local safeRange = deps.safeRange
	local parseCSV = deps.parseCSV
	local Connections = deps.Connections

	local FC = UI.Force
	if not FC then return end
	local function selectedForces() return ctx.selectedForces end

	C.cToggle(FC, "Enabled", "FC")
	for _, key in ipairs(RANGE_KEYS) do
		C.cInput(FC, key, safeRange, "FC")
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(NUMBER_KEYS) do
		C.cInput(FC, key, tonumber, "FC")
	end
	C.cInput(FC, "Falloff", parseShare, "FC")
	-- Group is free text; empty reaches every Reactor.
	C.cInput(FC, "Group", function(text) return text end, "FC")
	C.cDropdown(FC, "Direction", Enum.NormalId, "FC", "EmissionDirection")

	local function wireStringDropdown(ref, key, allowed)
		if not ref or not ref.setOnChanged then return end
		ref.setOnChanged(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedForces)}
			task.defer(function()
				local text = ref.dropdown.Text
				if not allowed[text] then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Force " .. key)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, key, text) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Force " .. key)
			end)
		end)
	end
	wireStringDropdown(FC.Shape, "Shape", SHAPES)
	wireStringDropdown(FC.ActsAs, "ActsAs", KINDS)
	wireStringDropdown(FC.After, "After", AFTERS)
	wireStringDropdown(FC.Cut, "Cut", CUTS)

	for _, key in ipairs(GRAPH_KEYS) do
		C.cGraphDots(FC, key, selectedForces, readProp, writeProp)
		C.cGraphInline(FC, key, selectedForces, writeProp, "FC_")
	end

	-- Spawn, Motion and Link: the mesh's rows (BuildPropertiesForce), wired by the Meshes section's
	-- helpers. MoveDirection and MotionTurbulence are the Force's own keys.
	local function parseRange(text)
		local values = parseCSV(text, 2)
		if not values then
			return nil
		end
		return NumberRange.new(math.min(values[1], values[2]), math.max(values[1], values[2]))
	end
	local function parseVector2(text)
		local values = parseCSV(text, 2)
		if not values then
			return nil
		end
		return Vector2.new(values[1], values[2])
	end
	local function parseVector3(text)
		local values = parseCSV(text, 3)
		if not values then
			return nil
		end
		return Vector3.new(values[1], values[2], values[3])
	end

	deps.wireAxisEvenToggles(FC, "Rot", selectedForces, "FC")
	deps.wirePosMode(FC, selectedForces, "FC")
	deps.wireRotOrder(FC, selectedForces, "FC")

	C.cDropdown(FC, "MoveDirection", Enum.NormalId, "FC")

	deps.wireRotMode(FC, selectedForces, "FC")
	deps.wireAxisGraphSelect(FC, "PosOffset", selectedForces, "FC")
	deps.wireAxisGraphSelect(FC, "RotSpeed", selectedForces, "FC")
	C.cToggleGroup(FC, "AccelerationTowardsInstance", "Force", "Accel toward")

	deps.wireLinkMode(FC, selectedForces)

	for _, name in ipairs(PICKED_VALUES) do

						holder.Name = name
						holder.Parent = item

			end)
		end
	end
	C.wireConfigButtons(FC, selectedForces)
end
