-- Writes to the LIVE RenderTemplate skip TypeRegistry.write, so they bump its _PoolGen here.
local function bumpRTPoolGen(item)
	if not item then return end
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not rt then return end
	local cur = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
end

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local C = deps.C
	local UI = deps.UI
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local readProp = deps.readProp
	local writeProp = deps.writeProp
	local parseCSV = deps.parseCSV
	local safeRange = deps.safeRange
	local wireEmissionMode = deps.wireEmissionMode
	local wireItemAttrToggle = deps.wireItemAttrToggle
	local wireAxisInput = deps.wireAxisInput
	local wireAxisEvenToggles = deps.wireAxisEvenToggles
	local wireRotOrder = deps.wireRotOrder
	local wirePosMode = deps.wirePosMode
	local wireConfigButtons = C.wireConfigButtons

	local LN = UI.Lightning
	if not LN then return end
	local function sln() return ctx.selectedLightnings end

	wireEmissionMode(LN, function() return ctx.selectedLightnings end, "LN")
	deps.wireLinkMode(LN, sln)
	deps.wireLinkAxes(LN, sln, "Lightning_")
	wireItemAttrToggle(LN, "PreloadTexture", function() return ctx.selectedLightnings end, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "Rate", tonumber, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "Keyframes", tonumber, "LN", "TotalKeyFrames")
	C.cInput(LN, "Linger", tonumber, "LN", "PartLife")
	C.cInput(LN, "Lifetime", safeRange, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "Length", safeRange, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "GrowthSpeed", safeRange, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "SpreadAngle", function(t) local v = parseCSV(t,2); if not v then return nil end; return Vector2.new(v[1],v[2]) end, "LN")
	-- Rolled per bolt: "min, max", or one number for a fixed value.
	for _, k in ipairs({"SegmentCount","Amplitude","AmplitudeDecay","JitterRate","ScrollSpeed","Waves","ForkChance","ForkDepth","ForkLengthScale","Sag","SagShape"}) do
		C.cInput(LN, k, safeRange, "LN")
	end

	-- Populate applies the same row gating on a fill.
	if LN.ShapeMode and LN.ShapeMode.setOnChanged then LN.ShapeMode.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedLightnings)}
		task.defer(function()
			local text = LN.ShapeMode.dropdown.Text
			if text ~= "Jitter" and text ~= "Scroll" and text ~= "JitterScroll" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set ShapeMode")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "ShapeMode", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set ShapeMode")
			local scrolls = text ~= "Jitter"
			for _, k in ipairs({"ScrollSpeed","Waves"}) do
				if LN[k] and LN[k].row then LN[k].row.Visible = scrolls end
			end
		end)
	end) end
	C.cToggle(LN, "Enabled", "LN")
	C.cToggle(LN, "Pool", "LN")
	C.cDropdown(LN, "Direction", Enum.NormalId, "LN", "EmissionDirection")

	-- UseShape scatters from the volume; in Directional mode the shape's outward normal aims the bolt.
	if LN.UseShape and LN.UseShape.toggle then
		deps.Connections["T_UseShape_LN"] = LN.UseShape.toggle.Activated:Connect(function() task.defer(function()
			local val = LN.UseShape.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn")
			if LN.UseShape.fields then LN.UseShape.fields.Visible = val end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle UseShape")
			deps.sel.writeForLightnings("UseShape", val)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle UseShape")
		end) end)
	end
	if LN.DiskEnabled and LN.DiskEnabled.toggle then
		deps.Connections["T_DiskEnabled_LN"] = LN.DiskEnabled.toggle.Activated:Connect(function() task.defer(function()
			local val = LN.DiskEnabled.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn")
			if LN.DiskEnabled.fields then LN.DiskEnabled.fields.Visible = val end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle DiskEnabled")
			deps.sel.writeForLightnings("DiskEnabled", val)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle DiskEnabled")
		end) end)
	end
	-- Manual shows the transparency and brightness graphs.
	if LN.DiskMode and LN.DiskMode.setOnChanged then LN.DiskMode.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedLightnings)}
		task.defer(function()
			local text = LN.DiskMode.dropdown.Text
			if text ~= "Follow" and text ~= "Manual" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set DiskMode")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "DiskMode", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set DiskMode")
			local manual = text == "Manual"
			for _, k in ipairs({"DiskTransparency","DiskBrightness"}) do
				if LN[k] and LN[k].row then LN[k].row.Visible = manual end
			end
		end)
	end) end
	C.cInput(LN, "DiskTexture", function(t) if t == "none" then return "" end return t end, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "DiskOffset", tonumber, "LN")
	C.cDropdown(LN, "Shape", Enum.ParticleEmitterShape, "LN")
	C.cDropdown(LN, "ShapeInOut", Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "ShapePartial", tonumber, "LN")

	local rangeParser = function(t)
		local v = parseCSV(t, 2)
		if not v then return nil end
		return NumberRange.new(math.min(v[1], v[2]), math.max(v[1], v[2]))
	end
	wireAxisInput(LN, "Rot", rangeParser, sln, deps.sel.writeForLightnings, "AI_LN_")
	wireAxisInput(LN, "Pos", rangeParser, sln, deps.sel.writeForLightnings, "AI_LN_POS_")
	wireAxisEvenToggles(LN, "Rot", sln, "LN")
	wireAxisEvenToggles(LN, "Pos", sln, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "RotationEvenCycle", safeRange, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "PositionEvenCycle", safeRange, "LN")
	wireRotOrder(LN, sln, "LN")
	wirePosMode(LN, sln, "LN")

	-- Origin motion (the Part's Movement keys).
	C.cInput(LN, "Drag", tonumber, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "TurbulenceFrequency", tonumber, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "Acceleration", function(t)
		local v = parseCSV(t, 3)
		if not v then return nil end
		return Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3])
	end, "LN")
	deps.wireAxisGraphSelect(LN, "PosOffset", sln, "LN")
	deps.wireDisplacementMode(LN, sln, "LN")
	-- Not deps.wireDirMode, which also writes the Part engine's VelocityVectored.
	if LN.DirMode and LN.DirMode.setOnChanged then LN.DirMode.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedLightnings)}
		task.defer(function()
			local text = LN.DirMode.dropdown.Text
			if text ~= "RigidLocal" and text ~= "Local" and text ~= "Global" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set DirMode")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "DirMode", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set DirMode")
		end)
	end) end
	-- Emitter is the authored Direction; Radial is the shape's outward normal.
	if LN.ShapeDirection and LN.ShapeDirection.setOnChanged then LN.ShapeDirection.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedLightnings)}
		task.defer(function()
			local text = LN.ShapeDirection.dropdown.Text
			if text ~= "Emitter" and text ~= "Radial" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set ShapeDirection")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "ShapeDirection", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set ShapeDirection")
		end)
	end) end

	-- Target shows for Point; SeekRadius and Retarget for Seek; Length, Spread and Direction for
	-- Directional; GrowthSpeed for Directional and Seek. Populate applies the same on a fill.
	if LN.TargetMode and LN.TargetMode.setOnChanged then LN.TargetMode.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedLightnings)}
		task.defer(function()
			local text = LN.TargetMode.dropdown.Text
			if text ~= "Directional" and text ~= "Point" and text ~= "Seek" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set TargetMode")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "TargetMode", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set TargetMode")
			if LN.Target and LN.Target.row then LN.Target.row.Visible = text == "Point" end
			for _, k in ipairs({"SeekRadius","SeekRetarget","SeekBias","RetargetSpeed"}) do
				if LN[k] and LN[k].row then LN[k].row.Visible = text == "Seek" end
			end
			for _, k in ipairs({"Length","SpreadAngle","Direction"}) do
				if LN[k] and LN[k].row then LN[k].row.Visible = text == "Directional" end
			end
			if LN.GrowthSpeed and LN.GrowthSpeed.row then LN.GrowthSpeed.row.Visible = text ~= "Point" end
		end)
	end) end
	C.cInput(LN, "SeekRadius", safeRange, "LN")
	C.cToggle(LN, "SeekRetarget", "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "SeekBias", tonumber, "LN")
	C.cInput(LN, "RetargetSpeed", tonumber, "LN")

	-- On the LIVE RenderTemplate: the segments copy its material.
	if LN.Material and LN.Material.setOnChanged then LN.Material.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedLightnings)}
		task.defer(function()
			local matName = LN.Material.dropdown.Text
			local ok, mat = pcall(function() return Enum.Material[matName] end)
			if ok and mat then
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Material")
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
					if rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") then
						rt.Material = mat
						bumpRTPoolGen(item)
					end
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Material")
			end
		end)
	end) end

	for _, k in ipairs({"Brightness","Transparency","Thickness","ThicknessProfile","Timescale","Speed","Turbulence","DiskSize","DiskTransparency","DiskBrightness"}) do
		C.cGraphDots(LN, k, sln, readProp, writeProp)
		C.cGraphInline(LN, k, sln, writeProp, "LN_")
	end
	for _, k in ipairs({"Color", "Gradient"}) do
		C.cColorDots(LN, k, sln, readProp, writeProp)
		C.cColorInline(LN, k, sln, writeProp, "LN_")
		C.cColorSwatch(LN, k, sln, readProp, writeProp)
	end
	wireConfigButtons(LN, function() return ctx.selectedLightnings end)
end

-- PropertyInputsMatte: wires the Matte section. (deps) from PropertyInputs/init.

local GRAPH_KEYS = { "Brightness", "Transparency", "MaskEdgeBrightness", "FlipbookTime", "MaskFlipbookTime" }
local COLOR_KEYS = { "Color", "MaskEdgeColor" }
-- TypeDataMatte.BACK_FACES, VIEW_MODES and FLIPBOOK_MODES, as the dropdowns list them.
local BACK_FACES = { Auto = true, Off = true, X = true, Y = true, Z = true }
local VIEW_MODES = { Tilted = true, ["Semi Tilt"] = true, Middle = true, Front = true, ["On Top"] = true }
local FLIPBOOK_MODES = { None = true, OneShot = true, Loop = true, PingPong = true }

local function positiveNumber(text)
	local value = tonumber(text)
	if value and value > 0 then
		return value
	end
	return nil
end

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local C = deps.C
	local UI = deps.UI
	local Connections = deps.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local readProp = deps.readProp
	local writeProp = deps.writeProp
	local safeRange = deps.safeRange

	local MT = UI.Matte
	if not MT then return end
	local function selectedMattes() return ctx.selectedMattes end

	C.cInput(MT, "Rate", tonumber, "MT")
	C.cInput(MT, "Lifetime", safeRange, "MT")
	C.cToggle(MT, "Enabled", "MT")
	C.cInput(MT, "TextureScale", positiveNumber, "MT")

	local function wireStringDropdown(ref, key, allowed)
		if not ref or not ref.setOnChanged then return end
		ref.setOnChanged(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedMattes)}
			task.defer(function()
				local text = ref.dropdown.Text
				if not allowed[text] then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Matte " .. key)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, key, text) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Matte " .. key)
			end)
		end)
	end
	wireStringDropdown(MT.BackFaces, "BackFaces", BACK_FACES)
	wireStringDropdown(MT.ViewMode, "ViewMode", VIEW_MODES)
	wireStringDropdown(MT.FlipbookMode, "FlipbookMode", FLIPBOOK_MODES)
	C.cInput(MT, "FlipbookFramerate", safeRange, "MT")
	C.cToggle(MT, "FlipbookStartRandom", "MT")
	C.cToggle(MT, "FlipbookReverse", "MT")

	C.cInput(MT, "MaskScale", positiveNumber, "MT")
	wireStringDropdown(MT.MaskFlipbookMode, "MaskFlipbookMode", FLIPBOOK_MODES)
	C.cInput(MT, "MaskFlipbookFramerate", safeRange, "MT")
	C.cToggle(MT, "MaskFlipbookStartRandom", "MT")
	C.cToggle(MT, "MaskFlipbookReverse", "MT")
	C.cToggle(MT, "Pool", "MT")

	-- Active pills: what an Inventory insert fills (InventoryWiring/MatteTargets reads the flags).
	-- ref.refresh() repaints from the first selected Matte; PopulateMatte calls it.
	local function wireActive(ref, key)
		local button = ref and ref.buttons and ref.buttons.Active
		if not button then return end
		local function paint()
			local theme = ctx.UIBuilder.Theme
			local first = ctx.selectedMattes[1]
			local on = first ~= nil and readProp(first, key) == true
			button.BackgroundColor3 = on and theme.Gold or theme.BlobBg
			button.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or theme.BlobAlpha
			button.TextColor3 = on and theme.PanelBg or theme.MutedGold
		end
		ref.refresh = paint
		-- What a click does, by name, for the Studio check: a script cannot press a button.
		ref.toggle = function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedMattes)}
			if #items == 0 then return end
			local on = not (readProp(items[1], key) == true)
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Matte " .. key)
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, key, on) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Matte " .. key)
			paint()
		end
		Connections["MT_" .. key] = button.Activated:Connect(ref.toggle)
	end
	wireActive(MT.PictureActive, "PictureActive")
	wireActive(MT.MaskActive, "MaskActive")

	for _, key in ipairs(GRAPH_KEYS) do
		C.cGraphDots(MT, key, selectedMattes, readProp, writeProp)
		C.cGraphInline(MT, key, selectedMattes, writeProp, "MT_")
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(COLOR_KEYS) do
		C.cColorDots(MT, key, selectedMattes, readProp, writeProp)
		C.cColorInline(MT, key, selectedMattes, writeProp, "MT_")
		C.cColorSwatch(MT, key, selectedMattes, readProp, writeProp)
	end

	-- Stored on the config, and on each item at edit time (Matte/Field: a game script cannot put a
	-- texture on a plane).
	local function wireTexture(row, key)
		if not row or not row.input then return end
		Connections["MT_" .. key] = row.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedMattes)}
			if #items == 0 then return end
			local text = row.input.Text
			local value = ""
			if string.match(text, "%S") then
				local id = string.match(text, "%d+")
				if not id then
					row.input.Text = readProp(items[1], key) or ""
					return
				end
				value = "rbxassetid://" .. id
			end
			row.input.Text = value
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Matte " .. key)
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				writeProp(item, key, value)
			end
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				if item.Parent then
					ctx.Part:SyncMatteField(item)
				end
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Matte " .. key)
		end)
	end
	wireTexture(MT.Texture, "Texture")
	wireTexture(MT.MaskTexture, "MaskTexture")
end

--[[
	PropertyInputsPE: wires the native ParticleEmitter section and the rows' "more" (dots) menu.
	(ctx, connectors)
]]

local SequenceClipboard = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.SequenceClipboard)

return function(ctx, C)
	local Connections = ctx.Connections
	local ChangeHistoryService = ctx.ChangeHistoryService
	local TypeRegistry = ctx.TypeRegistry
	local UIBuilder = ctx.UIBuilder
	local util = ctx.util
	local sel = ctx.sel
	local UI = ctx.UI
	local selection = ctx.Selection

	local getPEGraph = util.getPEGraph
	local setPEGraph = util.setPEGraph
	local safeRange = util.safeRange
	local parseCSV = util.parseCSV
	local populateGraphInput = util.populateGraphInput
	local populateColorInput = util.populateColorInput

	-- The dots menu
	local dotsMenu = UI.Menu
	if dotsMenu then
		local _dotsTarget = nil

		local function hideDotsMenu() dotsMenu.Visible = false end

		local function showDotsMenu(btn, typeRef, key, getItems, getFn, setFn)
			if dotsMenu.Visible then hideDotsMenu(); return end
			_dotsTarget = {typeRef = typeRef, key = key, getItems = getItems, getFn = getFn, setFn = setFn}
			local absPos = btn.AbsolutePosition
			local absSize = btn.AbsoluteSize
			local scale = 1
			local uiScaleObj = UI and UI.ScreenGui and UI.ScreenGui:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIScale")
			if uiScaleObj then scale = uiScaleObj.Scale end
			-- The menu hangs from the button's end of its field: left edges meet for a leading button
			-- (Widgets.makeGraphRow), right edges otherwise; in view units.
			local menuW = dotsMenu.Size.X.Offset
			local x = (absPos.X + absSize.X) / scale - menuW
			if btn.Position.X.Scale == 0 then
				x = absPos.X / scale
			end
			local y = (absPos.Y + absSize.Y + 2) / scale
			local vp = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
			if vp then
				x = math.clamp(x, 0, vp.X / scale - menuW)
				y = math.min(y, vp.Y / scale - 80)
			end
			dotsMenu.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y)
			dotsMenu.Visible = true
			local pasteBtn = dotsMenu:FindFirstChild("Paste")
			if pasteBtn then
				-- Greyed while there is nothing to paste.
				local theme = UIBuilder.Theme
				pasteBtn.TextColor3 = SequenceClipboard.has() and theme.Gold or theme.DarkGold:Lerp(theme.PanelBg, 0.4)
			end
		end
		ctx._showDotsMenu = showDotsMenu

		local function refreshTargetDisplay()
			if not _dotsTarget then return end
			local ref = _dotsTarget.typeRef[_dotsTarget.key]
			if not ref then return end
			local items = _dotsTarget.getItems()
			if #items == 0 then return end
			local val = _dotsTarget.getFn(items[1], _dotsTarget.key)
			if val and typeof(val) == "NumberSequence" then
				populateGraphInput(ref, val)
			elseif val and typeof(val) == "ColorSequence" then
				populateColorInput(ref, val)
			end
		end

		if UI.CopyBtn then
			UI.CopyBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not _dotsTarget then return end
				local items = _dotsTarget.getItems()
				if #items == 0 then hideDotsMenu(); return end
				local current = _dotsTarget.getFn(items[1], _dotsTarget.key)
				if current then SequenceClipboard.set(current) end
				hideDotsMenu()
			end)
		end

		if UI.PasteBtn then
			UI.PasteBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not _dotsTarget or not SequenceClipboard.has() then hideDotsMenu(); return end
				local items = _dotsTarget.getItems()
				if #items == 0 then hideDotsMenu(); return end
				local current = _dotsTarget.getFn(items[1], _dotsTarget.key)
				if current and SequenceClipboard.has(typeof(current)) then
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Paste " .. _dotsTarget.key)
					for _, item in ipairs(items) do _dotsTarget.setFn(item, _dotsTarget.key, SequenceClipboard.get()) end
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Paste " .. _dotsTarget.key)
					refreshTargetDisplay()
				end
				hideDotsMenu()
			end)
		end

		if UI.ResetBtn then
			UI.ResetBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if not _dotsTarget then hideDotsMenu(); return end
				local items = _dotsTarget.getItems()
				if #items == 0 then hideDotsMenu(); return end
				-- Each item's own type default (a Trail's Brightness is a number, a Part's a sequence). Checked
				-- first, so no waypoint pair is left open when nothing writes.
				local anyWritable = false
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					local typeName = TypeRegistry.getTypeName and TypeRegistry.getTypeName(item)
					local defaultVal = typeName and TypeRegistry.getDefault and TypeRegistry.getDefault(typeName, _dotsTarget.key)
					if defaultVal ~= nil then anyWritable = true; break end
				end
				if not anyWritable then hideDotsMenu(); return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Reset " .. _dotsTarget.key)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					local typeName = TypeRegistry.getTypeName and TypeRegistry.getTypeName(item)
					local defaultVal = typeName and TypeRegistry.getDefault and TypeRegistry.getDefault(typeName, _dotsTarget.key)
					if defaultVal ~= nil then _dotsTarget.setFn(item, _dotsTarget.key, defaultVal) end
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Reset " .. _dotsTarget.key); refreshTargetDisplay()
				hideDotsMenu()
			end)
		end

		-- The clipboard outlives the selection; ColorGradientEditor's Copy and Paste share it.
		Connections["DotsHide"] = selection.SelectionChanged:Connect(function()
			hideDotsMenu()
			_dotsTarget = nil
			UIBuilder.hideDropdownExpansion()
		end)
	end

	-- ParticleEmitter
	local PE = UI.PE
	if PE then
		-- itemsSnapshot is the items at the click or focus; without it, the selection now.
		local function writePE(prop, value, itemsSnapshot)
			local items = itemsSnapshot or {table.unpack(ctx.selectedPEs)}
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Edit " .. prop)
			for _, pe in ipairs(items) do pcall(function() pe[prop] = value end) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Edit " .. prop)
			if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
		end

		-- The PEs selected when an input took focus: FocusLost writes those, not a later selection.
		local _peFocusSnap = nil
		local function _wirePEInputFocus(ref, key)
			if not (ref and ref.input) then return end
			Connections["PE_FocusSnap_"..key] = ref.input.Focused:Connect(function()
				_peFocusSnap = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedPEs)}
			end)
		end
		local function _peWrite(prop, value)
			writePE(prop, value, _peFocusSnap)
		end

		-- An attribute toggle on each selected emitter, one undo step a click.
		local function wireAttributeToggle(key)
			local ref = PE[key]
			if not ref or not ref.toggle then return end
			Connections["T_" .. key .. "_PE"] = ref.toggle.Activated:Connect(function() task.defer(function()
				local isOn = ref.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn") or false
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Toggle " .. key)
				for _, pe in ipairs(ctx.selectedPEs) do pe:SetAttribute(key, isOn) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Toggle " .. key)
				-- Follow Spin's row shows only while Lock Roll is on.
				if key == "LockRoll" and ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populatePEs then
					ctx.populate.populatePEs(ctx.selectedPEs)
				end
			end) end)
		end
		-- PEs are never transformed; EnabledLoop's DescendantAdded scan still pins them.
		wireAttributeToggle("PreloadTexture")
		-- Part/RollLock fires the emitter so its image turns with its parent.
		wireAttributeToggle("LockRoll")
		-- With Lock Roll, each burst spins with the spinning copy it sits on.
		wireAttributeToggle("FollowSpin")

		if PE.Rate and PE.Rate.input then
			_wirePEInputFocus(PE.Rate, "Rate")
			Connections["PE_Rate"] = PE.Rate.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(PE.Rate.input.Text); if n then _peWrite("Rate", n) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.Drag and PE.Drag.input then
			Connections["PE_Drag"] = PE.Drag.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(PE.Drag.input.Text); if n then _peWrite("Drag", n) end
			end)
		end
		-- Not clamped: out-of-range values (negative Brightness, LightInfluence > 1) make effects, and
		-- the engine clamps what it must.
		if PE.Brightness and PE.Brightness.input then
			Connections["PE_Br"] = PE.Brightness.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(PE.Brightness.input.Text); if n then _peWrite("Brightness", n) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.LightEmission and PE.LightEmission.input then
			Connections["PE_LE"] = PE.LightEmission.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(PE.LightEmission.input.Text); if n then _peWrite("LightEmission", n) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.LightInfluence and PE.LightInfluence.input then
			Connections["PE_LI"] = PE.LightInfluence.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(PE.LightInfluence.input.Text); if n then _peWrite("LightInfluence", n) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.ZOffset and PE.ZOffset.input then
			Connections["PE_ZO"] = PE.ZOffset.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(PE.ZOffset.input.Text); if n then _peWrite("ZOffset", n) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.VelocityInheritance and PE.VelocityInheritance.input then
			Connections["PE_VI"] = PE.VelocityInheritance.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(PE.VelocityInheritance.input.Text); if n then _peWrite("VelocityInheritance", n) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.TimeScale and PE.TimeScale.input then
			Connections["PE_TS"] = PE.TimeScale.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(PE.TimeScale.input.Text); if n then _peWrite("TimeScale", n) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.ShapePartial and PE.ShapePartial.input then
			Connections["PE_SP"] = PE.ShapePartial.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local n = tonumber(PE.ShapePartial.input.Text); if n then _peWrite("ShapePartial", n) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.Lifetime and PE.Lifetime.input then
			Connections["PE_LT"] = PE.Lifetime.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local r = safeRange(PE.Lifetime.input.Text); if r then _peWrite("Lifetime", r) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.Speed and PE.Speed.input then
			Connections["PE_Spd"] = PE.Speed.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local r = safeRange(PE.Speed.input.Text); if r then _peWrite("Speed", r) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.Rotation and PE.Rotation.input then
			Connections["PE_Rot"] = PE.Rotation.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local r = safeRange(PE.Rotation.input.Text); if r then _peWrite("Rotation", r) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.RotSpeed and PE.RotSpeed.input then
			Connections["PE_RS"] = PE.RotSpeed.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local r = safeRange(PE.RotSpeed.input.Text); if r then _peWrite("RotSpeed", r) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.FlipbookFramerate and PE.FlipbookFramerate.input then
			Connections["PE_FF"] = PE.FlipbookFramerate.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local r = safeRange(PE.FlipbookFramerate.input.Text); if r then _peWrite("FlipbookFramerate", r) end
			end)
		end
		-- "cols, rows": "0" is None, a square 2, 4 or 8 a preset Grid layout, anything else Custom. The
		-- Inventory lays a sheet out by the same rule (InventoryDetailWiring layFlipbook).
		if PE.FlipbookGrid and PE.FlipbookGrid.input then
			Connections["PE_FBG"] = PE.FlipbookGrid.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local txt = PE.FlipbookGrid.input.Text
				if txt == "~" or txt == "-" then return end
				-- One undo step; the snapshots refresh so the next Hue / Resize / Retime preview starts here.
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before PE FlipbookGrid")
				local writeItems = _peFocusSnap or ctx.selectedPEs
				if txt == "" or txt == "0" or txt == "0, 0" then
					for _, pe in ipairs(writeItems) do
						pcall(function() pe.FlipbookLayout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.None end)
					end
					PE.FlipbookGrid.input.Text = "0, 0"
					ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: PE FlipbookGrid")
					if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
					return
				end
				local v = parseCSV(txt, 2); if not v then ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: PE FlipbookGrid"); return end
				local cols, rows = math.max(1, math.floor(v[1] or 1)), math.max(1, math.floor(v[2] or 1))
				local layout
				if cols == rows and (cols == 2 or cols == 4 or cols == 8) then
					layout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout["Grid" .. cols .. "x" .. cols]
				else
					layout = Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Custom
				end
				for _, pe in ipairs(writeItems) do
					pcall(function() pe.FlipbookLayout = layout end)
					if layout == Enum.ParticleFlipbookLayout.Custom then
						pcall(function() pe.FlipbookSizeX = cols end)
						pcall(function() pe.FlipbookSizeY = rows end)
					end
				end
				PE.FlipbookGrid.input.Text = cols .. ", " .. rows
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: PE FlipbookGrid")
				if ctx._refreshSnapshots then task.defer(ctx._refreshSnapshots) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.SpreadAngle and PE.SpreadAngle.input then
			Connections["PE_SA"] = PE.SpreadAngle.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local v = parseCSV(PE.SpreadAngle.input.Text, 2); if v then _peWrite("SpreadAngle", Vector2.new(v[1], v[2])) end
			end)
		end
		if PE.Acceleration and PE.Acceleration.input then
			Connections["PE_Acc"] = PE.Acceleration.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local v = parseCSV(PE.Acceleration.input.Text, 3); if v then _peWrite("Acceleration", Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3])) end
			end)
		end
		-- One focus snapshot serves every input: only one TextBox has focus at a time.
		for _, key in ipairs({
			"Rate","Drag","Brightness","LightEmission","LightInfluence","ZOffset",
			"VelocityInheritance","TimeScale","ShapePartial","Lifetime","Speed",
			"Rotation","RotSpeed","FlipbookFramerate","FlipbookGrid","SpreadAngle",
			"Acceleration","Texture",
		}) do
			_wirePEInputFocus(PE[key], key)
		end
		-- The items at the click, not when the deferred write runs.
		local function _wireToggle(ref, prop, key)
			if not (ref and ref.toggle) then return end
			Connections["PE_"..key] = ref.toggle.Activated:Connect(function()
				local snap = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedPEs)}
				task.defer(function()
					local v = ref.toggle:GetAttribute("IsOn")
					writePE(prop, v, snap)
				end)
			end)
		end
		_wireToggle(PE.Enabled, "Enabled", "En")
		_wireToggle(PE.LockedToPart, "LockedToPart", "LTP")
		_wireToggle(PE.FlipbookStartRandom, "FlipbookStartRandom", "FSR")
		_wireToggle(PE.FlipbookBlendFrames, "FlipbookBlendFrames", "FBF")
		_wireToggle(PE.WindAffectsDrag, "WindAffectsDrag", "WAD")
		local function cPEDropdown(ref, enumType, prop)
			if not ref or not ref.setOnChanged then return end
			ref.setOnChanged(function()
				local snap = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedPEs)}
				task.defer(function()
					local v = enumType[ref.dropdown.Text]
					if v then writePE(prop, v, snap) end
					-- Lock Roll's row shows only for VelocityPerpendicular.
					if prop == "Orientation" and ctx.populate and ctx.populate.populatePEs then
						ctx.populate.populatePEs(ctx.selectedPEs)
					end
				end)
			end)
		end
		cPEDropdown(PE.EmissionDirection, Enum.NormalId, "EmissionDirection")
		cPEDropdown(PE.Orientation, Enum.ParticleOrientation, "Orientation")
		cPEDropdown(PE.Shape, Enum.ParticleEmitterShape, "Shape")
		cPEDropdown(PE.ShapeStyle, Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeStyle, "ShapeStyle")
		cPEDropdown(PE.ShapeInOut, Enum.ParticleEmitterShapeInOut, "ShapeInOut")
		cPEDropdown(PE.FlipbookMode, Enum.ParticleFlipbookMode, "FlipbookMode")

		local function spe() return ctx.selectedPEs end
		local function writePEGraph(item, k, v) setPEGraph(item, k, v) end
		local function writePEColor(item, k, v) pcall(function() item[k] = v end) end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Size","Transparency","Squash"}) do
			C.cGraphDots(PE, k, spe, getPEGraph, writePEGraph)
			C.cGraphInline(PE, k, spe, writePEGraph, "PE_")
		end
		C.cColorDots(PE, "Color", spe, getPEGraph, writePEColor)
		C.cColorInline(PE, "Color", spe, writePEColor, "PE_")
		C.cColorSwatch(PE, "Color", spe, getPEGraph, writePEColor)

		if PE.Texture and PE.Texture.input then
			Connections["PE_Tex"] = PE.Texture.input.FocusLost:Connect(function()
				local txt = PE.Texture.input.Text
				if txt == "~" then return end
				if txt == "-" or txt == "" then
					_peWrite("Texture", "")
				else
					local id = txt:match("%d+")
					if id then _peWrite("Texture", "rbxassetid://" .. id) end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- PropertyInputsReactor: wires the Reactor section, and the same rows (BuildPropertiesReactorRows)
-- in the Meshes section's Reactor group, where a reacting mesh keeps the Reactor's settings on its
-- own config. (deps) from PropertyInputs/init.

local Widgets = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.UIBuilder.Widgets)
local ReactorPieces = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.Reactor.Pieces)
local ReactorShards = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.Reactor.Shards)
local ReactorSites = require(script.Parent.Parent.Modules.Part.Reactor.Sites)
local EventsConnectors = require(script.Parent.Parent.EventsConnectors)

-- TypeDataReactor.AFTER, BREAK and SHARD_PATTERNS, as the dropdowns list them.
local AFTER = { Stay = true, Fade = true, Return = true }
local BREAK = { None = true, Blocks = true, Shards = true }
local SHARD_PATTERNS = { Even = true, ["Around hit"] = true, Cracks = true }
-- TypeDataReactor.PARTICLE_PATTERNS: an emitted copy is never cracked ground.
local PARTICLE_PATTERNS = { Even = true, ["Around hit"] = true }
local SCATTER_TURN = { Upright = true, ["Any way"] = true }
local SCATTER_SHAPES = { Box = true, Circle = true, ["Region shape"] = true }
-- How long a Scatter button shows what it did, in seconds.
local RESULT_SECONDS = 1.6

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local C = deps.C
	local UI = deps.UI
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local readProp = deps.readProp
	local writeProp = deps.writeProp
	local safeRange = deps.safeRange
	local Connections = deps.Connections
	local Scatter = deps.scatter

	-- Below zero is refused, and the row keeps what it showed.
	local function parseSeconds(text)
		local seconds = tonumber(text)
		if not seconds or seconds < 0 then
			return nil
		end
		return seconds
	end
	-- A whole number of blocks or shards a part, from 2 to what one cut gives.
	local function parsePieces(text)
		local count = tonumber(text)
		if not count then
			return nil
		end
		return math.clamp(math.floor(count), 2, ReactorSites.MAX)
	end

	-- Written to what getItems() answered at the pick; afterSet(items, text) runs after.
	local function wireStringDropdown(ref, key, allowed, getItems, afterSet)
		if not ref or not ref.setOnChanged then return end
		ref.setOnChanged(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(getItems())}
			task.defer(function()
				local text = ref.dropdown.Text
				if not allowed[text] then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Reactor " .. key)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, key, text) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Reactor " .. key)
				if afterSet then
					afterSet(items, text)
				end
			end)
		end)
	end

	-- The engine cuts what draws its own shape (Reactor/Shards.cuttable): every part with Shards, and
	-- with Blocks every part that is not a plain box (a box is cut by arithmetic). Says so when some
	-- parts will not be cut. partsOf(item) is the parts a Break of that item would cut. Only the
	-- engine knows a mesh that is not a closed solid (Shards.judge, up to half a second for a new
	-- one): the note waits for the last answer.
	local function noteUncut(items, text, partsOf)
		if text ~= "Shards" and text ~= "Blocks" then
			return
		end
		local parts = {}
		for _, item in ipairs(items) do
			for _, part in ipairs(partsOf(item)) do
				table.insert(parts, part)
			end
		end
		local waiting = #parts
		local function answered()
			waiting -= 1
			if waiting > 0 then
				return
			end
			local uncut, refused = 0, 0
			for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
				local byArithmetic = text == "Blocks" and ReactorPieces.isPlainBlock(part)
				if not byArithmetic and not ReactorShards.cuttable(part) then
					uncut += 1
					if ReactorShards.refused(part) then
						refused += 1
					end
				end
			end
			if uncut == 0 then
				return
			end
			local why = "a Part with a mesh in it, a truss"
			if refused == uncut then
				why = "a mesh must be a closed solid"
			elseif refused > 0 then
				why = "open mesh, Part with a mesh, truss"
			end
			Widgets.showToast(string.format("%s: %d of %d parts cannot be cut and will move whole (%s).", text, uncut, #parts, why), "warn", 6)
		end
		for _, part in ipairs(parts) do
			ReactorShards.judge(part, answered)
		end
	end

	-- The rows a Reactor and a reacting mesh both have, on `refs`, written through `writer` (a
	-- Connectors writer name) to what getItems() answers. patterns: that section's Pattern choices.
	local function wireShared(refs, writer, getItems, patterns, partsOf)
		for _, key in ipairs({ "Hold", "HoldSpread", "MaxPieces", "AfterDelay", "AfterTime" }) do
			C.cInput(refs, key, tonumber, writer)
		end
		C.cInput(refs, "MaxAirTime", parseSeconds, writer)
		for _, key in ipairs({ "Gravity", "Bounciness", "Friction", "TumbleSpeed" }) do
			C.cInput(refs, key, safeRange, writer)
		end
		-- Free text; a Force with an empty Group reaches the item whatever this says.
		C.cInput(refs, "Group", function(text) return text end, writer)
		wireStringDropdown(refs.After, "After", AFTER, getItems)
		wireStringDropdown(refs.Break, "Break", BREAK, getItems, function(items, text)
			noteUncut(items, text, partsOf)
		end)
		wireStringDropdown(refs.ShardPattern, "ShardPattern", patterns, getItems)
		C.cInput(refs, "Pieces", parsePieces, writer)
	end

	-- The Meshes section's Reactor group: the switch, whose rows show while it is on, and the shared
	-- rows. A Break cuts the emitted copy, whose shape is the RenderTemplate's.
	local P = UI.Part
	if P and P.Reacts then
		C.cToggleGroup(P, "Reacts", "Part", "React to Forces")
		wireShared(P, "Part", function() return ctx.selectedParts end, PARTICLE_PATTERNS, function(item)
			local template = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
			if template and template:IsA("BasePart") then
				return ReactorPieces.parts(template)
			end
			return {}
		end)
	end

	local RC = UI.Reactor
	if not RC then return end
	local function selectedReactors() return ctx.selectedReactors end

	wireShared(RC, "RC", selectedReactors, SHARD_PATTERNS, ReactorPieces.parts)
	-- The Advanced group's Hit Filter opens the Events section's panel.
	EventsConnectors.wireHitFilter(ctx, "RC_HitFilterPick", RC.HitFilter, selectedReactors)
	for _, key in ipairs({ "ScatterSpacing", "ScatterSeed" }) do
		C.cInput(RC, key, tonumber, "RC")
	end
	-- A whole number of pieces, held to what one Fill places.
	C.cInput(RC, "ScatterCount", function(text)
		local count = tonumber(text)
		if not count then
			return nil
		end
		return math.clamp(math.floor(count), 0, Scatter.MAX_COUNT)
	end, "RC")
	C.cInput(RC, "ScatterSize", safeRange, "RC")
	C.cToggle(RC, "Collapse", "RC")
	wireStringDropdown(RC.ScatterTurn, "ScatterTurn", SCATTER_TURN, selectedReactors)
	wireStringDropdown(RC.ScatterShape, "ScatterShape", SCATTER_SHAPES, selectedReactors)
	-- The share of a Circle's radius left empty: below 1, or nothing is left to fill.
	C.cInput(RC, "ScatterHollow", function(text)
		local share = tonumber(text)
		if not share then
			return nil
		end
		return math.clamp(share, 0, 0.95)
	end, "RC")

	-- Connectors.cConfigButton only sets an ObjectValue that exists, so it is made at the press,
	-- before the picker opens.
	local pickers = { { key = Scatter.SOURCE, title = "Scatter Pieces" }, { key = Scatter.REGION, title = "Scatter Region" } }
	for _, picker in ipairs(pickers) do
		local ref = RC[picker.key]
		if ref and ref.configBtn then
			Connections["RC_Ensure_" .. picker.key] = ref.configBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
				for _, item in ipairs(ctx.selectedReactors) do
					Scatter.ensureValue(item, picker.key)
				end
			end)
			C.cConfigButton(ref, function() return ctx.selectedReactors end, picker.title)
		end
	end

	-- Fill and Clear write LIVE user content (parts under the Reactor), one undo step each; the
	-- Reactor is put back first, so no play points at parts that are gone.
	local actions = RC.ScatterActions and RC.ScatterActions.buttons
	-- A button shows what its press did for a moment, then its name. The name is read once, here: a
	-- second press can come while the first one's answer shows.
	local names = {}
	for key, button in pairs(actions or {}) do
		names[key] = button.Text
	end
	local function showResult(key, text)
		local button = actions[key]
		button.Text = text
		task.delay(RESULT_SECONDS, function()
			if button.Parent and button.Text == text then
				button.Text = names[key]
			end
		end)
	end
	local function scatterSettings(item)
		local size = readProp(item, "ScatterSize")
		local smallest, largest = 1, 1
		if typeof(size) == "NumberRange" then
			smallest, largest = size.Min, size.Max
		end
		return {
			Count = readProp(item, "ScatterCount") or 40,
			Spacing = readProp(item, "ScatterSpacing") or 1,
			Turn = readProp(item, "ScatterTurn") or "Upright",
			SizeMin = smallest,
			SizeMax = largest,
			Seed = readProp(item, "ScatterSeed") or 1,
			Shape = readProp(item, "ScatterShape") or "Box",
			Hollow = readProp(item, "ScatterHollow") or 0,
		}
	end
	if actions and actions.Fill then
		Connections["RC_ScatterFill"] = actions.Fill.Activated:Connect(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedReactors)}
			if #items == 0 then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Scatter Fill")
			local total, asked, problem = 0, 0, nil
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				if ctx.Part then ctx.Part:RestoreReactor(item) end
				local placed, itemProblem, wanted = Scatter.fill(item, scatterSettings(item))
				total += placed
				asked += wanted
				problem = problem or itemProblem
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Scatter Fill")
			-- Fewer than asked: the Region has no room for more at this Spacing. A button holds about a dozen
			-- characters at text size 16 (Shannon), so four-digit counts drop the word.
			local result = total .. " placed"
			if problem then
				result = problem
			elseif total < asked then
				result = total .. "/" .. asked .. (if asked < 1000 then " fit" else "")
			end
			showResult("Fill", result)
		end)
	end
	if actions and actions.Clear then
		Connections["RC_ScatterClear"] = actions.Clear.Activated:Connect(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedReactors)}
			if #items == 0 then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Scatter Clear")
			local total = 0
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do
				if ctx.Part then ctx.Part:RestoreReactor(item) end
				total += Scatter.clear(item)
			end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Scatter Clear")
			showResult("Clear", total .. (if total < 1000 then " removed" else " gone"))
		end)
	end
end

-- PropertyInputsRocks: wires the Rocks section. (deps) from PropertyInputs/init.

-- Writes to the LIVE RenderTemplate skip TypeRegistry.write, so they bump its _PoolGen here.
local function bumpRTPoolGen(item)
	if not item then return end
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not rt then return end
	local cur = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
end

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local C = deps.C
	local UI = deps.UI
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local readProp = deps.readProp
	local writeProp = deps.writeProp
	local parseCSV = deps.parseCSV
	local safeRange = deps.safeRange
	local wireEmissionMode = deps.wireEmissionMode
	local wireItemAttrToggle = deps.wireItemAttrToggle
	local wirePosMode = deps.wirePosMode
	local wireAxisInput = deps.wireAxisInput
	local wireAxisEvenToggles = deps.wireAxisEvenToggles
	local wireConfigButtons = C.wireConfigButtons

	local RK = UI.Rocks
	if not RK then return end
	local function srk() return ctx.selectedRocks end

	wireEmissionMode(RK, function() return ctx.selectedRocks end, "RK")
	wireItemAttrToggle(RK, "PreloadTexture", function() return ctx.selectedRocks end, "RK")
	C.cInput(RK, "Rate", tonumber, "RK")
	C.cInput(RK, "Keyframes", tonumber, "RK", "TotalKeyFrames")
	C.cInput(RK, "Linger", tonumber, "RK", "PartLife")
	C.cInput(RK, "Lifetime", safeRange, "RK")
	C.cInput(RK, "SpreadAngle", function(t) local v = parseCSV(t,2); if not v then return nil end; return Vector2.new(v[1],v[2]) end, "RK")
	for _, k in ipairs({"ChunkCount","ChunkScale","Gravity","Bounciness","Friction","TumbleSpeed"}) do
		C.cInput(RK, k, safeRange, "RK")
	end
	local rangeParser = function(t)
		local v = parseCSV(t, 2)
		if not v then return nil end
		return NumberRange.new(math.min(v[1], v[2]), math.max(v[1], v[2]))
	end
	wireAxisInput(RK, "Pos", rangeParser, srk, deps.sel.writeForRocks, "AI_RK_POS_")
	wireAxisEvenToggles(RK, "Pos", srk, "RK")
	C.cToggle(RK, "Enabled", "RK")
	C.cToggle(RK, "Pool", "RK")
	C.cToggle(RK, "SinkOut", "RK")
	C.cToggle(RK, "InheritFloor", "RK")
	C.cToggle(RK, "HitPerChunk", "RK")
	C.cDropdown(RK, "Direction", Enum.NormalId, "RK", "EmissionDirection")
	wirePosMode(RK, srk, "RK")

	if RK.BurstMode and RK.BurstMode.setOnChanged then RK.BurstMode.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedRocks)}
		task.defer(function()
			local text = RK.BurstMode.dropdown.Text
			if text ~= "Directional" and text ~= "Ring" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set BurstMode")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "BurstMode", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set BurstMode")
		end)
	end) end

	-- On the LIVE RenderTemplate: the chunks copy its material.
	if RK.Material and RK.Material.setOnChanged then RK.Material.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedRocks)}
		task.defer(function()
			local matName = RK.Material.dropdown.Text
			local ok, mat = pcall(function() return Enum.Material[matName] end)
			if ok and mat then
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Material")
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
					if rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") then
						rt.Material = mat
						bumpRTPoolGen(item)
					end
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Material")
			end
		end)
	end) end

	for _, k in ipairs({"Speed","Brightness","Transparency","Scale","Timescale"}) do
		C.cGraphDots(RK, k, srk, readProp, writeProp)
		C.cGraphInline(RK, k, srk, writeProp, "RK_")
	end
	C.cColorDots(RK, "Color", srk, readProp, writeProp)
	C.cColorInline(RK, "Color", srk, writeProp, "RK_")
	C.cColorSwatch(RK, "Color", srk, readProp, writeProp)
	wireConfigButtons(RK, function() return ctx.selectedRocks end)
end

return function(deps)
	local ctx = deps.ctx
	local C = deps.C
	local UI = deps.UI
	local ChangeHistoryService = deps.ChangeHistoryService
	local readProp = deps.readProp
	local writeProp = deps.writeProp
	local parseCSV = deps.parseCSV
	local safeRange = deps.safeRange
	local wireEmissionMode = deps.wireEmissionMode
	local wireItemAttrToggle = deps.wireItemAttrToggle
	local wireConfigButtons = C.wireConfigButtons

	local RP = UI.Rope
	if not RP then return end
	local function srp() return ctx.selectedRopes end

	wireEmissionMode(RP, function() return ctx.selectedRopes end, "RP")
	wireItemAttrToggle(RP, "PreloadTexture", function() return ctx.selectedRopes end, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "Rate", tonumber, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "Keyframes", tonumber, "RP", "TotalKeyFrames")
	C.cInput(RP, "Linger", tonumber, "RP", "PartLife")
	C.cInput(RP, "Lifetime", safeRange, "RP")
	for _, k in ipairs({"SegmentCount","RopeLength","WindAmplitude","LaunchSpeed"}) do
		C.cInput(RP, k, safeRange, "RP")
	end
	C.cInput(RP, "Slack", tonumber, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "Stiffness", tonumber, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "Damping", tonumber, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "WindFrequency", tonumber, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "TurbulenceFrequency", tonumber, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "Drag", tonumber, "RP")
	local vec3Parser = function(t)
		local v = parseCSV(t, 3)
		if not v then return nil end
		return Vector3.new(v[1], v[2], v[3])
	end
	C.cInput(RP, "Gravity", vec3Parser, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "Acceleration", vec3Parser, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "SpreadAngle", function(t)
		local v = parseCSV(t, 2)
		if not v then return nil end
		return Vector2.new(v[1], v[2])
	end, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "GrowIn", tonumber, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "DeathWindow", tonumber, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "BendStiffness", tonumber, "RP")
	C.cToggle(RP, "Enabled", "RP")
	C.cToggle(RP, "Pool", "RP")
	C.cDropdown(RP, "Direction", Enum.NormalId, "RP", "EmissionDirection")
	C.cDropdown(RP, "MotionDirection", Enum.NormalId, "RP")

	local rangeParser = function(t)
		local v = parseCSV(t, 2)
		if not v then return nil end
		return NumberRange.new(math.min(v[1], v[2]), math.max(v[1], v[2]))
	end
	deps.wireAxisInput(RP, "Pos", rangeParser, srp, deps.sel.writeForRopes, "AI_RP_POS_")
	deps.wireAxisInput(RP, "Rot", rangeParser, srp, deps.sel.writeForRopes, "AI_RP_ROT_")
	deps.wireAxisEvenToggles(RP, "Pos", srp, "RP")
	deps.wireAxisEvenToggles(RP, "Rot", srp, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "PositionEvenCycle", safeRange, "RP")
	C.cInput(RP, "RotationEvenCycle", safeRange, "RP")
	deps.wireRotOrder(RP, srp, "RP")
	deps.wirePosMode(RP, srp, "RP")

	for _, def in ipairs({
		{ key = "SpawnTarget", valid = { Start = true, End = true } },
		{ key = "DeathMode", valid = { None = true, Retract = true, Release = true } },
	}) do
		local ref = RP[def.key]
		if ref and ref.setOnChanged then ref.setOnChanged(function()
			local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedRopes)}
			task.defer(function()
				local text = ref.dropdown.Text
				if not def.valid[text] then return end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set " .. def.key)
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, def.key, text) end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set " .. def.key)
			end)
		end) end
	end

	-- Anchor motion, as for Lightning; DisplacementMode's Local and RigidLocal are the same on a rope.
	deps.wireAxisGraphSelect(RP, "PosOffset", srp, "RP")
	deps.wireDisplacementMode(RP, srp, "RP")

	-- Populate applies the same gating on a fill.
	local function gatePinRows(text)
		-- End Anchor is also the launch destination; Direction and Spread aim StartOnly and Launch.
		if RP.Target and RP.Target.row then RP.Target.row.Visible = text == "BothEnds" or text == "Launch" end
		if RP.LaunchSpeed and RP.LaunchSpeed.row then RP.LaunchSpeed.row.Visible = text == "Launch" end
		for _, k in ipairs({"Direction","SpreadAngle"}) do
			if RP[k] and RP[k].row then RP[k].row.Visible = text ~= "BothEnds" end
		end
	end
	if RP.PinMode and RP.PinMode.setOnChanged then RP.PinMode.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedRopes)}
		task.defer(function()
			local text = RP.PinMode.dropdown.Text
			if text ~= "BothEnds" and text ~= "StartOnly" and text ~= "Launch" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set PinMode")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "PinMode", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set PinMode")
			gatePinRows(text)
		end)
	end) end

	if RP.MotionTarget and RP.MotionTarget.setOnChanged then RP.MotionTarget.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedRopes)}
		task.defer(function()
			local text = RP.MotionTarget.dropdown.Text
			if text ~= "Start" and text ~= "End" then return end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set MotionTarget")
			for _, item in ipairs(items) do writeProp(item, "MotionTarget", text) end
			ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set MotionTarget")
		end)
	end) end

	-- On the LIVE RenderTemplate: the segments copy its material.
	if RP.Material and RP.Material.setOnChanged then RP.Material.setOnChanged(function()
		local items = {table.unpack(ctx.selectedRopes)}
		task.defer(function()
			local matName = RP.Material.dropdown.Text
			local ok, mat = pcall(function() return Enum.Material[matName] end)
			if ok and mat then
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Before Set Material")
				for _, item in ipairs(items) do
					local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
					if rt and rt:IsA("BasePart") then
						rt.Material = mat
						bumpRTPoolGen(item)
					end
				end
				ChangeHistoryService:SetWaypoint("Part-Icles: Set Material")
			end
		end)
	end) end

	for _, k in ipairs({"Brightness","Transparency","Thickness","ThicknessProfile","Timescale","Turbulence","Speed"}) do
		C.cGraphDots(RP, k, srp, readProp, writeProp)
		C.cGraphInline(RP, k, srp, writeProp, "RP_")
	end
	C.cColorDots(RP, "Color", srp, readProp, writeProp)
	C.cColorInline(RP, "Color", srp, writeProp, "RP_")
	C.cColorSwatch(RP, "Color", srp, readProp, writeProp)
	wireConfigButtons(RP, function() return ctx.selectedRopes end)
end
